🌱 At the start a fingertip touch floats a person or object up to about a car's weight until you release it, or drags someone you grab to their knees.
📈 With training: debris dropped on cue, rubble lifted off survivors, drifting wall leaps, unshakable anchors, one-handed car throws, crushing fields, a building held aloft.
⚠️ Whatever you float falls when you let go.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as nausea and dizziness build with the weight you change.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ochaco Uraraka (Zero Gravity).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Liftoff Tap, Ballast Palm
Gravity Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user changes the weight of what a bare fingertip or palm touches. At first: floats people and objects up to about a ton total (a small car) until a release gesture from anywhere in sight, or makes a held person about twice as heavy for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: skin contact only, so full gloves block it; floated things keep momentum (a pushed car still hits hard) and drift in wind. Past the total, new touches do nothing; no push or pull at range; all of it falls if the user lets go or is knocked out. Quirk Strain: light: floating one person or object; moderate: making someone heavy, floating debris or rubble, drifting leap; heavy: anchoring something, throwing a car; severe: signature crush, holding up a collapsing building. Type: Emitter. Law: floating a person against their will is unlawful restraint; the user is liable for anything floated that falls on someone. Look: touched things rise shimmering or sag floorward.
abilities: Liftoff Tap
Ballast Palm

Elasticity Quirk.name: Elasticity Quirk
Elasticity Quirk.description:
🪀 You make surfaces, and even the air, elastic.

🌱 At the start a touch turns a door-sized patch of floor, wall or air into a stretching sheet that stops a blow and throws it back, or springs you a story up.
📈 With training: nets that catch falling people, slingshot launches, holding bands, floors no enemy can stand on, truck-stopping barriers, a dome that returns every blow.
⚠️ Allies need to know where your patches are.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding many patches in mind wears down your focus.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Gentle Criminal (Elasticity).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Bounceback Sheet, Springstep
Elasticity Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user touches a surface, or swipes air within reach, and makes it elastic: it gives under force and snaps back. A new adult user keeps a few door-sized patches; a surface patch lasts about a minute, an air patch a few seconds, unless dropped sooner. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: at the start a patch only returns the force put in; it stops bodies and objects, not fire, light, gas, sound or electricity; bullets or a speeding car tear through. Allies hitting an unknown patch are thrown too. Never works on living bodies or worn clothing. Quirk Strain: light: single patch, bounce; moderate: catching net, slingshot launch, holding band; heavy: elastic floor, vehicle barrier; severe: signature snap, dome over a scene. Type: Emitter. Law: a patch left in public counts as a hidden trap; the user answers for anyone hurt by one they forgot to release. Look: in use, touched surfaces ripple; elastic air is a faint warp, plain in rain, dust or smoke.
abilities: Bounceback Sheet
Springstep

Creation Quirk.name: Creation Quirk
Creation Quirk.description:
🧰 You make solid, nonliving objects out of your own skin, built from your body's stored reserves.

🌱 At the start you pull simple things of one or two materials from your palms and arms: a staff, a baton, a rope, a shield you can crouch behind.
📈 With training: tangling bolas, field medical supplies, a spring grapple, a steel dome, sleeping-gas canisters, a ring of cannons and, at the top, whole working machines.
⚠️ You can only make what you have studied.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, since every object costs what you have eaten.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Momo Yaoyorozu (Creation).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Science +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Palm Forge, Bulwark Shield
Creation Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes solid, nonliving objects that push out through the skin, built from stored body fat. A new adult user makes a simple one- or two-material object, baton to crouch-behind shield, in a second or two; a key or spring takes a quiet minute. Objects are real and stay. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only what the user has studied down to its materials; a guess comes out brittle or fails. At the start, nothing alive, at a distance or bigger than the user. A dozen batons leave a new user hungry and shaky; made food never repays its cost; enemies can take made things. Quirk Strain: light: handheld tool or weapon; moderate: shield, bolas, medical supplies, grapple; heavy: shelter dome, gas canister; severe: signature move, large machine. Type: Emitter. Law: a made blade or gun is still a weapon; a made ID or banknote is forgery. Look: in use, skin glows faintly (player's color) where objects emerge, so costumes bare the arms or back.
abilities: Palm Forge
Bulwark Shield

Plant Quirk.name: Plant Quirk
Plant Quirk.description:
🌿 You grow living vines from your body and raise roots from the ground.

🌱 At the start your vines reach about ten meters, hold an adult and bind limbs, a thorned vine whips anyone in reach, and crops you touch grow days' worth in minutes.
📈 With training: thorn hedges across a street, buried people found through roots, vine swings, lifting rubble, a hardwood ram and, at the top, every plant in a city block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, since every vine grows from your body and needs water and sunlight to regrow.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ibara Shiozaki (Vines), Kamui Woods (Arbor).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Survival +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tendril Bind, Thorn Lash
Plant Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user grows vines from the skin, usually forearms or scalp, and raises roots from touched soil. A new adult user sends wrist-thick vines about ten meters in a second or two, able to hold an adult, and grows touched crops days' worth in minutes. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: fire burns vines, blades cut them; cut vines die, and regrowth needs water and sunlight, so long fights in dark, dry places starve it. Roots need soil or cracked ground; at the start the user cannot command plants they did not grow. Quirk Strain: light: tendril, lash; moderate: hedge, root listening, swing line; heavy: lifting rubble, hardwood ram; severe: signature move, a block's plants. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed binding is unlawful restraint; roots that crack a foundation are property damage. Look: thorned vines push from the skin, roots crack up through soil; as a Mutant Quirk, a permanent feature (vines in hair, bark on forearms).
abilities: Tendril Bind
Thorn Lash

Earth Quirk.name: Earth Quirk
Earth Quirk.description:
🪨 You shape stone, concrete and packed soil by touch.

🌱 At the start you tip up a chest-high slab for cover, drive a stone spur under an attacker, cut steps into a wall and move a car's weight of ground in a second or two.
📈 With training: feet locked in the floor, a ridge heaving down a street, a rising column, shoring a collapse while you open a way in, crushing walls, a reshaped block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every push into the ground jars your wrists.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Cementoss (Cement), Pixie-Bob (Earth Flow).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Upturned Slab, Stone Spur
Earth Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user shapes stone, concrete, brick and packed soil by touch; it softens, flows where pushed, sets hard on release. At first: about a car's weight within a few meters in a second or two (chest-high slab, spur that throws an adult, steps up a wall). Shapes are real stone and stay. More needs learned techniques. Limits: the user must touch or stand on the material, moving only what is joined to it; metal, wood, glass and flesh do not answer (useless on a steel deck or in the air). Shaping takes a moment; reshaping a load-bearing wall can drop a building. Quirk Strain: light: slab, spur; moderate: gripping feet, a ridge down a street, a rising column; heavy: shoring a building, crushing vise; severe: signature move, reshaping a block. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed reshaping of roads or buildings is property damage; sealing a person in is unlawful confinement. Look: none at rest; ground ripples from the palms, gray grit climbs the wrists, stone grinds up.
abilities: Upturned Slab
Stone Spur

Magnetism Quirk.name: Magnetism Quirk
Magnetism Quirk.description:
🧲 You pull and push iron and steel, and you can give anything you touch a magnetic pole.

🌱 At the start you snatch a knife or a gun out of a hand from about ten meters, stop a thrown wrench in midair and slap an attacker away with a repelling push.
📈 With training: marked people locked to walls or each other, scrap storms, girder rides, falling beams caught, a car swung through a barricade, all the steel in a block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as a strained field grabs metal you never meant to move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Magne (Magnetism).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Iron Snatch, Repulse Burst
Magnetism Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user pulls and pushes iron, steel and anyone or anything marked by touch. A new adult user moves steel within about ten meters, up to a person's weight (a knife, a manhole cover). Marks keep a user-picked pole for the scene; opposite marks within a few meters slam together, matching ones push apart. More needs techniques. Limits: aluminum, copper, plastic, wood, stone and unmarked flesh ignore it; most bullets (lead, copper) pass through. The user must see targets; the field wipes cards and scrambles nearby phones; scrap driven edge-first maims and is lethal force. Quirk Strain: light: snatch, shove; moderate: locking marks, scrap volley, glide; heavy: catching falling steel, swinging a car; severe: signature move, a block's steel. Type: Emitter. Law: hurling metal at people without a license is assault with a weapon; disrupting a pacemaker is endangering life. Look: loose metal twitches toward the user, a low hum, marks glow faintly, one color per pole.
abilities: Iron Snatch
Repulse Burst

Acid Quirk.name: Acid Quirk
Acid Quirk.description:
🧪 You secrete acid from your skin and set its strength and thickness each time, from a harmless sting to acid that eats rope, plastic and wood.

🌱 At the start you spray it a few meters, make an attacker drop their weapon with a sting and skate on a slick film faster than you can run.
📈 With training: melted locks and car doors, glued feet, etched climbing routes, an unholdable coat, armor-ruining rain and, at the top, dissolving only what you name.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as overuse leaves your skin raw.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mina Ashido (Acid).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sizzle Flick, Slick Skate
🛡️ Resists: corrosive
Acid Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user secretes acid from the skin, mostly palms and soles, setting strength and thickness each time: stinging film, sticky gel, or acid that eats rope, plastic and wood in seconds. A new adult user sprays it a few meters, about a bucket's worth before running dry; their skin resists corrosives. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: water dilutes it, baking soda neutralizes it, it pools where it runs; fumes in a closed room sting everyone's eyes and lungs, allies included. It eats thick steel or concrete only slowly; full strength scars skin for life, so restraint is the skill. Quirk Strain: light: spray, skating film; moderate: glob, melted lock, etched climb; heavy: full-body coat, acid rain; severe: signature move, tuned solvent. Type: Emitter. Law: acid thrown at a person is aggravated assault; melting locks or cars unlicensed is burglary or property damage. Look: skin glistens with hissing fluid (player's color); skating leaves a wet, shining trail.
abilities: Sizzle Flick
Slick Skate

Toxic Gas Quirk.name: Toxic Gas Quirk
Toxic Gas Quirk.description:
☁️ Your body brews gas and lets it out through your breath or your skin.

🌱 At the start you spit a stinging irritant into a foe's face and fill a room with thick, harmless smoke that hides you and the people you protect.
📈 With training: sleep gas, trace gas that finds survivors in rubble, crowd-flooring nausea, a smothered fire, gas through masks, a building put to sleep with no one hurt.
⚠️ Gas hits whoever breathes it, so where you release it matters most.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your lungs and throat burn raw.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mustard (Gas).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Stealth +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Bitter Breath, Smoke Pall
🛡️ Resists: toxic
Toxic Gas Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user exhales body-made gas (or sweats it from the palms), one blend per release; at the start, stinging irritant or thick harmless smoke. A new adult user fills a room about five meters wide in a few seconds or sends a jet a few strides; a cloud lingers a few minutes in still air. Own gas never harms them. Knockout and stronger blends need techniques. Limits: wind, rain and water spray scatter it; sealed masks and held breath keep it out; it drifts onto allies, hostages and bystanders downwind. It takes a few breaths, cannot be recalled, and in a sealed room builds to a breath-stopping dose. Quirk Strain: light: irritant jet, smoke; moderate: knockout cloud, trace gas; heavy: nausea front, smothering a fire, mask-piercing dose; severe: signature storm, dosing a building. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed gassing is assault; licensed heroes using knockout gas in arrests answer for all who breathe it. Look: haze in the player's color, sharp or sweet smell.
abilities: Bitter Breath
Smoke Pall

Warp Quirk.name: Warp Quirk
Warp Quirk.description:
🌀 You open linked gates: step into one and out of the other.

🌱 At the start gates reach about fifty meters to a spot you can see or have stood in; small ones strike from odd angles, door-sized ones carry you and a companion out.
📈 With training: attacks sent back, peeks into sealed rooms, crowd exits, villains sent far from hostages, the city crossed in a step, command of every door in a building.
⚠️ Warp users are rare, and agencies, the Commission and villains all track them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding two places in mind wears you down.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kurogiri (Warp Gate).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Navigation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sidelong Reach, Threshold Step
Warp Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: two linked gates, one beside the user and one at a spot they can picture (in sight or once stood on); what enters one leaves the other. At first: about fifty meters, at most door-sized, open a few seconds, one pair at a time. More needs learned techniques. Limits: a gate takes a moment to open and works both ways, so quick foes can dodge, follow through or shoot back. Gates never open inside solid matter or a person and never cut: a closing gate pushes anything halfway through back out. Losing focus shuts every gate. Quirk Strain: light: small gates, short step; moderate: turning an attack aside, peephole, group exit; heavy: sending someone away, crossing the city; severe: signature collapse, taking every door in a building. Type: Emitter. Law: moving a person through a gate without consent is abduction; the Commission tracks every registered warp user. Look: none at rest; each gate a flat ring of swirling haze in the player's chosen color, far side visible.
abilities: Sidelong Reach
Threshold Step

Living Shadow Quirk.name: Living Shadow Quirk
Living Shadow Quirk.description:
🌑 A living shadow dwells in your body, talks with its own voice and fights beside you.

🌱 At the start it reaches about five meters, catches blows and falls meant for you or a friend, and rakes opponents with its claws.
📈 With training it pins people, hauls you up buildings, scouts under doors, digs out survivors, wraps you as armor, strikes in step with you and stays yours in total dark.
⚠️ Darkness makes it bigger, stronger and wilder; bright light shrinks it into a timid sulk.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as darkness and anger loosen your hold on it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fumikage Tokoyami (Dark Shadow).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Shade Catch, Umbra Rake
Living Shadow Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a shadow creature with its own mind, voice and player-picked temper lives in the user and pours from their chest. In indoor light a new adult user's shadow is user-sized, reaches about five meters, throws an adult, claws. Darkness makes it bigger, stronger, wilder; bright light (sun, floodlights, fire) shrinks it to a timid scrap. Limits: it stays within reach, cannot fly or pass walls, feels blows and burns, can refuse orders; in total darkness it may frenzy at anyone near, allies included, until light or the user's will reins it in. Quirk Strain: light: catch, strike; moderate: pin, climb, scouting; heavy: bracing rubble or armor; severe: signature duet, control in total darkness. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: whatever it breaks or hurts, even in a frenzy, is the user's own Quirk use. Look: hidden unless peeking; a pitch-black clawed shape, eyes glowing in the player's color; as Mutant, also e.g. light-swallowing skin or a lagging shadow.
abilities: Shade Catch
Umbra Rake

Healing Quirk.name: Healing Quirk
Healing Quirk.description:
💗 Your touch speeds up another person's healing, and they pay with their own stamina.

🌱 At the start you close cuts, stop bleeding and ease sprains in moments, and work down a line of wounded keeping each alive until help comes.
📈 With training: knit bones, a strength-draining touch, poison burned out, the dying held back, grave wounds mended, a room healed at once, what a body cannot fix restored.
⚠️ Healers are rare, and every agency, hospital and villain crew wants one.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as long shifts empty you too.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Recovery Girl (Heal).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Mending Touch, Ward Rounds
Healing Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: by touch (or a kiss, player's choice) the user speeds a patient's own healing, paid from the patient's stamina. A new adult user closes cuts in a minute or two, stops a gash bleeding, knits a cracked bone over about an hour of contact. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: heals only as far as the patient can pay: the exhausted gain little and forcing more can kill, so each patient is judged first. At the start it cannot regrow limbs, cure illness or poison, or revive the dead. Needs skin contact; heals villain or hero alike; cannot heal the user. Quirk Strain: light: small wounds; moderate: steadying the wounded, knitting a bone, draining a target, purging a poison; heavy: holding the dying, grave wounds; severe: signature mass healing, restoring what the body cannot. Type: Emitter. Law: healing outside licensed hero work or a registered clinic is unlicensed Quirk use; police seldom charge a lifesaver. Look: a soft glow (player's color) at the touch.
abilities: Mending Touch
Ward Rounds

Mental Command Quirk.name: Mental Command Quirk
Mental Command Quirk.description:
🗣️ When someone answers you aloud, your voice takes hold of them.

🌱 At the start you hold one person at a time with simple commands until pain or a shock snaps them free, and you know what to say to draw a reply from someone on guard.
📈 With training: orders that outlast the hold, minds freed from panic or control, phone commands, several held at once, mind overload, a crowd, a person's skills and Quirk.
⚠️ Many call it a villain's Quirk and go silent once they know.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, as Strain demands a longer, clearer answer.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hitoshi Shinso (Brainwashing).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Deception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Spoken Tether, Loaded Question
Mental Command Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: anyone who answers the user aloud blanks and obeys short spoken commands (stop, sit, drop it), doing nothing on their own. A new adult user holds one person in earshot at a time, up to several minutes. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only a spoken reply counts (no nod or wordless scream); those who know the Quirk stay silent or cover their ears. Pain, a hard shake, a close loud noise or an order to hurt anyone breaks it. Held people move stiffly, lose fine skills and their own Quirk, and later recall only a haze; it reads no thoughts. Quirk Strain: light: hold, baited question; moderate: standing order, waking someone, speaking by phone; heavy: holding several, overloading a mind; severe: commanding a crowd, directing another's skills and Quirk. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed commanding is assault; nothing gained by command holds up in court; the Commission watches licensed users closely. Look: nothing on the user; held eyes go flat, faces slack.
abilities: Spoken Tether
Loaded Question

Suppression Quirk.name: Suppression Quirk
Suppression Quirk.description:
👁️ You switch off other people's Quirks by looking at them.

🌱 At the start you stop one person's Quirk in clear sight within about twenty meters while you stare unblinking, and read a Quirk's tell to cut it off before it fires.
📈 With training: flyers downed safely, crowds swept for hidden users, runaway Quirks shut off, a prisoner held all scene, sealed doorways, all Quirks in sight stilled.
⚠️ It stops powers, not people: you still capture by hand. Mutant features never switch off.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your eyes dry, burn and blur.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eraser Head (Erasure).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Quell Gaze, Cutoff Glance
Suppression Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user's look stops a person's Quirk: at first one person at a time, in clear sight within about twenty meters, about ten seconds without blinking; drying eyes shorten later looks until rested. Under it Emitter Quirks fail and transformations end; what the Quirk already made stays. More needs learned techniques. Limits: Mutant features never switch off, only what a Mutant body sends out. Screens do not carry the look; a blink, smoke, a flash or a blow to the user breaks it and the Quirk returns at once. A stopped foe keeps fists and weapons. Quirk Strain: light: single look, read tell; moderate: grounding a mover, crowd sweep, stopping a runaway Quirk; heavy: scene-long hold, watched doorway; severe: signature stare, a group held all scene. Type: Emitter. Law: switching off a Quirk without a license is unlawful Quirk use; police and agencies prize licensed users for arrests. Look: irises glow (player's color), showing the target unless goggles hide it.
abilities: Quell Gaze
Cutoff Glance

Copy Quirk.name: Copy Quirk
Copy Quirk.description:
🪞 You copy other people's Quirks by touch.

🌱 At the start bare skin contact lends you a person's Emitter or Transformation Quirk for a few minutes at a beginner's level, enough to turn it on its owner's attacks.
📈 With training: riding copied movement, tracking a Quirk to its owner, rescues beside the heroes you copy, several copies, a copy at full power, every copy fired in turn.
⚠️ You hold one copy at a time, without its owner's practice or stored power; Mutant features and Quirkless people give you nothing.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as copies run out early.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Neito Monoma (Copy).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Control +10, Insight +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Borrowed Touch, Like for Like
Copy Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: skin-to-skin touch copies a person's Quirk. New adult user: one copy at a time, about five minutes, at beginner level (basic effect, without the owner's practice or stored power); a new copy replaces the old; the owner keeps theirs. More needs techniques. Limits: no Mutant features or anything needing a body part the user lacks; Quirkless people give nothing; gloves and armor block the touch; copies lack the matching body (copied fire can burn the user's hands). Quirk Strain: light: taking a copy, answering its owner, plus the copy's usual cost; moderate: riding a copied movement, tracing an owner, shared rescue; heavy: several copies, opening one fully; severe: signature sequence, splicing two copies. Type: Emitter. Law: copying without consent is unlawful Quirk use; a copy used in a crime points police at its registered owner until they check for copiers. Look: a palm ring in the player's color flashes as a copy takes; then the Quirk shows as on its owner.
abilities: Borrowed Touch
Like for Like

Telepathy Quirk.name: Telepathy Quirk
Telepathy Quirk.description:
🧠 You send your thoughts into other people's minds.

🌱 At the start you speak into the heads of up to five people within about a hundred meters, through walls, smoke and noise, and feel the minds near you, even under rubble.
📈 With training: stunning static, shared sight, a team linked mind to mind, the trapped kept calm, surface thoughts read, all hostile minds struck, a district addressed.
⚠️ It works one way: you hear no answers and read no thoughts until training opens surface reading.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as reaching into other minds wears down your own.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mandalay (Telepath).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Control +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Mindcast, Mind Census
Telepathy Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user speaks into minds. A new adult user reaches up to five people they can see or have met within about a hundred meters, a few sentences at a time, in their voice; walls, smoke, noise and deafness do not stop it. They also feel minds within about thirty meters: how many, where, awake or not. Images and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: one way at the start: no replies, no thoughts read. Cannot move a body, plant a command or change a feeling; a message can be ignored, not unheard; the unconscious receive nothing. Quirk Strain: light: messages, sensing minds; moderate: mental spike, shared sight, team link; heavy: rescue link, reading a mind; severe: signature strike, district-wide link. Type: Emitter. Law: messaging strangers' minds without cause is harassment; reading a mind without consent is a serious crime and spoils any evidence; licensed users read minds only to save lives. Look: unfocused eyes; listeners feel pressure behind the eyes first.
abilities: Mindcast
Mind Census

Adhesive Quirk.name: Adhesive Quirk
Adhesive Quirk.description:
🕸️ Your body makes a strong adhesive, in strips of tape or sticky globs.

🌱 At the start you fire a strand or glob about ten meters to glue a hand, a foot or a weapon in place, and swing or haul yourself along lines that hold your weight.
📈 With training: harmless full-body wraps, people reeled from danger, catch-webs, plugged leaks and wounds, a glued street, a crowd bound in a pass, a building held up.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as the adhesive draws on what you eat and drink.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hanta Sero (Tape), Minoru Mineta (Pop Off).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tack Shot, Tapeline Swing
Adhesive Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes tape or sticky globs from the skin, usually palms or forearms. A new adult user fires a strand or glob about ten meters, with lines that hold their weight or another adult's; it sets at once, stays tacky about an hour, then dries and flakes off. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut it, fire and solvents loosen it, dust and oil stop it holding, a strong person tears free with hard effort. It sticks to friend and foe, never the user; it cannot cut or crush; never on faces, where it can suffocate. Quirk Strain: light: shot, swing; moderate: wrap, reel-in, web; heavy: plugging a breach, gluing a street; severe: signature pass, holding a building together. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed gluing of a person is unlawful restraint; adhesive left on roads, platforms or exits endangers the public. Look: glossy adhesive in the player's color; as a Mutant Quirk, a permanent feature (tacky palms, forearm dispensers).
abilities: Tack Shot
Tapeline Swing

Duplication Quirk.name: Duplication Quirk
Duplication Quirk.description:
👥 You make living doubles of yourself.

🌱 At the start you split off up to two doubles in about a second; they think, talk and fight as you do, wear copies of your clothes, and burst harmlessly when hit hard.
📈 With training: a guard double, a spare self working for hours, stacks over walls, hiding among yourselves, search crews, a pinned giant, a flooded street, doubled allies.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as every double is built from your own energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Twice (Double).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Splitting Image, Fall Guy
Duplication Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes self-acting doubles. At first: up to two at a time, each appearing within arm's reach in about a second, wearing copied clothes and gear; they share the user's body, skills and memories up to their making and follow the user's lead for the scene, about ten minutes at most. More needs learned techniques. Limits: doubles burst into a harmless puff when cut, burned or hit hard, and cannot use the Quirk. Copied gear is a dead shell that vanishes with them (phones, keys, weapons, money do nothing). The user feels where each bursts. Doubling anyone else needs a learned technique. Quirk Strain: light: a double or two, a guard; moderate: lasting spare, boost, crowd to hide in; heavy: rescue crew, dogpile; severe: signature swarm, doubling a team. Type: Emitter. Law: a double's acts are the user's own Quirk use and crimes; doubles faking an alibi or sitting exams are fraud. Look: doubles peel off and burst in a shimmer of the player's chosen color.
abilities: Splitting Image
Fall Guy

Disintegration Quirk.name: Disintegration Quirk
Disintegration Quirk.description:
✋ Whatever you grip with a full hand breaks down into dust.

🌱 At the start you crumble a weapon, a lock or a shield in a moment, and you can hold the decay to a thin line that cuts a trapped person free.
📈 With training: swung weapons dusted, floors crumbled under a gang, walks through walls, collapses lifted off the trapped, structures dropped exactly where you choose.
⚠️ On a living person it maims or kills, so every lawful use is on matter.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the decay creeps past where you meant it to stop.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tomura Shigaraki (Decay), Overhaul (Overhaul).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Demolition +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Crumbling Palm, Hairline Cut
Disintegration Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user breaks down nonliving matter under a full hand. A new adult user turns a pistol to grit in a moment, a door in seconds; decay spreads about a meter through joined matter. On a person it destroys gripped flesh; held past a moment it maims or kills; decay through ground or walls stops at living flesh. More needs techniques. Limits: bound or gloved hands, a broken grip or distance stop it; it cannot repair or undo; falling debris endangers those below. Quirk Strain: light: grip, narrow cut; moderate: dusting a weapon, crumbling a floor, walking through walls; heavy: clearing rubble, dropping part of a building; severe: signature, unmaking named things through a structure. Type: Emitter. Law: use on a person is charged as grievous assault or attempted murder, so licensed users work on matter only (breaching, demolition, rescue); police treat unlicensed users as armed. Look: often gloved; gray cracks race from the palm, matter hisses to dust.
abilities: Crumbling Palm
Hairline Cut

Compression Quirk.name: Compression Quirk
Compression Quirk.description:
🔮 You shrink what you touch into a small glassy sphere and restore it at will. It is a showman's Quirk.

🌱 At the start you palm a weapon, a crate or a motorcycle into a marble-sized sphere in an instant, and feel through your palm what a wall or a rubble pile hides.
📈 With training: people carried out sealed safely inside, stored walls dropped in place, pocket ladders, villains removed, gangs disarmed at once, a falling tower pocketed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as tracking every sphere wears on your mind.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mr. Compress (Compress).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Sleight of Hand +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Disappearing Prop, Palm Survey
Compression Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the palm shrinks what it touches into a marble-sized sphere (or a player-picked shape) and snaps it back within about ten meters. A new adult user takes up to a motorcycle's size in a second, carries a handful of weightless spheres, and feels the shape of what the palm touches. People and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: no touch, no compression; walls, floors and fixed doors stay put. It never harms its contents; a person inside feels no time pass and comes out unhurt on their own within minutes. A broken sphere frees what it holds. Quirk Strain: light: an object in or out, reading a volume; moderate: a willing person, ranged release, climbing released objects; heavy: a resister, disarming a group; severe: signature, touchless compression. Type: Emitter. Law: compressing a person without consent is abduction; hiding goods in spheres is smuggling; licensed users take people only to rescue or arrest. Look: a blurred miniature inside; release pops.
abilities: Disappearing Prop
Palm Survey

Barrier Quirk.name: Barrier Quirk
Barrier Quirk.description:
🛡️ You project flat, clear panels of force that stop what hits them.

🌱 At the start you snap a door-sized panel into an attack's path or slam it into an attacker, and hold a dome over yourself and the people beside you.
📈 With training: villains boxed in, falls caught on slanted panes, panel stairs, walls against crowds, floods or collapses, blasts turned aside, a dome over a city block.
⚠️ Every barrier shatters if it takes more than you can hold.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding a barrier burns your body's strength.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kosei Tsuburaba (Solid Air), Crust (Shield).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Evacuation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Stopgap Pane, Shelter Dome
Barrier Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: flat, clear force panels, or a curved dome, anywhere in sight within about five meters. A new adult user raises a door-sized panel in a blink, or a dome over themselves and two or three people, held while focused. It stops fists, blades, debris and handgun rounds; a speeding car or heavy Quirk blow shatters it. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: a new user's barriers stay put and cannot form inside an object or body, so never cut; heat, light and sound pass through; all vanish if the user is knocked out or suppressed. Quirk Strain: light: a panel; moderate: dome over a few people, cage, catching slope, stair; heavy: street-wide wall, deflecting an attack; severe: signature dome, shells around a crowd. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed walling people in or blocking roads or exits is unlawful confinement; whoever traps people in danger answers for what happens. Look: clear panes edged in the player's color, rippling when hit, bursting into flakes.
abilities: Stopgap Pane
Shelter Dome

Emotion Induction Quirk.name: Emotion Induction Quirk
Emotion Induction Quirk.description:
🎭 You push strong feelings onto the people around you.

🌱 At the start you make a single person double over laughing or flinch back in fear, and you sense the feelings of everyone nearby, even through a wall.
📈 With training: panicked crowds calmed to orderly exits, dread in a gang, crowds parted silently, villains baited onto you, a laughing street, a crippling feeling lifted.
⚠️ It works on feelings, never thoughts, and people fear what it could do to them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the feeling you push spills onto everyone near you.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ms. Joke (Outburst).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Insight +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Heart Jolt, Mood Sweep
Emotion Induction Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user pushes raw feelings onto people nearby: at first laughter, calm or fear onto one or a few within about ten meters, and senses strong feelings through walls. A push lasts seconds to a minute and colors behavior, but never gives orders or plants thoughts. Other feelings and more need learned techniques. Limits: a strong will, training or a stronger ruling feeling blunts a push. It cannot read thoughts, change memories, create love or trust, or make anyone betray what they hold dearest. Quirk Strain: light: push, reading the room; moderate: calming or parting a crowd, wall of dread; heavy: goading rage, setting an area laughing; severe: signature flood, lifting a feeling out of someone. Type: Emitter. Law: pushing feelings without consent counts as mind control and voids deals or confessions under it; licensed users announce themselves and only calm, rally or subdue. Look: a fixed, focused stare (or faint eye glow, player's choice); nearby faces change.
abilities: Heart Jolt
Mood Sweep

Fiber Quirk.name: Fiber Quirk
Fiber Quirk.description:
🧵 You move fibers: thread, cloth, rope, carpet and anything woven.

🌱 At the start you pull a person's own sleeves or pant legs tight to bind them, and feel through fabric where people are and what they carry.
📈 With training: people hauled by their clothes, curtain nets, rope swings, woven armor unpicked, cloth roofs over a street, every foe in sight held, armored clothing.
⚠️ Where nobody wears fabric, it has little to grip.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, since you must see or touch the fabric you move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Best Jeanist (Fiber Master).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sleeve Lock, Weave Sense
Fiber Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user moves fibers touched or seen within about ten meters: thread, cloth, rope, felt, carpet. A new adult user grips clothing with a firm hand's strength (enough to pin arms or lock legs), spins cloth into a line that holds an adult, and feels through fabric where it is worn or weighted. More needs techniques. Limits: never hair, skin, wire, leather or rubber, so swimwear or hard armor gives little hold; blades cut threads, fire burns them, strong people tear free; cloth tight at the throat can choke, so trained users never bind there. Quirk Strain: light: binding a person, reading cloth; moderate: hauling someone clear, net, swing line; heavy: unweaving a room's woven guards, weaving a canopy; severe: signature hold, hardening a crowd's clothing. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding by clothing is unlawful restraint; police treat use to rob or trap as assault. Look: cloth ripples and tightens, threads twist in the air, fingers twitch with each pull.
abilities: Sleeve Lock
Weave Sense

Blood Quirk.name: Blood Quirk
Blood Quirk.description:
🩸 You control your own blood once it leaves your body, moving it as liquid or hardening it at will.

🌱 At the start you work about a cupful at a time within a few meters: needles flicked from a nicked fingertip, a rope that hardens around someone's wrists.
📈 With training: sealed wounds, a marking drop you follow across the city, blood cables to swing on, a bullet-stopping shell, and spilled blood called back.
⚠️ Dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood slips out of your control.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as iron and fluids run low.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Vlad King (Blood Control), Stain (Bloodcurdle).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Scarlet Quills, Garnet Cuffs
Blood Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user moves their own blood once it leaves the body through small cuts (lancet or existing wound). A new adult user works about a cupful at a time within about five meters and hardens it instantly; hardened blood holds until broken or released. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood leaves their control; heavy blows break hardened blood. Never anyone else's blood; bound hands that cannot cut stop it. Quirk Strain: light: needles, cuff; moderate: wound seal, tracking drop, lifeline; heavy: shell over people, thorned lash; severe: signature, calling spilled blood back. Type: Emitter. Law: blood used on a person unlicensed is assault with a weapon; blood left at a scene is evidence police can match to the user. Look: healed fingertip nicks; dark red threads leave the cuts, defy gravity, harden glossy and smell of iron.
abilities: Scarlet Quills
Garnet Cuffs

Animal Voice Quirk.name: Animal Voice Quirk
Animal Voice Quirk.description:
🐾 Animals understand you, and you understand them: a crow tells of shiny things and shouting, a cat of a stranger's smell.

🌱 At the start any animal within shouting distance grasps simple requests and answers in its own terms. Ask an animal a favor, or ask strays what they saw.
📈 With training you calm a dog mid-attack, send crows to scout, follow alley cats along hidden routes, find trapped survivors and call a district's animals to you.
⚠️ Animals are not soldiers: they refuse real danger and never fight to the death for you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as animal voices crowd your hearing.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Koji Koda (Anivoice).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Animal Handling +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Friendly Ask, Street Witnesses
Animal Voice Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user speaks so animals understand and hears what they mean. A new adult user reaches any animal within about fifty meters, talks to a few at once and makes simple requests (come, follow, look, fetch, warn me). Answers come in smells, sizes, colors, noise and fear, never names or written words. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: it asks, not commands. Animals refuse fire, gunfire and fights, flee when hurt, forget long tasks; police dogs obey handlers first; insects grasp only gather and scatter. Never on people: animal-featured heteromorphs hear plain speech; treating them as animals insults them. Quirk Strain: light: talk, asking what they saw; moderate: calming, sending scouts, an alley guide; heavy: rubble search, setting a flock on people; severe: signature call, district-wide watch. Type: Emitter. Law: a crime done through an animal is the user's; sending animals into harm brings animal-welfare charges. Look: strays drift closer; low clicking hum.
abilities: Friendly Ask
Street Witnesses

Hardening Quirk.name: Hardening Quirk
Hardening Quirk.description:
🗿 You harden your skin into rough, ridged armor at will.

🌱 At the start your whole body hardens in an instant: fists, knives, bats and falling debris stop at your skin, and your hardened fists dent a car door.
📈 With training: diving over people in danger, breaking walls, dropping through floors to the trapped, holding up a ceiling, armor-cracking blows, a past-your-limit strike.
⚠️ It stops cuts and blows, not heat, cold, electricity, gas or sound.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as the hardening softens sooner the harder you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening), Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Steel).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Crag Knuckle, Stone Skin
🛡️ Resists: bludgeoning, slashing, piercing
Hardening Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: skin hardens rough and ridged, one limb or the whole body, instantly. A new adult user shrugs off fists, knives, bats and a fall of a story or two, and dents a car door; a pistol round only chips it and bruises. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: stops cuts and blows, not heat, cold, electricity, gas or sound; a rifle round, a speeding car or a full-power strength Quirk cracks it. Hardened, the user is heavy, sinks and loses fine touch; ridges cut anyone they grab. Quirk Strain: light: one limb, quick full-body flash; moderate: charge, covering a person, hardened drop; heavy: bracing a collapse, armor-breaking flurry; severe: signature move, sheltering a crowd all scene. Type: Transformation. Law: hardening in self-defense is lawful, but a ridged fist outside licensed work is assault, its cuts hard to deny. Look: skin turns gray (or player's color), ridges jut from arms, shoulders and face, the body grinds.
abilities: Crag Knuckle
Stone Skin

Size Change Quirk.name: Size Change Quirk
Size Change Quirk.description:
📏 You grow your body or parts of it far past normal size.

🌱 At the start your hands, forearms or feet swell to car-door size in a second, enough to swat a person flat, hold someone in a palm or shelter people under a cupped hand.
📈 With training: double height, a block in a few strides, apartment-building height for a minute, stomps that topple enemies, a falling bus caught with all inside unhurt.
⚠️ Growth adds strength, not toughness, and you pay for what giant steps break.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as extra mass burns your energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mount Lady (Gigantification), Itsuka Kendo (Big Fist).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Athletics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Outsize Swat, Palm Shelter
Size Change Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user grows their own body or parts of it, gaining strength and weight in proportion. A new adult user swells hands, forearms or feet to about car-door size in a second, holding several minutes; whole-body growth needs techniques, and giant height lasts about a minute at first. Limits: strength, not toughness: bullets and blades still wound a bigger target. No shrinking below normal; nothing grows but the user's body. Grown hands fumble fine work; a grown body cannot fit through doors, cracks floors and roads, and can crush people with a careless step. Quirk Strain: light: hands or feet; moderate: grip, doubled height, long stride; heavy: apartment-building height, giant stomp; severe: signature drop, careful giant rescue. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed public growth is an offense; every car, pipe and window a giant form breaks goes on the user's record and bill. Look: limb or body swells smoothly in a second, features unchanged, ground creaking.
abilities: Outsize Swat
Palm Shelter

Beast Form Quirk.name: Beast Form Quirk
Beast Form Quirk.description:
🐻 You change into a great beast you choose: a bear, a big cat, a wolf, a boar or a dragon.

🌱 At the start claws come in an instant and the full form in seconds: the size of a large bear, strong enough to push a car aside, with senses far past any person's.
📈 With training: tracking by scent, pinning a villain under your weight, bounding up buildings with people, sheltering people under you, a freezing roar, house size.
⚠️ Pain, fear and anger pull you toward instinct.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the beast pushes back under stress.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ryukyu (Dragon), Jurota Shishida (Beast).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Intimidation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Raking Paw, Full Shift
Beast Form Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user changes into one beast form picked at creation (bear, big cat, wolf, boar, dragon) and back. At first: claws at once, full form in seconds, about large-bear size, pushes a car aside, tracks a fresh scent across several blocks, held about ten minutes; wings only glide. More needs learned techniques. Limits: the hide turns fists and knives, not bullets. The form cannot use tools, fit through doors or say more than a few rough words; strong smells and loud noise overwhelm it. Pain, fear and rage pull the user toward instinct; clothes tear. Quirk Strain: light: claws, sharper senses; moderate: full form, tracking, a pounce, a climb; heavy: sheltering people, a roar, a long fight; severe: the rampage, the greater form. Type: Transformation. Law: the full form in public draws police at once; an unlicensed claw or bite wound counts as assault with a weapon. Look: the body swells under fur, scales or hide, face to muzzle; eye and hair colors carry over.
abilities: Raking Paw
Full Shift

Body Blades Quirk.name: Body Blades Quirk
Body Blades Quirk.description:
🗡️ You grow blades from your own skin.

🌱 At the start a curved edge about thirty centimeters long slides from your forearms, shins or knuckles in under a second, cutting rope, cloth, wood and plastic.
✂️ It frees a tied-up person in a single stroke, and you strike with the flat when you hold back.
📈 With training: caught weapons, people pinned by their clothes, blade-spur climbs, people cut from wrecks, cleaved armor, a bloom of edges, a room disarmed bloodlessly.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as every blade tears its way out through your skin.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Togaru Kamakiri (Blades).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Melee Weapons +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Crescent Draw, Freeing Cut
🛡️ Resists: slashing
Body Blades Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user grows bone-hard blades through the skin of forearms, shins, knuckles and elbows. A new adult user extends an edge of about thirty centimeters in under a second and holds it at will; it cuts rope, cloth, plastic and wood but only scratches steel. More needs techniques. Limits: reach is arm's length plus the blade; blades cannot be thrown or stop bullets. A heavy blow or twisting grip snaps a blade, which bleeds and regrows in about a minute; a grapple on the arms shuts them down. Every edge cuts, so holding back means striking with the flat. Quirk Strain: light: a cut, freeing someone; moderate: block, pin, spur climb; heavy: carving a wreck, cleaving armor; severe: signature bloom, a room of precise cuts. Type: Transformation. Law: blades count as a drawn weapon: unlicensed public use brings police; a cut on a person is an armed attack. Look: curved blades, bone-white or the player's color, slide out with a dry scrape, tearing unslit sleeves.
abilities: Crescent Draw
Freeing Cut

Mimicry Quirk.name: Mimicry Quirk
Mimicry Quirk.description:
👤 You take another person's appearance from a hair or a few drops of their blood.

🌱 At the start you change in a few seconds, matching face, build and voice, and hold the form about ten minutes per hair or drop; your clothes stay your own.
📈 With training: stand-ins for people in danger, fooled scanners, a trusted face for the scared, slipped cuffs, a day as someone else, face flickers, a gang boss replaced.
⚖️ Wearing a face without its owner's consent is a crime.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as each form slips sooner the harder you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Himiko Toga (Transform).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Disguise +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Quick-Change Fade, Stand-In Double
Mimicry Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: from a hair or a few drops of blood, a new adult user takes the person's face, build, voice and height (within a head either way) in about three seconds. A hair or drop lasts about ten minutes, a vial of blood about an hour; one form at a time; samples spoil in a day unless chilled. Limits: clothes and gear never change. No copied Quirk, memories or skills; copied wings do not fly. Blood and scent stay the user's own, so a blood test, tracking dog or personal question exposes them; a hard hit briefly slips features back. Quirk Strain: light: quick change; moderate: form held under attack, partial change, ambush, leading people; heavy: smaller form, day-long cover; severe: signature carousel, a leader's place. Type: Transformation. Law: wearing someone's face without consent is impersonation and fraud; taking blood or hair by force is assault; heroes need consent or an authorized undercover operation. Look: a ripple spreads from the face; bones click softly.
abilities: Quick-Change Fade
Stand-In Double

Strength Boost Quirk.name: Strength Boost Quirk
Strength Boost Quirk.description:
💪 Your muscles swell on command for bursts of strength far past human.

🌱 At the start a boost lasts about a minute: lift about a ton, punch through a cinder-block wall, throw an adult several meters, hold a fallen beam off a trapped person.
📈 With training: steel doors torn open, crushing holds, rooftop leaps, a collapsing ceiling held up, a speeding truck stopped and, at your peak, an overpass lifted.
⚠️ Swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people.
🔗 Common drawback pairings: Stamina Drain or Finite Fuel, as each boost burns your energy or the fuel you carry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Rikido Sato (Sugar Rush), Muscular (Muscle Augmentation).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Athletics +5, Stamina +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Sledge Blow, Rubble Lift
Strength Boost Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: muscles swell on command for strength far past human. A new adult user bulks up in about a second and, for about a minute per boost, lifts about a ton, punches through a cinder-block wall and throws an adult several meters. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: strength, not toughness: punching steel still breaks knuckles; blades and bullets cut as deep. No added speed; swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people. Range and an early grapple counter it. Quirk Strain: light: boosted blow; moderate: lift, breach, hold, leap; heavy: holding up a structure, stopping a vehicle; severe: signature blow, lifting an overpass. Type: Transformation. Law: a boosted punch can kill, so police treat an unlicensed user who bulks up in a fight as armed; every injury is judged by the force chosen. Look: the chosen build; in use, arms, shoulders and back swell, veins stand out, sleeves split.
abilities: Sledge Blow
Rubble Lift

Speed Boost Quirk.name: Speed Boost Quirk
Speed Boost Quirk.description:
💨 You speed up your own body: legs, arms and reflexes.

🌱 At the start you match city traffic for a few seconds per burst, throw several punches in the time of one and react to a thrown punch before it lands.
📈 With training: weapons snatched in passing, people carried from harm, wall and water runs, a smoky stairwell cleared, a group struck at once, a falling building emptied.
⚠️ Stopping takes about ten meters.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as friction and effort build heat in your body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kendo Rappa (Strongarm) for rapid fists; hyper-speed Quirks also turn up among working pros.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Output +10, Running +5, Stamina +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Snap Sprint, Drumroll Barrage
Speed Boost Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user speeds up their own legs, arms, nerves and reflexes. At first: about sixty kilometers an hour for a few seconds per burst, several punches in the time of one, reacting to a thrown punch. More, and clean stops, need learned techniques. Limits: at full speed braking takes about ten meters and a sharp turn throws them off their feet. Senses lag behind legs, so crowds, stairs, wet floors and darkness cause crashes. Speed adds no weight to a blow except at a run, cannot outrun bullets and gives no flight; friction burns through ordinary soles. Quirk Strain: light: dash, burst of punches; moderate: snatch, rescue carry, wall or water run; heavy: clearing smoke, striking a group; severe: signature strike, emptying a building. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed racing through crowds or traffic is reckless endangerment; an injuring high-speed collision is charged as assault. Look: a blur; dust and paper whip up behind; hard starts crack the air.
abilities: Snap Sprint
Drumroll Barrage

Phasing Quirk.name: Phasing Quirk
Phasing Quirk.description:
👻 You turn intangible, along with whatever you wear and carry.

🌱 At the start you phase for as long as you can hold a breath: blows, blades and bullets pass through you, and you walk through about a meter of wall.
📈 With training: peeks through walls, counters from inside a guard, rubble searched from within, people carried through walls, reeling foes, a runaway truck phased past.
⚠️ While phased you cannot see, hear or breathe, and you sink through floors if you lose focus.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as sight and sound slam back when you turn solid.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mirio Togata (Permeation).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Hollow Guard, Wallwalk
Phasing Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user turns intangible with all they wear and carry. New adult user: phased for a held breath, through about a meter of wall; blows, blades, bullets and blasts pass through. Partial phasing and phasing others need techniques. Limits: fully phased, the user cannot see, hear or breathe and moves from memory; losing focus sinks them through the floor. They must turn solid to strike or grab, and enemies wait for that instant; the Quirk shoves them out of matter before they solidify; mind-affecting Quirks still reach them. Quirk Strain: light: letting an attack through; moderate: wall walk, peek, counter, rubble search; heavy: carrying someone, running through enemies; severe: signature strike, phasing a vehicle or slab. Type: Transformation. Law: phasing into a home or vault without a license or warrant is burglary; police suspect registered phasers first after locked-room break-ins. Look: skin ripples, outline faintly translucent.
abilities: Hollow Guard
Wallwalk

Impact Absorption Quirk.name: Impact Absorption Quirk
Impact Absorption Quirk.description:
🥊 Your body soaks up impacts and stores their force.

🌱 At the start you go soft as a blow lands, taking a punch, a bat swing or a fall from a second-floor window unhurt, then send what you stored back out in one hard blow.
📈 With training: people shielded, a swallowed arm, rooftop bounces, knives and bullets stopped, a room knocked flat, a fight's force returned, a truck stopped.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding the soft state burns through your body's reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fat Gum (Fat Absorption).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Sinking Guard, Payback Blow
🛡️ Resists: bludgeoning
Impact Absorption Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: while active, the body turns soft and dense; a blow that sinks in is stored as force, not felt. A new adult user takes a strong adult's punch, a bat swing or a second-floor fall unhurt, holds it about a minute, releasing it in one contact blow. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only blunt force sinks in; blades and bullets still cut at the start; heat, cold, electricity, sound and gas pass through. Grabs, chokes and unseen blows get no help. Stored force cannot be split or thrown; no sprinting or dodging while soft. A growing flush and tremor warn sharp foes the user is loaded. Quirk Strain: light: soak or release a blow; moderate: shield people, hold an attacker, rebound; heavy: catch blades and bullets, shake the ground; severe: signature release, stopping a vehicle dead. Type: Transformation. Law: soaking blows is self-defense; unlicensed release of stored force into a person is assault. Look: the body thickens by half; struck spots dent and refill.
abilities: Sinking Guard
Payback Blow

Trait Manifestation Quirk.name: Trait Manifestation Quirk
Trait Manifestation Quirk.description:
🦀 Your body grows the features of what you have eaten. What you ate today decides your toolkit.

🌱 At the start you turn a hand into a crab's claw, stretch fingers into octopus tentacles, or grow another feature from recent meals, one limb in size, for a few minutes.
📈 With training: a shell for you and someone you hold, wings, squid ink, horns through a wall, a steel-shearing claw, all meals in one form, a crowd caught on tentacles.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as each feature burns the meal it came from.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tamaki Amajiki (Manifest).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Cooking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Pincer Snap, Suckerline Reach
Trait Manifestation Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user grows features of animals, fish, shellfish and plants eaten within about a day: claws, shells, tentacles, wings, horns, ink sacs. A new adult user grows one at a time, sized to one body part (forearm-sized claw, tentacles about two meters, wings that glide but cannot climb), holds it a few minutes and switches in a breath. Bigger feats need techniques. If meals were never stated, assume shrimp and squid. Limits: no meal, no feature; hard use burns a meal within the hour. Features keep their creature's weaknesses (shells crack, tentacles tear). It never copies a Quirk and draws nothing from people. Quirk Strain: light: one small feature; moderate: shell, wings, ink, whole limb; heavy: horns, giant claw; severe: every meal at once, dozens of tentacles. Type: Transformation. Law: a grown claw or horn is Quirk use; using one on a person unlicensed is assault. Look: a part reshapes in a second into the creature's real color and texture, tearing sleeves.
abilities: Pincer Snap
Suckerline Reach

Animal Heteromorph Quirk.name: Animal Heteromorph Quirk
Animal Heteromorph Quirk.description:
🐸 Your body carries the traits of an animal you choose: a frog, a rabbit, a dog, a cat, a lizard or another creature.

🌱 From the start you have its way of moving, its sharpest sense and its natural weapons: claws, teeth, kicks or a tail.
📈 With training: sheer walls climbed with someone on your back, ambushes felt early, people snatched from danger, a room bounced around and struck, every heartbeat nearby.
⚠️ The features are permanent and visible.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as senses this sharp punish noise and stench.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tsuyu Asui (Frog), Mirko (Rabbit), Hound Dog (Dog).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Endurance +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Perception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Leaping Lunge, Keen Read
Animal Heteromorph Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user's body carries one player-chosen animal's senses, movement and natural weapons at human size. New adult users: rabbit or frog legs clear a story per bound; a cat lands on its feet from a second floor; gecko hands cling to walls; the keenest sense matches the animal (a dog's nose trails fresh scent a few blocks). Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only what the animal's body could do; never flight, gills or venom. Weaknesses too: cold slows cold-blooded bodies, keen noses and ears suffer stench and noise, leapers wrestle poorly. Quirk Strain: none for living in the body; light: bound, sense reading; moderate: wall running, instinct, snatch; heavy: full-strength blow, rampage; severe: signature pounce, sensing a whole block. Type: Mutant. Law: features are legal; unlicensed clawing, biting or kicking a person is assault; the user meets open heteromorph prejudice. Look: permanent animal ears, tail, fur or scales, eyes, feet, claws, player's pick.
abilities: Leaping Lunge
Keen Read

Wings Quirk.name: Wings Quirk
Wings Quirk.description:
🦅 You have real wings on your back, feathered unless you choose leathery or insect wings.

🌱 At the start you take off onto rooftops and across rivers, glide down from any height, and beat a gust that pushes people back and clears smoke.
📈 With training: people carried out, scenes read from above, diving strikes, steered feathers, a group sheltered, a street swept in one pass, a burning tower cleared.
⚠️ Rain, wind and low ceilings ground you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as hard flying tears at the muscles of your back.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hawks (Fierce Wings).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Snap Takeoff, Wingbeat Gust
Wings Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: wings about twice the user's height tip to tip, feathered unless the player chose leathery or insect. At first: a few blocks at a time at about a car's town speed, a rooftop in seconds, gliding down from any height; carrying an adult or long flight needs a learned technique. Limits: indoors, in alleys or under low ceilings, hops and glides only. Rain, wind and cold slow or ground them; a hurt, netted or grabbed wing downs them. Only feathered wings shed and steer feathers, by technique; a suppressing stare drops steered feathers, never the wings. Quirk Strain: wings themselves cost nothing; light: takeoff, gust; moderate: carry, overwatch, dive; heavy: steering feathers, sheltering people; severe: signature pass, clearing a burning tower. Type: Mutant. Law: wings break no law, but unlicensed public flight is unlawful Quirk use and diving on a person is assault. Look: permanent wings of the player's chosen kind and color, folded through shirt slits.
abilities: Snap Takeoff
Wingbeat Gust

Aquatic Quirk.name: Aquatic Quirk
Aquatic Quirk.description:
🐟 Your body is built for water: gills, fins, webbed hands and feet or slick skin, as you choose.

🌱 At the start you breathe underwater, outswim any athlete, hold a breath through smoke and gas on land, and rush through water to a target or a drowning swimmer.
📈 With training: sonar in murky water, groups towed from floods, any grip slipped, tail and body slams, boats stopped dead, breaches onto a target, rescues held underwater.
⚠️ Dry air and heat wear on you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as exertion out of water heats and dries your body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Gang Orca (Orca), Tsuyu Asui (Frog).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Swimming +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Slipstream Dash, Deepwater Breath
Aquatic Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a body built for water: gills, fins, webbed hands and feet or slick skin (player's choice). New adult user: breathes underwater, swims several times faster than a human champion, dives to about thirty meters, sees in murky water and holds a breath on land for minutes. More needs techniques. Limits: ordinary pace on land; dry air and heat dry skin and gills: hours from water tire them until wet again; hot rooms exhaust them; they move through water, never move it; polluted water harms them as anyone. Quirk Strain: living in the body costs nothing; light: dash, held breath; moderate: sonar, towing, slipping a hold; heavy: body slam, ramming a vessel; severe: signature breach, whole-district rescue. Type: Mutant. Law: the features break no law, but holding a person under water is attempted murder, whatever the intent. Look: permanent: gill slits on neck or ribs, fins on forearms, back, calves or a tail, webbed digits, smooth damp skin in the player's colors.
abilities: Slipstream Dash
Deepwater Breath

Extra Limbs Quirk.name: Extra Limbs Quirk
Extra Limbs Quirk.description:
🐙 You were born with extra limbs: a second pair of arms, tentacles from your back or shoulders, or long prehensile limbs.

🌱 Each starts about as strong as an ordinary arm: climb, carry and fight with all at once, strike from angles one guard cannot cover, and pin a person with your hands free.
📈 With training: several injured carried, an eye or ear budded at a limb tip, sprints up walls, a falling ceiling held, a group seized, limbs split among separate tasks.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as muscle tears where the limbs join.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mezo Shoji (Dupli-Arms).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Endurance +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Grappling +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Crossing Blows, Many-Handed Bind
Extra Limbs Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: born with extra limbs of the player's choice: a second pair of arms, up to about four back or shoulder tentacles, or long prehensile limbs. Each has an adult arm's strength; together they lift about two adults' weight, hands left free. Larger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut and blows break them, and each is one more thing to grab or pin. They cannot stretch, detach or regrow; grips slip past a few holds at once. Always visible unless covered; strangers stare; clothes and costumes need custom work. Quirk Strain: none for daily use; light: multi-limb strike, bind; moderate: group carry, budded organ, fast climb; heavy: bracing a structure, seizing a group; severe: signature move, splitting limbs among tasks. Type: Mutant. Law: striking, pinning or carrying off a person with the limbs unlicensed is assault or unlawful restraint outside self-defense. Look: limbs move independently; trained users bud a working eye, ear or mouth at a limb tip.
abilities: Crossing Blows
Many-Handed Bind

Enhanced Senses Quirk.name: Enhanced Senses Quirk
Enhanced Senses Quirk.description:
👂 Your hearing, smell or sight works far past human range, with organs to match: big ears, a long nose, wide eyes, whiskers or antennae.

🌱 At the start you hear a whisper through a wall, follow a trail hours old or read a face half a kilometer away, and single out a person in a crowd.
📈 With training: early warning of attacks, hidden enemies called out, blind runs through smoke, every buried survivor found, disguises seen through, district-wide tracking.
⚠️ Loud noise always hurts you more.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as pushed senses flood the brain.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kyoka Jiro (Earphone Jack), Hound Dog (Dog).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Control +10, Perception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Trail Reader, Pulse in the Crowd
💢 Weak to: sonic
Enhanced Senses Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: superhuman hearing, smell and/or sight in player-chosen organs. A new adult user hears a whisper through a wall, follows a few-hours-old scent a few kilometers, or reads a face half a kilometer off and sees in near darkness. More needs techniques. Limits: no mind reading: a racing pulse shows stress, not a lie. Sirens, flashes, pepper, smoke and perfume swamp matching senses; rain and vehicles break a trail; soundproofing blocks hearing. Sound attacks always hurt them more; bystanders assume they're overheard. Quirk Strain: everyday sensing free; light: trail, singling someone out; moderate: sensing an attack, calling out hidden foes, blind run; heavy: disaster-site sweep, unmasking disguises; severe: signature read, district-wide hunt. Type: Mutant. Law: spying into homes is a privacy crime; courts treat what they sensed as testimony, not proof. Look: permanent big or animal ears, long nose, big or extra eyes, whiskers or antennae that swivel, flare, widen.
abilities: Trail Reader
Pulse in the Crowd

Invisibility Quirk.name: Invisibility Quirk
Invisibility Quirk.description:
🫥 Your body is invisible all the time: skin, hair, eyes and nails.

🌱 At the start you bend light around a gloved fist for an unseen blow and slip out of people's notice by standing still.
📈 With training: light flashed into a foe's eyes, every camera in a building mapped, unseen sprints, a person you hold hidden, bonds burned through, a whole group hidden.
⚠️ Clothes and carried things still show, so you must shed them to vanish fully, and you still make noise, leave footprints and have a scent.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as pushed light flickers your outline into view.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Toru Hagakure (Invisibility).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Stealth +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Empty-Air Strike, Out of Mind
Invisibility Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the whole body is permanently invisible (skin, hair, eyes, nails); they see normally and cast no shadow. Clothes and held things stay visible, so full stealth means nothing worn or carried. At first: bending light around a gloved hand for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: footsteps, breath, scent and prints in dust or rain give them away; thermal cameras find them. Light tricks fail in darkness; erasure never reveals the body but stops light tricks. People forget the user is there. Quirk Strain: none to be invisible; light: unseen blow, fading from notice; moderate: dazzle, sight-line survey, vanishing sprint; heavy: hiding a held person, burning point; severe: signature burst, hiding a group. Type: Mutant. Law: sneaking into homes or changing rooms is trespass or voyeurism; an unlicensed strike from hiding is assault. Look: visible clothes on an unseen form (portraits: outfit only); light tricks: faint warp, then bright point or flash.
abilities: Empty-Air Strike
Out of Mind

Propulsion Quirk.name: Propulsion Quirk
Propulsion Quirk.description:
⚙️ Your body has built-in engines: exhaust ports in your calves, or thrusters in your forearms or back if you prefer.

🌱 At the start they drive you at about the speed of a car on a city street for about a minute at a time, and kick hard enough to dent a car door.
📈 With training: a ring of foes swept down, the injured shuttled from fires, wall runs, a speeding car beaten to the person in its path, walls rammed, a runaway bus caught.
⚠️ The engines are loud and hot, and they cannot make you fly.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cooldown, as a pushed engine stalls and must reset.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tenya Iida (Engine).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Output +10, Running +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Piston Kick, Throttle Dash
Propulsion Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: body engines vent through calf ports, or forearm or back thrusters (player's choice). A new adult user runs at about city-car speed for about a minute before the engines ease off; kicks dent a car door. More needs techniques. Limits: no flying or hovering. Speed makes turns wide and stops long; mud and deep water choke the ports; a blocked port or a firm grip on the limb stalls that engine. Loud, hot engines rule out sneaking while running them. Quirk Strain: none for walking and ordinary running; light: boosted kick, dash; moderate: spinning sweep, rescue shuttle, wall sprint; heavy: last-second save, ram through a wall; severe: signature kick, stopping a runaway vehicle. Type: Mutant. Law: unlicensed engine-speed running on public streets breaks Quirk law; a collision at that speed is also a traffic crime. Look: permanent ports, pipes or fins that tick as they cool and need clothing openings; in use they roar, vents glow red, heat shimmers.
abilities: Piston Kick
Throttle Dash

Regeneration Quirk.name: Regeneration Quirk
Regeneration Quirk.description:
🩹 Your body heals itself fast: cuts close in minutes and a broken bone knits in hours.

🌱 At the start you can also force fresh wounds shut mid-fight and take a blow on purpose to land your own.
📈 With training: blades caught barehanded, poison purged, long falls landed, people pulled from fire, others shielded, marches through anything, a lost limb regrown.
⚠️ You feel every wound, and lost limbs do not grow back yet.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as healing burns your reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Super Regeneration.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Control +10, Conditioning +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Accepted Blow, Knit Shut
Regeneration Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: fast self-repair. For a new adult user, cuts close in minutes, bruises fade in an hour, broken bones knit in a few hours, all scarless. Faster healing needs techniques. Limits: not instant: a heavy blow still drops the user, pain arrives in full, a fatal wound is still fatal. At the start lost limbs and eyes do not regrow; a blade left in a wound keeps it open; an unset bone knits crooked. Heals only the user. Quirk Strain: none at normal pace; light: taking a blow on purpose; moderate: closing wounds mid-fight, catching a blade, purging a poison, a long fall; heavy: walking through fire, shielding others; severe: signature advance, rebuilding the whole body. Type: Mutant. Law: attackers are still charged for wounds the user healed; unlicensed fighting is still illegal Quirk use. Look: runs warm, eats hugely; wounds close in threads of tissue, bones click into line, skin steams.
abilities: Accepted Blow
Knit Shut

U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).name: U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A)
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).description:
🦸 You are an extra student in U.A.'s Class 1-A, the most watched hero class in Japan, training for your hero license.

🏫 Your homeroom teacher is Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), who expels any student he judges to have no potential. You live in the Heights Alliance dorms from day one.
⚖️ No license yet: Quirk use is legal only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders during workplace experience, or in self-defense.
🤝 Twenty canon classmates, rival Class 1-B, the press, scouting agencies and villains who single 1-A out all keep an eye on you.
⚠️ A Quirkless student in this class passed the entrance exam on skill and nerve, and draws extra doubt.
🔓 Learnable later: Villain's-Eye Plan, Goal-Line Gambit.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Search and Rescue +10, Combat Tactics +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting technique: Rescue Clutch
🎒 Starts with: U.A. school uniform, U.A. gym uniform, U.A. student ID, Course textbooks, ¥10,000, School bag, Casual clothes
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: adult first-year, U.A. Hero Course Class 1-A, an extra beside the 20 canon classmates (none replaced). No license: Quirk use only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders in workplace experience, or in self-defense; off campus, civilian law until the Provisional License Exam at summer's end. A Quirkless student passed on skill and nerve, and draws extra doubt.
Access: campus, gyms, mock-city grounds, costume lockers, Recovery Girl's infirmary, Power Loader's Studio.
Obligations: classes, training, exams, Quirk rules; homeroom: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), whose stare erases Quirks and who expels anyone he judges to have no potential, with surprise tests; Heights Alliance dorms from day one (curfew, sign-outs).
Who notices: teachers, classmates, rival 1-B (Vlad King's, out to beat 1-A), press and scouts, villains targeting 1-A.
Standing pressures: All Might teaches them (his first teaching year); the Sports Festival is televised nationally.
abilities: Rescue Clutch

U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B).name: U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B)
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B).description:
