Quirk Awakening.description: Your Quirk has awakened: pushed past every limit, it changed in scale and reach and stayed that way. It unlocks two Awakened techniques for your Quirk family, which still need high Quirk skill (and level 30 for the second). Grants: Quirk Control +5, Quirk Output +5, Quirk Stamina +5. As a level-up pick it requires Quirk Breakthrough and level 24; the story can also grant it in a life-or-death moment. Not available to Quirkless characters.
Quirk Awakening.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's Quirk has awakened, the rare change researchers call a Quirk awakening: driven past every limit it had, it grew in scale and reach and kept that growth. Mark the moment with a scene in which the Quirk does its own work on a scale nobody has seen from this character, and show what it costs them. From then on the larger scale is theirs, but heavy: Awakened techniques cost severe Strain, the Drawback bites harder at full output, and holding the new scale back takes practice. Limits: the Quirk keeps its nature and family and gains no new kind of power. Teachers, the Hero Public Safety Commission, the press and villains take serious interest; the character's Quirk registration must be updated, and some will want to study, sponsor or recruit them. If the character chose Quirkless, this trait does not apply: they have no Quirk to awaken.

Licensed Pro Hero.name: Licensed Pro Hero
Licensed Pro Hero.description:
🏢 You run your own small hero agency on Musutafu's Hero Agency Row: your hero name on the door, one sidekick and a ranking to climb.

⚖️ Fully licensed from the first scene. You may patrol, arrest villains, hire sidekicks and supervise hero students on workplace experience.
⚠️ Rent is due every month, and property damage or excessive force brings complaints, lawsuits and lost sponsors that your agency pays for.
🤝 Your sidekick, rival agencies on the same street (Death Arms, Backdraft, Gunhead, Fourth Kind), the police, the press and the Hero Billboard Chart.
🔓 Learnable later: Name on the Door, Team-Up Request.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Hero Industry +10, Leadership +10, Media Presence +5
⚡ Starting technique: Agency Dispatch
🎒 Starts with: Agency hero costume, Agency radio, Agency phone, Business cards, Capture tape, Duffel bag, Casual clothes, ¥80,000
Licensed Pro Hero.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: fully licensed pro hero (Hero License trait added at start), small agency on Musutafu's Hero Agency Row; not U.A. faculty. Commission rules: Quirk use in hero work and emergencies, arrests for police, hiring sidekicks, contracts, supervising student workplace experience. Damage or excess force: complaints, inquiries, suits, lost sponsors; agency pays.
Access: office, shared Row rooms and radio, crime scenes, Commission app, police, support, agency contacts.
Obligations: rent, insurance, sidekick pay, patrols, reports, statements, court, audits, sponsor rules; Hero Billboard Chart: arrests, rescues, complaints all count.
Who notices: sidekick; Row rivals Death Arms, Backdraft, Gunhead, Fourth Kind; Kamui Woods, Mount Lady; police, Naomasa Tsukauchi on League cases; press, fans.
Standing pressures: rank and contracts make or break agencies; pros scout students at the Sports Festival; Stain the Hero Killer is loose; big operations draft nearby agencies.
abilities: Agency Dispatch

Sports Club Regular.name: Sports Club Regular
Sports Club Regular.description:
⚽ You practiced every afternoon: track, soccer, volleyball or baseball.

🌅 Early-morning runs and summer camps were part of the deal.
🤝 You know how to play your part on a team.

📈 Grants: Athletics +5, Team Coordination +5
Sports Club Regular.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school in a sports club and still thinks in drills, warm-ups and teamwork. They recover fast, read a team's rhythm and talk easily with athletes; coaches and club captains recognize the type.

Gym Rat.name: Gym Rat
Gym Rat.description:
🏋️ You lived at the gym after school.

💪 Weights and a heavy bag were your daily routine.
📓 You kept a training log and never skipped it.

📈 Grants: Conditioning +5, Striking +5
Gym Rat.traitNarrativeEffects: The character kept a strict training routine through high school and still does: early workouts, protein, rest days counted. They are hard to tire and know how to hit; they get restless when a day has no training.

Bookworm.name: Bookworm
Bookworm.description:
📖 You spent lunch in the library and train rides in a novel.

🏅 You had the highest marks in the year, more or less by accident.
🔎 Digging through sources for an answer comes naturally.

📈 Grants: Academics +5, Investigation +5
Bookworm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character read everything in high school and remembers most of it: facts, references and footnotes come up in conversation. They are good at research and slow to trust a claim without a source.

Gamer.name: Gamer
Gamer.description:
🎮 You spent late nights on online matches, speedruns and strategy games.

🏆 A few tournament trophies sit at home.
🧠 You think in strategies and know your way around a computer.

📈 Grants: Combat Tactics +5, Computing +5
Gamer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up on competitive games: reading patterns, timing cooldowns and planning team plays. They are at home with computers and online communities, and they talk about fights in game terms.

Tech Tinkerer.name: Tech Tinkerer
Tech Tinkerer.description:
🔩 You took apart every appliance in the house and put most of them back together, usually better.

🛠️ Tools feel natural in your hands.
🎯 Good for Support Course students and anyone who builds their own gear.

📈 Grants: Fabrication +5, Support Engineering +5
Tech Tinkerer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school building and repairing gadgets: radios, drones, bikes and anything with screws. They carry a small screwdriver everywhere and notice how a machine or a support item is put together.

Part-Time Worker.name: Part-Time Worker
Part-Time Worker.description:
☕ You worked convenience store nights and café weekends.

💴 You have earned your own money all through high school.
🧾 You know how to serve customers and how a small business runs.

📈 Grants: Hospitality +5, Business +5
Part-Time Worker.traitNarrativeEffects: The character worked part-time jobs through high school: registers, stock, difficult customers and shift schedules. They are practical about money, polite under pressure and know how small businesses run.

Delinquent.name: Delinquent
Delinquent.description:
😤 You skipped classes and hung out in back streets.

🏫 You left a reputation the teachers still mention.
🧭 You know the back streets and how to stare someone down.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Intimidation +5
Delinquent.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school on the wrong side of the rules: fights behind the station, truancy, older friends with bad habits. They know the streets and how to look dangerous; teachers and police remember them.

Class Clown.name: Class Clown
Class Clown.description:
🤡 You were the one who made the whole class laugh.

🗣️ You talked your way out of every detention.
🎭 You can sell a story with a straight face.

📈 Grants: Deception +5, Persuasion +5
Class Clown.traitNarrativeEffects: The character was the class joker: pranks, impressions and quick excuses. They read a room fast, defuse tension with a joke and can sell a story with a straight face.

Volunteer.name: Volunteer
Volunteer.description:
🤲 You spent your weekends at the community center and in disaster drills.

🩹 You carry a first aid card in your wallet.
🧒 You know how to keep kids calm and busy.

📈 Grants: First Aid +5, Childcare +5
Volunteer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character volunteered through high school: tutoring kids, helping at the community center and disaster drills. They stay calm with frightened people, know basic first aid and are trusted by children and the elderly.

Hero Otaku.name: Hero Otaku
Hero Otaku.description:
📓 You filled notebooks with pro heroes' Quirks and memorized the rankings.

📺 You have every hero interview on replay.
🔍 You can size up a Quirk from a few seconds of footage.

📈 Grants: Hero Industry +5, Quirk Analysis +5
Hero Otaku.traitNarrativeEffects: The character studied pro heroes obsessively through high school: Quirks, fighting styles, agencies and rankings, written up in notebooks. They recognize heroes on sight and analyze any Quirk they see in action.

Early-Bird Cook.name: Early-Bird Cook
Early-Bird Cook.description:
🍱 You got up at five every day to cook the family's bento before school, rain or shine.

🍳 You can cook a proper meal fast.
⏰ Discipline is a habit for you now.

📈 Grants: Cooking +5, Willpower +5
Early-Bird Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: The character kept a strict morning routine through high school, cooking for the family before class. They cook well, wake early without trying and stick to a routine others give up on.

Shadow Manipulation Quirk.name: Shadow Manipulation Quirk
Shadow Manipulation Quirk.description:
🌑 You shape real shadows as a material: flat black bands, dark glass and a coat of darkness.

🌱 Bind a target's ankles in the shadow under them, or step into one shadow and out of another you can see.
📈 Training adds dark glass pins and panes, a coat of dusk, shadow ribbons to lower people, splinters from every shadow in a room and, at the top, a whole city block.
⚠️ It needs real shadow: strong, even light thins it and shadowless light stops it. Your shadow has no mind or voice and does only what you shape.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, as the Quirk works only where real shadow falls.
🎬 Not Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow, which is a living creature: yours is plain shadow shaped as a material, with no mind of its own.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Infiltration +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Shadow Snare, Dark Crossing
Shadow Manipulation Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: real shadow shaped as a material. At first, within about ten meters: harmless flat black binding bands; stepping into a shadow at least their size and out of a seen one within about fifteen meters; shapes last about a minute. Dark glass, coats and bigger shapes: learned techniques. Limits: no shadow, no Quirk; strong even light (noon sun, floodlights, flashlights) thins it: shapes fade, binds slip, dark glass goes brittle; firelight makes them unreliable. It has no mind, voice or will and moves only when shaped; darkness means more, never wilder. The user must see it; steps carry only what they wear and hold. Quirk Strain: light: bind, quick step; moderate: glass pin or pane, coat of dusk, lowering people; heavy: glass splinters across a room; severe: signature relay, every shadow on a block. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding is unlawful confinement; shadow-entering homes or vaults is still trespass or burglary. Look: flat black shadows with hard edges.
abilities: Shadow Snare
Dark Crossing

Vector Lock Quirk.name: Vector Lock Quirk
Vector Lock Quirk.description:
🛑 You lock the motion of moving things in place for a moment, then let them go or turn them onto a new line.

🌱 Touch a punch, a swung bat or a thrown object and it stops dead, then goes on its way or turns onto a new line at the same speed.
📈 Training adds locking a runner at a glance, midair pivots, easing falls and crashes to a gentle stop, turning gunfire into the floor and rerouting a whole city block.
⚠️ You never add or store force: a locked thing keeps its own speed, and anything standing still is out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as reading every moving thing at once floods your eyes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Dodging +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Frozen Swing, Turnabout Throw
Vector Lock Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user locks a moving thing's motion so it hangs a moment, then releases it on its old line or a new one, same speed. New adult user, by touch: a punch, swung weapon, thrown object or lunging person, up to motorbike weight at city-street car speed, for a heartbeat or two. Glance, easing and multiple locks need techniques. Limits: motion only (nothing still, parked or a wall); never adds speed or stores force. A locked person still breathes, sees and speaks. Over truck weight or highway speed slides through; unseen, unfelt attacks land. Quirk Strain: light: locking or turning one blow or throw; moderate: glance-locking a runner, midair pivot, easing a fall; heavy: turning gunfire or several chargers; severe: signature stillness, rerouting a block. Type: Emitter. Law: locking a person is use of force; anything turned into a bystander is the user's own Quirk use. Look: pinpoint pupils; locked things stop with a dull thump, dust hanging still.
abilities: Frozen Swing
Turnabout Throw

Orbit Quirk.name: Orbit Quirk
Orbit Quirk.description:
🪐 Anything you touch and let go falls into a circle around your body and comes back to your hand when you call it.

🌱 Keep a few small objects circling within arm's reach to knock attacks aside, and fling one off its circle as a sling shot.
📈 Training adds a circling cord, a gravel ring, a filming loop, catching falling people, a debris shield and, at the top, every thrown thing pulled into your ring.
⚠️ Objects only circle you and never hang still, and a wall or a body in their path knocks them out of orbit.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as every object you keep circling draws on your breath.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Marksmanship +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Circling Guard, Tangent Shot
Orbit Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: touched-and-released objects circle the user instead of dropping, returning to hand when called. A new adult user keeps up to about five brick-weight objects circling, arm's length to about three meters out, for about a minute; a released one flies straight on at circling speed. Heavier objects, wider rings, people and debris shields need techniques. Limits: orbits center only on the user and move with them; nothing hangs still. A wall, ceiling or body in the path knocks an object down: cramped in corridors, risky in crowds. If the user is knocked out, all fly off along their paths. Any material; weight unchanged. Quirk Strain: light: a few small objects, one sling shot; moderate: circling cord, gravel ring, scouting loop; heavy: catching a falling person, debris shield; severe: signature throw, gathering all thrown at the user. Type: Emitter. Law: a sling shot is a thrown weapon; a lost orbit in a crowd is the user's Quirk use. Look: circling objects hum.
abilities: Circling Guard
Tangent Shot

Density Quirk.name: Density Quirk
Density Quirk.description:
🪨 You change how dense your body is: heavy, with the density of steel, or light, about the weight of a stack of paper, never both at once.

🌱 Turn heavy in an instant so nothing can shove you, and put your full weight behind a blow.
📈 Training adds drifting down from rooftops, pinning a target, walking a flooded street's bottom, anchoring a sliding car, dropping from the sky and facing a runaway truck.
⚠️ Heavy, you are slow and sink through weak floors; light, a gust carries you off and your blows have no weight. Clothes and gear keep their own weight.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as heavy shifts grind your joints and light ones leave you dizzy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Grappling +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Leaden Brace, Dropweight Strike
Density Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: body density shifts in about a second, size and shape kept: at first heavy to about five times their weight (a large motorbike) or light to about a fifth (leaps to a second-floor window, falls several stories unhurt), for about a minute. Car weight, drifting, gliding: learned techniques. Limits: heavy or light, never both or uneven; clothes, gear and anyone carried keep their weight. Heavy: walking pace, no jumps or swims, sinks, breaks wood floors, car roofs; shoves, tackles, blasts and wind cannot budge them; blades, bullets, heat and electricity still hurt. Light: gusts carry them off, blows lack weight, solid hits fling them. Quirk Strain: light: brace, weighted blow; moderate: slow descent, pin, underwater walk; heavy: counterweight, sky drop; severe: signature blow, truck weight. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed pinning under their weight is assault; floors or roofs they break are their property damage. Look: heavy, gray veins; light, pale skin.
abilities: Leaden Brace
Dropweight Strike

Vibration Quirk.name: Vibration Quirk
Vibration Quirk.description:
📳 You make whatever you touch vibrate, from a faint hum to a violent shake, and feel vibration through your hands and feet.

🌱 Your palm strike rattles a person off their feet, and a palm on the floor reveals footsteps and hollow spaces a room or two away.
📈 Training adds numbing a grip, shaking concrete to rubble, climbing sheer walls, packing rubble over trapped people, quakes through armor and holding a building still.
⚠️ It works only through touch: nothing crosses open air, and mud, water or thick padding swallows it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every quake you release also shakes your own wrists and elbows.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Yo Shindo (Vibrate).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Demolition +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Quake Palm, Footfall Read
Vibration Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user vibrates what they touch, faint hum to violent shake, and feels vibration via hands and feet. New adult user: a palm strike knocks an adult down and cracks paving stone or cinderblock; a palm on floor or wall feels footsteps, drops and hollows through about two rooms or one floor. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: contact only, via solid joined material, never air; soft soil, mud, water, loose sand and padding absorb it. No sensing the perfectly still, fliers or swimmers; engines and machinery drown it. Shaking a load-bearing wall apart can drop a floor. Quirk Strain: light: strike, reading; moderate: numbing grip, shattered wall, climb; heavy: packing rubble, quake through armor; severe: signature move, holding a building still. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed wall or pavement shattering: property damage; a quake cracking a structure near bystanders: reckless endangerment. Look: hands blur, dust jumps.
abilities: Quake Palm
Footfall Read

Psychometry Quirk.name: Psychometry Quirk
Psychometry Quirk.description:
🔍 You read the traces people leave on things: who handled them, what they felt and what happened around them.

🌱 A touch reaches back only a few minutes, and in a fight, touching an opponent's weapon shows you where it was about to go.
📈 Training adds tracing a stolen object through every hand, disarming a grip you have read, seeing a collapse, following guards' worn paths and reading a scene days back.
⚠️ You read objects and places, never living minds, and gloves or fire stop you cold.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as other people's strongest moments crash into you with every touch.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Control +10, Investigation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Fresh Trace, Parry Reading
Psychometry Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: bare fingertips on an object or spot read its residue: at first the last few minutes within a few strides (who touched it, their faces and hands, what they did and felt, words said in strong feeling). In a fight, touching a foe's weapon shows where it was about to go. Hours and days need learned techniques. Limits: objects and places only, never living minds or bodies. Gloves block it; crowd-handled things (cash, railings, straps) blur; fire scours residue. Fresh, strong feelings drown older, calm ones; impressions are images and feelings to interpret, so can mislead. Quirk Strain: light: quick reading, read parry; moderate: chain of hands, disarm, worn path; heavy: a collapse or battleground; severe: signature move, full scene. Type: Emitter. Law: reading private belongings without consent or a warrant is invasion of privacy; readings are police leads, never court evidence alone. Look: eyes unfocus, fingertips pale, the user murmurs what they see.
abilities: Fresh Trace
Parry Reading

Machine Whisper Quirk.name: Machine Whisper Quirk
Machine Whisper Quirk.description:
⚙️ You feel what a machine is doing through your hands and can talk it into doing what it was built for.

🌱 A touch tells you what is running, what is broken and how to work it; you open an electronic lock, close a shutter or stall an engine with no key or code.
📈 Training adds locking villains in their own gear, lurching a forklift at an attacker, steadying an elevator, distant drones and driverless cars, and a whole building.
⚠️ Only machines with a motor, an engine or a circuit answer: a padlock, a knife, a gun and anything living are out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as every machine you hold crowds your own thoughts until words come slowly.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Support Engineering +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Diagnostic Touch, Coaxed Lock
Machine Whisper Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: bare-skin touch reads a machine's state, faults and design and makes it run any built-in function without controls, key or code. New adult user: one touched machine at a time (car, lock, phone, drone); distance needs techniques. Limits: only motor, engine or circuit machines; never simple mechanisms (padlocks, knives, guns, bicycles) or living things, Quirk-made limbs included; implants (pacemaker, prosthetic) are beyond a new user. Only what working parts allow: no power, no motion; cut cables stay cut. No electricity, no metal pulling; many machines at once blur. Quirk Strain: light: reading, unlock, stall; moderate: locking gear, lurch, drone steering; heavy: halting a failing machine, remote driving; severe: signature, running a building. Type: Emitter. Law: unlocking or taking a vehicle without consent or license is unauthorized access and theft; police check registered machine Quirks first after a hacked door. Look: fingertips on it, eyes half shut.
abilities: Diagnostic Touch
Coaxed Lock

Afterimage Quirk.name: Afterimage Quirk
Afterimage Quirk.description:
🎞️ Your eyes keep what they see, and you play it back as moving images made of light.

🌱 Leave a standing image of yourself behind, fake a lunge with an image of your body, or replay what you witnessed at life size a few strides away.
📈 Training adds a blinding stored glare, replays that show police what you saw, a false wall across an alley, a lit way out of smoke and a street full of your images.
⚠️ Your images are light only: no weight, no sound, no shadow, and anything that touches them passes straight through.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as your eyes glow with whatever you have stored and give away a coming projection.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Deception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Left-Behind Self, Phantom Feint
Afterimage Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the eyes store sight, projected as moving, full-color light. A new adult user keeps about the last ten minutes (rolling, unless a moment is kept) and projects any stored moment life-size anywhere visible within about ten meters, or their own figure, posed and moving at will; other images only replay sight, as seen. Larger, longer ones need techniques. Limits: light only: no weight, sound, touch, heat or shadow; things pass through. Solid by day; a glow betrays them in the dark. Fades if the user loses sight or focus; no unseen faces or places. Cameras record them. No beams, burning or hiding the user's body. Quirk Strain: light: standing image, feint; moderate: glare, replay, false wall; heavy: lit route, crowd of selves; severe: signature, projected battalion. Type: Emitter. Law: deceiving police or public is obstruction and fraud; showing real heroes or officers unlicensed is impersonation; a replay is sworn testimony, not a recording. Look: glowing irises.
abilities: Left-Behind Self
Phantom Feint

Anchor Point Quirk.name: Anchor Point Quirk
Anchor Point Quirk.description:
📍 You mark spots on a floor, a wall or a lamp post with a touch and snap back to them in a heartbeat.

🌱 Hold up to three anchors, always sensing each, and snap to any within your city district, arriving at rest whatever your speed, so a snap ends a fall.
📈 Training adds strike-and-snap, sending a touched person to safety, delivering a villain to a police van, tagging a car, shuttling people from fires and up to six anchors.
⚠️ Only you and what you wear and carry make the trip: a grip on you is left holding air, and an anchor someone stands on puts you down beside them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as each snap leaves you dizzy and half-deaf for a breath.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Navigation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Homing Snap, Recall Jab
Anchor Point Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a bare palm held a moment on a fixed spot plants an anchor. New adult user: up to three, each lasting about a day, always sensing direction and distance; focus snaps them to any anchor within about 2 km, arriving at rest, so a snap ends a fall. Carrying or sending others, moving or extra anchors need techniques. Limits: only body and gear go; grippers hold air; a chained rope or cuff stays, wrenching the wrist. Anchors: non-living fixed spots only, lost if moved. Occupied: arrive beside them; sealed, flooded or buried: snap fails. No snap unconscious or panicking. Quirk Strain: light: snap, strike-and-recall; moderate: send or carry one, tag a vehicle; heavy: shuttle several, three-sided rush; severe: signature throw, six anchors. Type: Emitter. Law: snapping into a locked home or office is trespass; warrantless anchoring of a stranger's car to tail it is stalking. Look: faint handprints seen up close; soft thump, flash on arrival.
abilities: Homing Snap
Recall Jab

Glass Quirk.name: Glass Quirk
Glass Quirk.description:
🪟 You grow clear glass from your skin and shape it as it sets; some users carry faintly glassy skin at the knuckles and neck.

🌱 Raise a door-sized pane, flick blunt beads, grow lenses, shards and plates. Your glass stops fists and pistol rounds until a blow hits its weak point.
📈 Training adds shackles fused to the floor, a lens that focuses sunlight, glazing shut a cracking wall, stairs up a building, shard fans and holding up a falling tower.
⚠️ You always feel the weak point and can shift it, but sudden heat change cracks it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as the skin at your knuckles cracks and bleeds when you push it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Window Wall, Bead Volley
Glass Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: clear glass wells from palms and forearms and sets hard in a second or two as guided; at first about a bucket per scene, up to a door-sized pane. It stops fists, bats, knives and pistol rounds, but a blow on its weak point shatters it; the user feels that point and all strain and can shift it by touch. Bigger structures need learned techniques. Limits: only self-grown glass obeys, though they feel strain in any glass touched. It hides nothing; sudden heat change (fire, then water) cracks it; shards cut unless carefully grown to break blunt. Quirk Strain: light: pane, beads; moderate: shackle, lens, stair; heavy: glazing a failing structure, shard fan; severe: signature fist, holding up a building. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: glass left on roads is the user's to clear; unlicensed shards count as weapons. Look: ringing as glass rises; as Mutant, glassy knuckles and neck.
abilities: Window Wall
Bead Volley

Living Ink Quirk.name: Living Ink Quirk
Living Ink Quirk.description:
🖋️ Black ink flows from your fingertips, and simple drawings lift off the surface as ink constructs that move at your word.

🌱 Sketch a rope that hauls a person up or a hound that knocks a target down. A quick sketch is flimsy; a careful one holds an adult or stops a punch.
📈 Training adds drawn nets, scout birds that come back as a sketch of what they saw, ladders, shields, a whole pack at once and a mural that keeps working without you.
⚠️ Constructs fade after a few minutes and dissolve in water, so rain, a hose or a sprinkler ends them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as your body makes ink slowly and a long fight leaves your fingertips dry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Visual Arts +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Drawn Lifeline, Sketched Hound
Living Ink Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user's fingertips draw black ink on any dry surface; simple drawings lift off as solid constructs up to large-dog or door size, obeying spoken orders in sight. New adult user: up to three; a quick sketch (seconds) breaks under a solid blow; a careful one (a full turn) holds an adult's weight, pulls a person, stops a punch, bites hard. More, bigger or self-acting constructs need techniques. Limits: constructs fade in about five minutes and dissolve at once in any water, even a crossed puddle; simple orders only, no speech, no copied look or power. Needs a free hand and a surface; ink refills slowly, so long fights run dry. Quirk Strain: light: rope, hound; moderate: net, scout bird, ladder; heavy: shield, pack; severe: signature beast, working mural. Type: Emitter. Law: unpermitted drawing on public walls is vandalism even if the ink fades; a construct's bite is the user's own assault. Look: gray-stained fingertips; glossy black drawings peel up.
abilities: Drawn Lifeline
Sketched Hound

Undo Quirk.name: Undo Quirk
Undo Quirk.description:
⏪ You touch a non-living thing, feel whether it changed in the last minute, and return it to how it was.

🌱 A shattered window stands whole, a bent bar straightens, a spilled bag repacks, and scattered pieces fly back, striking whatever stands in the way.
📈 Training adds closing a breach around a villain, making an armed bomb safe, raising a fallen stair, undoing a crushed car around its riders, rebuilding part of a house.
⚠️ Living bodies are out of reach: wounds, ages and Quirks never answer, and a body in the way stops the returning pieces.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding the earlier shape of things in mind blurs your own last few minutes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eri (Rewind), which works on living bodies; this one cannot.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Minute Mend, Shard Recall
Undo Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: by touch the user restores a non-living object's shape, wholeness and contents from any moment in the last minute. A new adult user undoes up to door or motorbike size. The object stays put; its broken or fallen pieces from that span fly back, bruising anyone between. Touch also senses whether and how it changed. Longer spans, larger objects need techniques. Limits: no living bodies, the user's included (wounds, age, illness, Quirks); clothing only once removed. Returning pieces press around a living body without crushing. Used-up things never return (burned fuel, eaten food, fired shots); older changes are final. Quirk Strain: light: mend, recall; moderate: closed breach, defused device, raised stair; heavy: crushed vehicle, rubble recall; severe: signature reset, rebuilding a house. Type: Emitter. Law: undoing crime-scene evidence is tampering; police suspect a registered Undo user near a tidied scene until cleared. Look: pieces streak back rattling.
abilities: Minute Mend
Shard Recall

Portrait Style - Hero Academy Anime.name: Portrait Style - Hero Academy Anime
Portrait Style - Hero Academy Anime.description:
🎨 Image Style: Hero Academy Anime
The hero-academy anime look: bright faces, bold cel shadows, crisp costumes and uniforms, and training-arc energy. The default style for this world.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Style - Hero Academy Anime.traitNarrativeEffects:
Clean high-resolution anime production artwork in Hero Academy Anime style: school-based superhero anime character art inspired by young hero training shows and academy battle series. Bright anime faces, sharp uniform and costume readability, energetic young-hero posture, clean action anatomy, bold cel shadows and optimistic training-arc energy. Readable character design, clear facial structure, strong silhouette control, clean material separation and controlled lighting.

Rendering and finish only. Preserve the selected frame, body plan, actual age, anatomy, proportions, colors, hair, eyes, outfit, pose, props, Quirk state and background. Follow the selected scene lighting; this style adds no scenery, weather, clothing, emblems, weapons, aura, companions, text, border, panel or interface. Remain unmistakably anime: no realism, semi-realism, photographic skin or three-dimensional render finish.

Art Club.name: Art Club
Art Club.description:
🎨 You carried a sketchbook in every bag and spent your afternoons in the art club.

🖼️ You made the posters for every school event.
🎯 Good for designing your own hero costume.

📈 Grants: Visual Arts +5, Costume Design +5
Art Club.traitNarrativeEffects: The character drew and designed through high school: sketches, posters, costumes for the school play. They notice color, shape and detail, and they remember faces and outfits.

Music Club.name: Music Club
Music Club.description:
🎸 You played in the light music club and a garage band.

🎤 You still remember every second of your school festival stage.
🎛️ You know your way around recording gear.

📈 Grants: Performance +5, Media Production +5
Music Club.traitNarrativeEffects: The character played in a band through high school: rehearsals, small gigs and recording sessions. They are comfortable on a stage, keep rhythm with a team and know their way around a mixing desk and a camera.

Precognition Quirk.name: Precognition Quirk
Precognition Quirk.description:
⏩ You see a few seconds ahead: the punch before it is thrown, the sign before it falls.

🌱 At the start you see about three seconds of whatever your own eyes would see, so you dodge, counter and shout warnings a beat early.
📈 Training adds grabbing a runner where they are about to step, crossing a collapsing street untouched, knocking a weapon loose before it fires, a ten-second horizon and, at your peak, a minute ahead.
⚠️ A blow from behind or through a wall never shows, a big brawl blurs into noise, and acting on a glimpse changes it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as a crowded fight floods you with seconds that have not happened yet.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close; Sir Nighteye's Foresight reads hours of one person's life instead.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Control +10, Dodging +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Next-Beat Dodge, Answered Blow
Precognition Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: awake and focused, a new adult user glimpses about three seconds ahead of all in their line of sight (punches, a runner's turn, a falling sign, a swerving car) as a motion overlay, so they move, counter and warn early. Longer windows, whole streets and others' safety need techniques. Limits: only what their own eyes would see; nothing behind, through walls or out of sight shows. It shows events' course if unchanged; acting on it branches events; they see anew. Motion and events only, never thoughts, plans or words; crowded fast brawls blur to noise. Asleep, blindfolded or in total darkness: nothing. Quirk Strain: light: dodge, counter, warning; moderate: pinned grab, run through danger, disarm; heavy: ten-second horizon over a block; severe: signature move, a minute ahead. Type: Emitter. Law: legal in self-defense and licensed duty; cheating at gambling or sports with it is fraud. Look: eyes track things a half beat early; they flinch or step aside first.
abilities: Next-Beat Dodge
Answered Blow

Prognostication Quirk.name: Prognostication Quirk
Prognostication Quirk.description:
🔮 Touch someone while meeting their eyes, and the coming stretch of their life rushes past you in a breath.

🌱 At the start a reading shows about fifteen minutes of that person's future, once per person per day.
📈 Training adds throwing at where a read opponent will be, pulling someone out of a coming accident, having police waiting where a suspect will go, a full hour, several people at once and, at your peak, a whole day ahead.
⚠️ No touch or no eye contact, no reading; it never shows thoughts, and acting on a vision changes the future it showed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as a long reading leaves your own day blurry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Sir Nighteye's Foresight.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Insight +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Glimpse Ahead, Foreseen Throw
Prognostication Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: touch (skin or clothing) plus eye contact shows the user in a breath a person's next stretch as rapid scenes from beside them: where they go, whom they meet, what they say and do, what befalls them. At first about fifteen minutes ahead, once per person per day; longer, multi-person and combat readings: learned techniques. Limits: sunglasses, eye masks or shut eyes block it; the narrator never opens a refuser's eyes. It shows the course if nobody acts, never fate; acting branches it, the player stays free. Only events to and around them: never thoughts, memories or secrets they would not reveal then, nor the user's future except beside them. Quirk Strain: light: short reading, foreseen throw; moderate: saved accident, set trap, route reading; heavy: several people; severe: signature move, a full day. Type: Emitter. Law: a reading is a lead, never court evidence alone; stalking, blackmail or robbery by it is a crime. Look: a still-eyed breath, tight grip.
abilities: Glimpse Ahead
Foreseen Throw

Notoriety: Watched.name: Notoriety: Watched
Notoriety: Watched.description:
👀 The police have a file on you: a description, a few sightings, a name or nickname that keeps coming up.

⚠️ Patrols notice you, beat officers ask questions, and a pro may recognize you on sight.
🧊 Lay low to let it cool.
Notoriety: Watched.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a person of interest to the police: a description and a few sightings are on file, and a working nickname is going around the precincts. Beat officers and local pros who see someone matching the description take a second look and may stop them with questions; informants know the police are curious. Nothing is public yet: no posters, no news. Laying low, changing clothes and staying off the streets cool this down.

Notoriety: Wanted.name: Notoriety: Wanted
Notoriety: Wanted.description:
🚨 You are wanted: your face or mask is on police bulletins and hero agency briefings.

⚠️ Officers and heroes act on sight, brokers raise their prices, informants are tempted.
🧊 Lay low to let it cool.
Notoriety: Wanted.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is wanted by the police: a photo or a clear description (with any mask or costume) is on police bulletins and the briefing boards of local hero agencies, and the news has run the story at least once. Officers and pros who recognize the character act on sight; checkpoints and transit cameras are a real risk; brokers like Giran charge more and informants are tempted by the reward. Ordinary people may recognize the face. Laying low for days lowers the pressure; more crimes raise it.

Notoriety: Most Wanted.name: Notoriety: Most Wanted
Notoriety: Most Wanted.description:
🔥 You are among the most wanted people in the region: posters, a bounty, a task force.

⚠️ Pro teams hunt you actively; safehouses burn; allies weigh the reward.
🧊 Only a long stretch of lying low cools this.
Notoriety: Most Wanted.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is one of the most wanted people in the region: wanted posters and a reward, a police task force, and pro hero teams assigned to find them. Their face is on the news and on station screens; patrols double where they were last seen; safehouses and brokers they used are watched or raided; allies and contacts weigh the reward. Heroes who find them come prepared and in numbers. Only a long stretch of lying low, far from where they were seen, eases the hunt.

Encore Quirk.name: Encore Quirk
Encore Quirk.description:
🎭 You turn a confrontation into a musical performance, guiding footwork with a beat while everyone keeps their own choices.

🌱 Start within six meters: steady allies, upset an opponent's step, supply music and a soft spotlight, and physically repeat a simple move with "Encore".
📈 Attention stores power. Training adds capture footwork, leaps, crowd evacuation and stronger audience flourishes; replays never reverse time or copy another Quirk.
⚠️ Silence, being ignored and noise that buries your beat weaken you. Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, from performing and repeating moves.
⚖️ Venues may require permission; forced movement needs self-defense or licensed duty. Nobody must sing, dance or follow orders.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), for vocal delivery only.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Media Presence +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Opening Measure, Immediate Reprise
Encore Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: sound organs give rhythmic pressure, tones, a soft glow. New adult user, six meters: steadies two willing allies or unbalances a listener's step; "Encore" re-performs a simple move bodily; training widens it. Limits: bodies only, not minds or Quirk activation; nobody must sing or dance; no free sound or solid light. Earplugs, soundproofing, silence or louder noise stop it. Charges: +1 per turn with an attentive live observer (any side) in hearing, max 3; crowds, recordings, being ignored: none; a broken beat clears all; never replaces stamina. Replays undo, restore and copy nothing. Quirk Strain: light: opening beat; moderate: reprise, capture footwork, palm strike, leap; heavy: evacuation, audience flourish; severe: signature formation, company rhythm, awakened performances; reprises: double exertion. Type: Emitter. Law: venue permits where required; forced movement or restraint outside self-defense or licensed duty is assault. Look: melody, claps, gestures.
abilities: Opening Measure
Immediate Reprise

Gelatinous Guardian Quirk.name: Gelatinous Guardian Quirk
Gelatinous Guardian Quirk.description:
🫧 You produce living medicinal slime and have a partly gel body, combining your doctor father's healing with your mother's liquid manipulation.

🌱 Start by softening blunt hits, squeezing gaps, cushioning short falls and sealing bleeding or cooling burns with gel. Healing is real and slow.
📈 Training adds sticky capture, sealed doors, injured transport and larger fall cushions. Only your own noncorrosive gel answers you.
⚠️ Heat, drying and sharp edges threaten gel; it cannot regrow limbs or replace blood. Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, from production and healing.
⚖️ Seek patient consent where possible; restraint needs self-defense or licensed duty. Gel protects wounds and speeds recovery while hospital care remains necessary.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Recovery Girl (Heal); Mina Ashido (Acid), for material feel only.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Medicinal Wrap, Yielding Guard
Gelatinous Guardian Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: living medicinal gel in skin and tissue, oozed from the hands. New adult user: about a bucket of own gel within 3 m; pads a low fall, seals an arm wound, slips shoulder-width gaps. Limits: own gel only; organs in a weak torso core; no splitting or phasing; eases blunt hits, not blades or bullets; heat dries, cold stiffens; dirty gel cannot heal. Healing (sustained touch) seals bleeding, speeds repair in minutes-hours; never replaces blood, regrows limbs, cures all or revives. Loose gel stops beyond range, dries in an hour. Quirk Strain: light: wrap, guard; moderate: sticky capture, squeeze, cooling; heavy: patient carry, fall cushion; severe: rescue spread, long dressings, awakened uses. Fusion: father's healing + mother's liquid manipulation. Type: Mutant (also fits Emitter). Law: consent if possible; restraint beyond self-defense or duty: unlawful confinement. Tagline: "I'm not a bad slime!" Look: translucent gel.
abilities: Medicinal Wrap
Yielding Guard

Frostfire Quirk.name: Frostfire Quirk
Frostfire Quirk.description:
❄️ Fire and ice run through your whole body at once: pale-blue flames that leave frost behind.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Fire and Ice: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you throw a frost-leaving flame jet about three meters and spread a steaming sheet of ice about five.
📈 With training: flame-burst hops, warm-veined ice cuffs, a fog wall where heat meets cold, a temperature lock on an object or patch of ground, and thermal shock that cracks stone, locks and ice.
⚠️ Each side checks the other: your fire thaws your own ice, and rain blunts the flame.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as your body temperature swings between fever and deep chill.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot), but with no left-right split.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Hoarfrost Jet, Cinder Glaze
🛡️ Resists: fire, cold
Frostfire Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: flame and frost together from any skin, no left-right split; at first a three-meter riming flame jet or a five-meter steaming ice sheet in a second or two. More needs learned techniques. Limits: their fire thaws their ice in moments unless held; rain or sealed rooms blunt the flame, heat thins the frost. Quirk Strain: light: jet, glaze; moderate: burst hop, steaming cuff, fog curtain; heavy: temperature lock, thermal fracture, close sear; severe: signature shockwave, warding a room. Fusion: Fire and Ice at about half single-nature range and force; lacks lances, fire flight, permanent ice walls, white heat; only it has thermal shock (cracks stone, locks, ice), fog walls and temperature locks (object or ground held at one extreme). Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed public fire or ice, or cracking locks, doors or pavement, brings criminal, property and burglary charges. Look: pale-blue fire on frosted skin.
abilities: Hoarfrost Jet
Cinder Glaze

Thunderhead Quirk.name: Thunderhead Quirk
Thunderhead Quirk.description:
⛈️ You gather a small storm cloud of your own: charged wind that steers its own lightning.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Wind and Electricity: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you throw charged gusts about five meters and deliver close-range static jolts.
📈 With training: static updrafts for short hops, rain-and-static cover for an escape, wind channels that guide a spark onto one target or safely to the ground, a charged downdraft that pins and numbs, and lightning steered past bystanders.
⚠️ Sealed rooms starve your cloud.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as feeding wind and charge together wears you down fast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Nine (Weather Manipulation), at a personal scale.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Evacuation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Charged Gust, Ozone Clasp
🛡️ Resists: electric
Thunderhead Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a damp, static storm cloud wraps shoulders and hands. New adult user: five-meter gusts shove an adult back; updrafts give a half-story hop; touch jolts. More needs techniques. Limits: sealed, bone-dry or grounded rooms thin it; crosswinds scatter it; wet ground carries stray current; no flight, air cuts or wiring control yet. Quirk Strain: light: charged gust, ozone clasp; moderate: updraft, rain-static cover, spark channel; heavy: pinning downdraft, vapor draft; severe: signature lightning, room storm cell. Fusion: Wind plus Electricity, each about half single-nature range and force; no high flight, air blades, nerve-speed sprints or district blackouts; only it guides sparks to a target or ground, makes rain-static cover and numbing downdraft pins, steers lightning past bystanders. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed public gusts or shocks are assault; stray static frying phones, signals or medical devices is strict liability. Look: static hair, sparking mist.
abilities: Charged Gust
Ozone Clasp

Magma Heart Quirk.name: Magma Heart Quirk
Magma Heart Quirk.description:
🌋 Stone you raise arrives hot, and heat you make melts rock: you turn stone into slag and back again.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Earth and Fire: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you tip up a waist-high slab of hot pavement for cover and blister the stone under a foe's feet.
📈 With training: smoking ridges, locks melted by touch, hot mud traps, poured rock cooled into cuffs and barricades, rubble fused into a glassy rescue ramp, and a heated floor.
⚠️ Heat lingers in every surface you work: cool it before civilians touch it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as heat builds inside your palms and chest.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Cementoss (Cement), for shaping only.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Warm Slab, Slag Glaze
🛡️ Resists: fire
Magma Heart Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user heats and shapes stone, concrete, brick and asphalt by touch. A new adult user moves half a car's weight of stone within two meters in a couple of seconds and can cool it back to touchable. Limits: touch on stone, concrete or soil only; wood, glass, metal and air never answer (steel decks, midair). Worked stone stays hot for minutes unless quenched, burning civilians; quenching dumps heat into the user. Quirk Strain: light: warm slab, blistered floor; moderate: smoking ridge, melted lock, hot mud trap, cooled cuffs, glassy ramp; heavy: clamping slabs; severe: signature wave, heated courtyard. Fusion: Earth plus Fire; half an Earth user's reach and volume; no flames or ranged blasts (heat moves only through rock); only the fusion melts stone to slag, fuses rubble to glass and quenches it solid. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed melting of roads or walls is property damage; hot stone left for the public is negligence. Look: orange-veined, hissing rock.
abilities: Warm Slab
Slag Glaze

Pressure Steam Quirk.name: Pressure Steam Quirk
Pressure Steam Quirk.description:
♨️ Water heated inside your body vents as pressurized steam.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Water and Fire: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you spray a short stream of hot water to douse flames and vent a scalding puff of vapor at close range.
📈 With training: steam-piston strikes and jumps, a scalding fog held back to warm mist for cover, a pressure valve that bursts a door or lifts rubble, a boiling water slug and a hall filled with humid heat.
⚠️ Steam must vent through your skin, so tight wraps block it, and dry air and cold rooms limit your output.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as unvented steam cooks your own core.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Conditioning +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Warm Spray, Scald Puff
🛡️ Resists: fire
Pressure Steam Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the body makes and heats water, venting hot water, mist or steam from palms, forearms, calves. New adult user: a hot spray about 5 m (douses small fires, shoves adults back), a 2 m scalding puff, or a doorway of mist in seconds. Limits: heated water must be vented, and blocked pores or tight wraps stop it. Dry, cold air halves reach and condenses steam harmlessly within a stride or two. Quirk Strain: light: warm spray, short puff; moderate: floor flush, wet-heat sear, piston strike or jump, fog screen, pressure release; heavy: boiling slug; severe: signature blowout, heating a hall. Fusion: Water's water + Fire's heat; half a Water user's volume and range, no open flames (heat stays inside); only it makes high-pressure steam. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed scalding is assault; crowded high-pressure venting is public endangerment. Look: white plumes at wrists, elbows, ankles.
abilities: Warm Spray
Scald Puff

Glacier Hide Quirk.name: Glacier Hide Quirk
Glacier Hide Quirk.description:
🧊 Ice forms as plates over your skin and hardens to near stone.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Ice and Hardening: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and duration, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you send a ridge of stony frost five meters along the ground and strike with frost-hardened knuckles.
📈 With training: slide tracks, your plated back as cover for allies, a cold bear-hug restraint, armored ice shields grown for others, armor-cracking blows and an anchored stance nothing pushes over.
⚠️ Heat melts your plates.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as the cold of your own armor stiffens your joints.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening), Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot, cold side).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rime Wedge, Frostplate Knuckle
🛡️ Resists: cold, bludgeoning
Glacier Hide Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: near-stone ice plating and short frost ridges along touched surfaces; at first a limb or torso plates instantly and turns fists, knives, bats and pistol rounds about thirty seconds; knuckles dent a car door; a frozen line of about five meters. More needs learned techniques. Limits: fire and heat melt the plates; electricity and gas hurt; worn long, the cold slows sprint and reflexes; they sink in water. Quirk Strain: light: ridge, plated fist; moderate: slide track, shell guard, bear hug, shed shields; heavy: armor-cracking blow; severe: signature glacier stance, block-wide redoubt. Fusion: Ice and Hardening: about half pure Ice reach, half pure Hardening duration; no room-wide flash-freeze or unchilled armor; only it makes petrified plates to anchor down or detach as shields for others. Type: Emitter (also fits Transformation). Law: unlicensed plate strikes or pins are assault, anchored ice cracking pavement property damage. Look: grinding blue-gray ice.
abilities: Rime Wedge
Frostplate Knuckle

Mending Bloom Quirk.name: Mending Bloom Quirk
Mending Bloom Quirk.description:
🌸 Every plant you grow carries your healing.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Plant and Healing: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and speed, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you bind foes in soothing vines out to five meters and grow moss dressings that stop bleeding.
📈 With training: vine stretchers for the wounded, calming pollen against pain, a fruit that restores stamina, a draining touch, a striking living bough and a cocoon for the dying.
⚠️ Plants need light and water, and the healing is slow. Living plants only, no gel.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as both growth and healing empty your strength.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Recovery Girl (Heal), Ibara Shiozaki (Vines).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Balm Tendril Snare, Moss Poultice
Mending Bloom Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: living moss, vines, flowers and fruit grow from hands and forearms, all slowly healing others. New adult user: soft vines hold an adult five meters off; a moss pad stops bleeding at once and closes small cuts in minutes; real plants, no gel. More needs techniques. Limits: darkness or thirst halves reach and withers them; fire and blades ruin them. Healing skips the user. Quirk Strain: light: soothing snare, moss dressing; moderate: vine stretcher, sapping touch, calming pollen, healing fruit; heavy: bough strike; severe: signature arbor, moss cocoon. Fusion: Plant plus Healing at half of pure Plant reach and of pure Healing speed; no instant bone-knitting or block-cracking trunks; only fusion makes dressings, stretchers, pollen, fruit. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding or pollen-dosing is unlawful restraint; non-emergency unlicensed treatment breaks medical law. Look: herbal scent.
abilities: Balm Tendril Snare
Moss Poultice

Railstorm Quirk.name: Railstorm Quirk
Railstorm Quirk.description:
🧲 Current runs through your arms as magnetic coils: you accelerate metal and ride on steel.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Magnetism and Electricity: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and force, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you snatch a steel weapon within five meters with a spark and jolt a target on touch.
📈 With training: coins and bearings fired as stun shots (lethal only if you let them), a metal-armored villain pinned to a wall, rides along steel girders, a pulse that kills phones, cameras and detonators, falling steel caught midair and a floor's wiring seized.
⚠️ Rubber and plastic ignore you, and it fries your own phone.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as coil current heats your forearms.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Support Engineering +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sparking Snatch, Polar Jolt
🛡️ Resists: electric
Railstorm Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: body charge loops into magnetic coils. A new adult user moves steel up to half a person's weight within five meters, locks muscles by touch jolt, powers small devices a few minutes; more needs techniques. Limits: rubber, plastic, wood, stone, glass, unmarked flesh ignore it; insulation blocks it; water spreads it to all; strong pulses fry cards, the user's phone, unshielded gear. Quirk Strain: light: snatch, jolt; moderate: armor pin, induction pulse, bearing volley, rail glide; heavy: falling-steel catch; severe: signature coil shot, floor-wiring seizure, awakened uses. Fusion: magnetism plus electricity, each about half a pure user's range and force; no block-wide metal command, car swings, unguided long-range lightning or storms; only the fusion fires coin or bearing stun shots, rides rails, snuffs electronics. Type: Emitter. Law: full-force shots are assault with a deadly weapon; frying pacemakers or public signals is reckless endangerment. Look: arcs.
abilities: Sparking Snatch
Polar Jolt

Rebound Quirk.name: Rebound Quirk
Rebound Quirk.description:
🏀 Your body stretches and changes its weight: feather-light bounds, heavy landings.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Gravity and Elasticity: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and force, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you lighten a person you touch and bounce punches off your torso.
📈 With training: wall-to-wall bounces that land heavy, a stretched net that catches a falling person and sets them down softly, a slingshot launch, blows rebounded at their source, and foes dragged down.
⚠️ Sharp edges and heat hurt your stretched body.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as rapid weight swings cause nausea.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Buoyant Tap, Snapback Belly
Rebound Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the body stretches, rebounds and shifts own or touched weight. New adult user: limbs stretch about 5 m; self or up to half a car's weight turns feather-light or doubles; punches bounce off the torso; more needs techniques. Limits: sharp edges and bullets pierce the stretched body; heat burns stretched skin; touch shifts need bare skin, end if knocked out. Quirk Strain: light: buoyant tap, belly rebound; moderate: weighted grab, spring tether, wall-bounce drop, catching net; heavy: bracing a load; severe: signature slingshot, spanning a street, awakened uses. Fusion: gravity + elasticity, each about half a single-nature user's range and force: no multi-ton floats, street crush fields or elastic air panes; only it does wall-bounce drops, weightless nets, slingshots, blows rebounded to source. Type: Emitter (also fits Transformation). Law: heavy-weight slams are assault; unlicensed launches risk traffic crashes. Look: springy step.
abilities: Buoyant Tap
Snapback Belly

Gale Wings Quirk.name: Gale Wings Quirk
Gale Wings Quirk.description:
🪽 Your feathered wings make their own wind, so you fly with less flapping.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Wings and Wind: smaller wings and about half a single Quirk's gust range, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you hop onto low roofs on an air pocket and shove foes back with a wing gust.
📈 With training: glides over a block, air-edged feathers, hovering rescues while a feather-gust sweeps people clear, a wind dome that shelters a group under your wings, and a diving gale strike.
⚠️ Wet or damaged feathers ground you, and strong crosswinds still win.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as making wind while aloft burns breath fast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hawks (Fierce Wings), Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tailwind Takeoff, Pinion Push
Gale Wings Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: user-height feathered wings stream currents from the quills for low-flap flight and hovering; at first a one-story roof, a narrow street in one gliding beat, a gust shoving an adult about five meters. More needs learned techniques. Limits: wet, muddied or damaged feathers ground them at once, shedding too many until regrown; strong crosswinds overpower them; indoors no diving speed. Quirk Strain: wings cost nothing; light: hop, gust; moderate: glide survey, edged feather, hover rescue; heavy: plumes, underwing dome; severe: signature dive strike, thermal corridor. Fusion: Wings and Wind at about half single-nature range and force; no wide feather telekinesis, thrown gales or free cyclones; only it hovers still on wing-wind, sweeps people clear, domes air underwing, dives in a gale. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: wings are legal; unlicensed public flight or gusts are unlawful Quirk use, diving strikes assault. Look: wings in the player's chosen color.
abilities: Tailwind Takeoff
Pinion Push

Echo Pulse Quirk.name: Echo Pulse Quirk
Echo Pulse Quirk.description:
🔊 Your voice carries a physical tremor into whatever it hits.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Sound and Vibration: about half a single Quirk's range and force, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start your shout rattles a target and your hum maps a room through a wall or smoke.
📈 With training: calls through rubble, a numbed limb, glass shattered or bolts loosened on one chosen object, a silenced area or a blocked sound Quirk, and foes dropped to their knees with nausea.
⚠️ Ear protection and soft materials blunt it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as vibrating notes wear on your throat and inner ears.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), Yo Shindo (Vibrate).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Perception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rattle Call, Wall-Hum Echo
🛡️ Resists: sonic
Echo Pulse Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the voice sends tremor through air and solids; jaw and ears read echoes. New adult user: shouts rattle an adult a few meters off, crack glass up close; a hum maps a room through walls or smoke. More needs techniques. Limits: ear protection and soft materials blunt it; heavy use shakes their skull, dulls hearing, rasps the throat; din scrambles echoes. Quirk Strain: light: rattling shout, echo hum; moderate: bone-conducted call, numbing grasp, resonance hum; heavy: counter-tone, corridor chord; severe: signature nausea pulse, bracing drone. Fusion: Sound plus Vibration, each about half single-nature range and force; no kilometer shouts, sound leaps or fault quakes; only it echolocates, loosens bolts, resonance-shatters one object, cancels sound, counters sound Quirks, nauseates foes. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed nausea or shattering is assault and property damage; listening through private walls without cause is unlawful surveillance. Look: mouth ripple.
abilities: Rattle Call
Wall-Hum Echo

Adaptation Quirk.name: Adaptation Quirk
Adaptation Quirk.description:
🦎 Your body changes itself to survive whatever is hurting it, and you don't get to choose how.

🌱 At the start the first blow, burn or breath of gas lands normally; by your next turn your body grows one answer to it: a layered hide that halves those hits, or gill slits and filtering lungs that breathe water, smoke or gas.
📈 With training: hold two adaptations (three at mastery), eyes and ears that adapt to dark, smoke and din, grip pads and webbing for walls, falls and floods, carrying people through fire or flood, clinches a foe can't break, and calling up a trained adaptation from memory.
⏳ Adaptations fade about ten minutes after the danger ends, and a new threat replaces the oldest one. Training one many times makes it come faster and stronger, never permanent.
⚠️ Fast attacks land before it forms, it never copies or resists Quirks themselves or heals wounds fast, and under heavy Strain your body overcorrects into the wrong change.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, because your body picks its own changes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Survival +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Weathered Hide, Filter Lung
Adaptation Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: threats and hazards reshape the body unbidden: hide, gills, fire- or shock-proof skin, filter lungs, night pupils, cold fat, slow blood, grip pads. The first hit, burn or breath lands; the change forms by next turn's end. Holds one (trained two, master three), newest replacing oldest; fades ten minutes after danger; training: faster, stronger, never permanent. Limits: the body picks; fast attacks beat it; never on command unexposed; physical only: no Quirk copying or resisting, fast healing, chosen animal parts; aids others only indirectly (shield, carry, breathe for them). Quirk Strain: light: reactive hide, lung shift; moderate: adapted senses, self-exposure, terrain shifts; heavy: hazard rescue, clinch; severe: signature surge, memory recall; heavy Strain overcorrects (wrong trait, stiff growths). Type: Transformation. Law: involuntary adaptation is lawful; public provoking, or unlicensed striking or pinning with it, is assault. Look: plates, gills, pads.
abilities: Weathered Hide
Filter Lung

Second-Year at U.A..name: Second-Year at U.A.
Second-Year at U.A..description: 📚 You are a second-year at U.A. Academy: new first-years arrived in April and look up to your year.
Second-Year at U.A..traitNarrativeEffects: Since April of the second year the character and everyone who entered U.A. with them are second-years: Class 1-A is now Class 2-A, Class 1-B is Class 2-B, and the other courses moved up the same way. A new first-year class arrived this April. Never call the character or their classmates first-years.

Third-Year at U.A..name: Third-Year at U.A.
Third-Year at U.A..description: 🎓 You are a third-year at U.A. Academy: the senior students, the ones the younger years watch.
Third-Year at U.A..traitNarrativeEffects: Since April of the third year the character and everyone who entered U.A. with them are third-years, the academy's senior class (Class 1-A is now Class 3-A, 1-B is 3-B). Never call the character or their classmates first-years or second-years.

U.A. Graduate.name: U.A. Graduate
U.A. Graduate.description: 🌸 You graduated from U.A. Academy with your class.
U.A. Graduate.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has graduated from U.A. Academy with the class they entered with. They are an alumnus, not a student: classmates are former classmates, teachers are former teachers, and the U.A. timetable no longer applies to them.

Custom Quirk.name: Custom Quirk
Custom Quirk.description:
✍️ A Quirk of your own design. 🎮 Single player only.

To make it work, do BOTH steps:
1️⃣ Before you generate your background, describe your Quirk in the background box: what it does, what it looks like and its limits. What it costs you is the Drawback you pick next, so leave the cost out. Your background's Quirk paragraph becomes its permanent record.
2️⃣ Your Quirk starts with NO techniques. Once the game starts, ask the in-game Studio to create your Quirk's abilities from that description. Until you do, you have no Quirk abilities to use.

🧬 It is one Quirk, as everyone in this world is born with one: if your idea blends two powers, describe them as a single Quirk and Studio builds it that way.
⚖️ It keeps the Quirk Type, Strength and Drawback you pick, and Quirk Strain works as for any Quirk.

📈 Grants: Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10
Custom Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's Quirk is their own design, recorded in the Quirk paragraph of their Background. Use exactly what that paragraph says it does, at the selected Quirk Strength, with the selected Drawback as its only cost (a cost the paragraph names is that Drawback's) and the selected Quirk Type, and nothing beyond it; techniques the player adds later through Studio are part of it. It is one Quirk: it never copies, steals or stacks other Quirks. Quirk Strain applies as for any Quirk. If the character chose Quirkless, this does not apply.

Duskglass Quirk.name: Duskglass Quirk
Duskglass Quirk.description:
🌑 Your shadow sets into smoked black glass that casts its own shade, and you step from shard to shard through it.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Shadow Manipulation and Glass: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you bind a target in glass-edged shadow bands about five meters away and flick smoked glass beads that knock people back.
📈 With training: shadow ribbons that lower people to safety, smoked panes that cast shade even in sunlight, a circling halo of blade-shards you step between, light-drinking glass armor, and shattering a shard to pin the shadows of everyone near it.
⚠️ Without a standing shard your shadow reaches only about five meters and bright light thins it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as glass splinters press under the skin of your palms.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Infiltration +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Umbral Band, Smoked Bead Toss
Duskglass Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: shadow and palm-grown glass fuse into shade-casting smoked glass. A new adult user binds or shadow-steps within five meters and grows a few thin panes, beads or shards a scene; more needs techniques. Limits: shardless shadow needs real shade; bright light thins it; hard hits on weak points shatter panes; plain windows never answer. Quirk Strain: light: bind, bead toss; moderate: rescue ribbon, pane, shard ring; heavy: armor, shadow-pinning shatter, spike bed; severe: signature relay, bracing a room, awakened uses. Fusion: Shadow Manipulation plus Glass, each half-scale (no block-wide shadow, no building-scale glass); only the fusion steps between shards' shade in sight, orbits glass as blades, wears it as light-drinking armor, shatters it to pin shadows. Type: Emitter. Law: the user clears public shards; shard-stepping into closed buildings is burglary. Look: glossy-edged shadow.
abilities: Umbral Band
Smoked Bead Toss

Arm Cannon Quirk.name: Arm Cannon Quirk
Arm Cannon Quirk.description:
💥 You turn one forearm into a cannon of bone and hardened muscle.

🌱 At the start you fire quick calcium rounds, or hold a glowing, whining charge that knocks an adult down from across a street.
📈 With training: door breaching, recoil jumps and fall braking, rescue ropes and grapple lines, blunt stun rounds, signal flares, a street-wide salvo.
⚠️ The cannon is useless for fine work until it turns back into a hand.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as stronger shots jar your shoulder and throw you backward.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Marksmanship +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Bore Snap, Braced Charge
Arm Cannon Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: one forearm (side fixed at creation) becomes a heavy bone-and-muscle cannon. A new adult user fires reserve-made calcium rounds about twenty meters, or a few-second charge that drops an adult across a street; special rounds and reach need training. Limits: no grip or fine work; reverting takes about three seconds. Straight shots can hit people beyond. Ropes, grapples, harnesses are carried gear. Quirk Strain: light: snap shot, flare; moderate: basic charge, rope launch, recoil jump, blunt round; heavy: breaching shot; severe: signature, sustained battery, awakened techniques. Type: Transformation (also fits Mutant). Law: outside self-defense or licensed duty, shooting people is assault, breaching property damage; strays are on the user. Look: a Mutant's forearm stays thick.
abilities: Bore Snap
Braced Charge

Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.name: Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk
Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.description:
🔥 You make ice from your right side and fire from your left.

🌱 At the start you raise waist-high ice cover a few meters wide, freeze five meters of floor or send a short flame jet.
📈 With training: safe restraints, ice slides, careful thawing, larger walls, concentrated fire, cold flames circulated through your body.
⚠️ Ice chills and stiffens you; fire overheats you, and alternating restores balance without restoring stamina or healing injuries.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Overheating, as either half shifts your body temperature.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Shoto Todoroki's Half-Cold Half-Hot. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Cooling vest

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Ice Sill, Leftward Flare
🛡️ Resists: fire, cold
Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: ice from the right side, fire from the left. Start: waist-high barrier a few meters wide, 5 m floor ice or a short jet; bigger attacks and combined circulation need training.
Limits: ice chills into movement-slowing frost and stiffness; long fire overheats; the other half restores balance, not stamina or injuries. No control of other fires or floating ice. Ice melts, breaks, blocks allies; focused fire burns people and buildings.
Quirk Strain: light: small cover, short jet; moderate: restraints, sliding, thawing, alternating attacks; heavy: big ice surge; severe: pressure blast, long focused fire, circulating cold flames.
Drawback: built in, the canon Overheating.
Canon: Shoto Todoroki's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public combat or road blocking needs a license; freezing or burning outside lawful defense is assault.
Look: ice right, flames left; own hair, eyes, scars.
abilities: Ice Sill
Leftward Flare

Zero Gravity Quirk.name: Zero Gravity Quirk
Zero Gravity Quirk.description:
🫧 You make solid people and objects weightless with your fingertip pads.

🌱 At the start you float one adult or loose rubble by touching with all five pads of one hand, up to roughly three tonnes total, and join your pads to release.
📈 With training: throws, rescue loads, tethered travel, debris attacks, awakening that spreads through touching targets and lowers them gently.
⚠️ You need pushes or tethers to steer floating solids; heavy loads and self-floating cause nausea and vomiting, and release can cause falls.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as heavy loads and self-floating upset your stomach.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Palm Weight Release, Weightless Shoulder Throw
Zero Gravity Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: floats solid targets, people too, touched with all five pads of one hand; first-year cap about 3 tonnes at once; near-cap loads and self-floating cause nausea.
Limits: contact only (spread through touching targets is for awakening); pads together release. No steering or propulsion: needs pushes, ropes, handholds. Air and flames cannot float. Release aloft risks a dangerous fall; fast targets need a safe catch. Vomiting and exhaustion halt work.
Quirk Strain: light: small load, short throw; moderate: suspension, tethered travel, rescue hauling, rubble weapon; heavy: debris shower; severe: big falling load, repeated self-float, contact spread, mass descent.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Ochaco Uraraka's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public combat needs a license; unlawful floating is assault; user answers for falling loads.
Look: pink fingertip pads.
abilities: Palm Weight Release
Weightless Shoulder Throw

Engine Quirk.name: Engine Quirk
Engine Quirk.description:
🏎️ You have engines in your calves that power fast runs and hard kicks.

🌱 At the start you run fifty meters in a few seconds on clear ground, with traction, braking room and time to notice hazards.
📈 With training: controlled turns, interceptions, passenger carries, short overdrive, longer high-speed runs with stronger regrown exhausts.
⚠️ You need orange juice; blocked pipes, fizzy drinks or heat stall your engines until you clear and cool them, and speed gives no armor or faster thought.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Cooldown, as overdrive temporarily stalls your engines.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Tenya Iida's Engine. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Running +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Calf Motor Dash, Driven Heel Strike
Engine Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: calf engines with exhausts. Start: 50 m in a few seconds on clear level ground, a running kick; high gears, sharp turns, safe passengers need training.
Limits: needs fuel (orange juice helps); soda or blocked exhausts stall it; overuse overheats; a stall needs cooling and cleared pipes. Needs traction, braking room, a visible route; speed gives no protection or faster thought. Long overdrive needs stronger exhausts regrown in prior training; learning it is not enough.
Quirk Strain: light: short dash, restrained kick; moderate: interception, capture, passenger run, throttle feint; heavy: 10-second overdrive; severe: max kick, sustained high gear, cooled distance run.
Drawback: built in, the canon Cooldown.
Canon: Tenya Iida's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: crowd racing and public combat need a license; user answers for collisions and exhaust burns.
Look: calf exhaust pipes.
abilities: Calf Motor Dash
Driven Heel Strike

Frog Quirk.name: Frog Quirk
Frog Quirk.description:
🐸 You have frog legs, wall grip, quick swimming and a long tongue.
