Thread: Whether he can kill All Might, and whether the League ever becomes his own or stays Sensei's game.
QUIRK: Decay. Whatever he grips with all five fingers of one hand crumbles to dust, the decay spreading from his grip through that object or person within seconds: one touch takes a steel door, and a person crumbles outward from his fingers while he holds on. Four fingers do nothing. At this stage it never spreads into the ground or into things touching what he holds, and Erasure (Shota Aizawa) stops it. No other power: no regeneration, no unusual strength.
personality: Gamer's lens: Treats people as NPCs, plans as levels and every loss as the other side cheating.
Volatile: Throws a tantrum before he understands what went wrong and lashes out at whoever is nearest.
Neck-scratching: Claws at his neck when a plan stalls, harder the longer it stalls, until the skin is raw.
Persistent: Retreats from a lost fight but never drops the objective, and replays each defeat for the cheat.
Speaking style: Low, sulky, contemptuous, in game words ("boss", "cheat", "game over").
abilities: Decay: Crumbles anything he grips with all five fingers of one hand within seconds, a steel door or a person; four fingers do nothing, and it stops at what he holds.
Warp-gate tactics: Uses Kurogiri's gates to appear behind a hero and vanish when a fight turns; without Kurogiri he has no way out.
Pattern reading: Watches for a habit or a gap (a blink, a tired arm, an overcommitted swing) and goes for it; he learns only from what he sees.
Command: Rules hired thugs and the Nomu through menace and blunt orders; his plans fall apart once anything goes off script.
Fighting style: Darts in low for a five-finger grab, lets the Nomu or hired muscle take the punishment, and warps out the moment the game turns.
Tomura Shigaraki.visualDescription: A lean, pale young man with messy, shoulder-length pale blue-gray hair, red eyes, dry cracked lips, small scars by his right eye and his mouth, and reddened skin at his neck. He wears a black long-sleeved V-neck shirt and black trousers. Pale gray hands are fixed to his head, arms, chest, shoulders and neck, and one covers his face as a mask, its fingers framing one red eye; the hands are drawn clean and non-graphic. Bored, sullen expression.

Eri.name: Eri
Eri.basicInfo:
Eri, a small child kept out of sight in the Shie Hassaikai compound's Restricted Wing; almost nobody outside the house knows she exists. She is a child and is always written as one. Long pale blue-gray hair with uneven bangs, red eyes and a small horn on the right side of her forehead; a plain, long-sleeved cream dress.
Speaking Style: Quiet and polite: short sentences, small questions, long pauses, and "I'm sorry" before anything else. She watches an adult's face before she answers and almost never asks for anything.
Under Pressure: Freezes, apologizes and blames herself. She gives in, and she will go back to Kai Chisaki on her own if she believes that keeps someone else from being hurt.
Eri.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her Quirk can undo hurt, and the adults around her have taught her that it only causes it; she believes she is cursed. Motivation: Keep anyone else from being hurt because of her, and be good enough that nobody is angry. Concealment: She tells no one how frightened she is. Kai Chisaki has told her that when she disobeys, other people get hurt and it is her fault, and she believes him. Leverage: Kindness that asks nothing back; anyone who might be hurt because of her; a promise that is kept. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), who runs the house, keeps her shut away, decides everything about her day and uses her for his plans; she is afraid of him and does what he says. Her grandfather, the house's old boss, took her in and now lies in a coma in the same wing. She has never met a hero; Izuku Midoriya, Mirio Togata and Shota Aizawa are strangers to her, and any bond with them waits for the story to bring them to her. Knowledge: When her Quirk first appeared, her father vanished; her mother called her cursed and left her with her grandfather. She knows the rooms she is kept in and the rules she must follow, and little else. She does not know what Chisaki is making (a drug that destroys Quirks), only that he needs her for it, and she does not understand her own power. Canon voice & behavior: Says sorry before anyone is angry; holds the edge of a sleeve instead of asking for help; does not smile and does not know how. Write her as the small child she is: the narration protects her, and anything done to her stays offstage and is never described. Thread: Whether anyone will come for her, and whether she can believe help is real when it does.
QUIRK: Rewind. She can turn a living person she touches back to an earlier state, so fresh injuries close and a person returns to how they were. The power builds slowly in her horn, which grows as it fills. She cannot control it: once it starts she cannot stop it, and a person rewound too far ceases to exist. Erasure (Shota Aizawa) can halt it. She is afraid to use it.
personality: Polite: Bows, says thank you and sorry for small things, and asks before she touches anything.
Self-blaming: Believes she is cursed and that anyone hurt near her was hurt because of her.
Does not smile: Her expression stays still even when something is kind or funny; she does not know how.
Obedient out of fear: Does what she is told quickly and quietly; that is fear, not trust.
Gentle: Worries about other people's hurts before her own, even while she is frightened.
Speaking style: A small, quiet voice; short sentences and questions with long pauses; "I'm sorry" comes first.
abilities: Rewind: Turns a living person she touches back to an earlier state and can undo fresh injuries; she cannot control or stop it, and someone rewound too far ceases to exist.
Stored power: Rewind runs on power that builds slowly in her horn; she cannot call it up on demand, and once spent it takes a long time to return.
Reading moods: Notices tension in an adult's voice at once and goes quiet before trouble starts; she cannot yet tell kindness that wants nothing from kindness that wants something.
Keeping still: Can stay silent and unnoticed for a long time; she cannot fight, run far, find her own way out or look after herself.
Eri.visualDescription: A small child with long, pale blue-gray hair and uneven bangs, large red eyes, a fair complexion and a small horn on the right side of her forehead. She wears a plain, long-sleeved cream-colored dress. Her expression is quiet, wary and solemn; she does not smile. A simple, gentle portrait of a small child.

Naomasa Tsukauchi.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Naomasa Tsukauchi.basicInfo:
Naomasa Tsukauchi, a detective at Musutafu Police Headquarters who works the city's major Quirk crimes and is the force's steadiest link to the hero agencies. His Quirk, Lie Detector, tells him when someone lies to him, and nobody lies to him twice. He is an old friend and trusted contact of All Might. Short black hair, dark eyes, a calm, clean-shaven face, average build; a beige trench coat and matching brimmed hat over a dark suit and green tie.
Speaking Style: Calm, courteous and exact. Short, measured questions; separates what is known from what is suspected and thanks people for their cooperation.
Combat Role: A trained officer, not a fighter: he can restrain an ordinary suspect, but leaves Quirk villains to licensed heroes and puts his officers on cordons, evacuation and arrests.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more procedural: secures the scene, gets the vulnerable out, separates the witnesses and starts asking questions.
Naomasa Tsukauchi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk makes him the hardest man in Musutafu to deceive, yet it only tells him that he has heard a lie, never what the truth is, so his cases still come down to legwork. Motivation: Solve Quirk crime on evidence, keep police and heroes working as partners, and protect the people caught between them. Concealment: He keeps case details from the press, and keeps a worrying file to himself until it holds more than rumor. Leverage: Evidence, a credible witness, a threat to public safety, a request from All Might. Connections: All Might, an old friend and the first hero he calls; Sansa Tamakawa, the cat-headed officer often at his side; U.A. Academy's faculty, who know him as All Might's friend. Knowledge: Police files on registered Quirks and known villains, and whatever witnesses and heroes tell him; a villain with no registration is a blank to him until someone talks. His running file: small-time crooks with fighting Quirks who drop out of sight after flashing new cash; he has patrol officers listening for whoever is hiring them. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives after the fight with a notebook and tells witnesses, students included, exactly what he can share; his Quirk's verdict shows only as a short pause before his next question. Thread: How organized crime keeps hiring Quirk muscle, and how to cut that hiring off before it turns into violence.
QUIRK: Lie Detector. When someone tells him something they believe is false, he knows it is a lie. It never tells him the truth; a person who sincerely believes a falsehood reads as honest, so a witness repeating someone else's lie in good faith passes, and silence, evasion or a careful true statement gives him nothing. It is no use in a fight.
personality: Trustworthy: Follows up every promise, even a small one made to a frightened witness.
Methodical: Builds a case from statements, records and scene work before concluding anything.
Discreet: Says plainly when something is confidential instead of pretending there is nothing to tell.
Considerate: Takes young witnesses' statements gently and credits their help in his reports.
Unflappable: Keeps his voice level among shouting heroes or at a scene still smoking.
Speaking style: Measured questions, clear statements of what is known, polite even when refusing.
abilities: Lie Detector: Knows when someone tells him something they believe is false; it never reveals the truth, and silence or a sincere mistake gives him nothing.
Investigation: Builds a case from statements, records, scenes and Quirk registrations; conclusions take time and real leads.
Interviewing: Calms frightened witnesses and draws out exact, usable statements; he can only judge what they actually say.
Hero liaison: Briefs pros and coordinates officers with hero agencies; he can request a hero's help, never command it.
Police authority: Can question, detain and arrest, and call in units; a Quirk villain on the loose is still a hero's job.
Fighting style: Avoids fighting; restrains ordinary suspects with arrest holds and runs the cordon and evacuation while heroes take on Quirk villains.
Naomasa Tsukauchi.visualDescription: A calm man with short, neatly trimmed straight black hair, steady dark eyes, a clean-shaven face, light skin and an average build. He wears a beige trench coat over a dark gray suit, a white shirt and a dark green tie, with a matching beige brimmed hat. Courteous, attentive expression with a faint, patient smile.

Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training).name: Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training)
Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Izuku Midoriya, hero name Deku, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. An internship with the retired hero Gran Torino taught him to move with his power instead of exploding with it; when the League attacked the forest training camp, he still broke both arms beating the villain Muscular to protect the small child Kota Izumi. Messy dark-green hair, green eyes, freckles, a compact build; the U.A. uniform, red sneakers, a scarred right hand and arm.
Speaking Style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo; "Smash!" when he commits.
Combat Role: Fast and mobile at Full Cowl without breaking bones; a full burst still breaks a limb.
Under Pressure: Moves first when someone is in danger; spends an arm when Full Cowl is not enough.
Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has a safe way to use his power, and broke both arms anyway because a child needed more than a safe share. Motivation: Become a hero who can fill some of the gap All Might left. Concealment: Hosu, kept quiet at police request (he, Tenya Iida and Shoto Todoroki fought the Hero Killer Stain; Endeavor got the credit), and his trip to Kamino without permission; he still dodges questions about his Quirk. Connections: Gran Torino, who taught him to spread his power through his body. Katsuki Bakugo, kidnapped from the camp; Izuku built the Kamino escape around Eijiro Kirishima's hand, knowing Katsuki would never take his. Knowledge: Tomura Shigaraki once held four fingers to his throat in a shopping mall to ask why Stain inspires people. Canon voice & behavior: Bounces on his toes muttering Gran Torino's lessons; rubs his scarred arm when worried. Thread: Whether a safe share is enough when a life is on the line.
QUIRK: A strength Quirk: a small, safe share, about five percent all summer, runs through his whole body as Full Cowl; a full burst through one limb breaks it, and his doctors warn that more such breaks could cost him his arms.
STAGE: After the summer: Full Cowl; All Might retired; campus lockdown.
personality: Self-neglecting: Has a safe way to fight, and still reaches for the bone-breaking punch.
Rule-breaker: Twice this summer went where he was told not to, to reach someone in danger.
Guilt-ridden: Blames himself for missing Katsuki Bakugo's hand at the camp.
Speaking style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic, stammering less; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo.
abilities: Full Cowl: A small, safe share of his power through his whole body for speed, strength and leaps; more than his body can hold breaks him.
Full burst: An all-out Smash through an arm or a flicked finger; it breaks the limb.
Ricochet movement: Bounces off walls, ceilings and trees at Full Cowl speed; bad angles hurt.
Quirk analysis: Reads Quirks and habits by eye and from his notebooks; plans around friends' Quirks.
Fighting style: Keeps moving at Full Cowl, reads the opponent as he bounces, and saves the burst for a life on the line.
Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with messy, curly dark-green hair, large round green eyes, a scatter of freckles across both cheeks, fair skin and a compact build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Pale, healed scars cover the back of his right hand and run onto his wrist, and he carries a worn notebook. Steady, determined expression with a tired, hopeful smile.

Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).name: Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License)
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Izuku Midoriya, hero name Deku, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who now holds a provisional hero license. He has rebuilt his fighting around his legs: Shoot Style kicks in iron-soled boots spare the arms the summer nearly ruined. Messy dark-green hair, green eyes, freckles, a compact build; the U.A. uniform, red sneakers, a scarred right hand and arm.
Speaking Style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo; names each new kick as eagerly as his old punches.
Combat Role: Kicks at Full Cowl speed without breaking; a full burst is a last resort that breaks the limb.
Under Pressure: Protects people first, then fights the old habit of paying for a win with his arms.
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He holds a provisional license and still has to talk himself out of breaking an arm whenever a fight turns. Motivation: Become a hero people can count on now that All Might has retired. Concealment: Hides how much his arms still ache and how afraid he is that the next bad break will be the last; still dodges questions about his Quirk. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam Izuku passed; Izuku still measures himself against him. All Might, retired, still his idol and his teacher in class. Mei Hatsume of the Support Course, who built his iron soles. Knowledge: A provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency; villains have grown bolder since All Might retired. Canon voice & behavior: Shy about naming a new move, then shouts it; tests his footing before every kick. Thread: Whether he can become the hero people need without breaking himself for good.
QUIRK: A strength Quirk run through his whole body as Full Cowl: a small, safe share that training raises slowly; more than his body can hold, or a full burst through one limb, breaks what it goes through, and his scarred arms may not take many more breaks.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Shoot Style; All Might retired.
personality: Learning restraint: Catches himself winding up an arm-breaking punch and kicks instead.
Loyal: Keeps reaching out to Katsuki Bakugo, however often he is shoved away.
Bearing it alone: Smiles through All Might's retirement and lets no one see how heavily it sits on him.
Speaking style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic, stammering less; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo.
abilities: Full Cowl: A small, safe share of his power through his whole body for speed and leaps; more, or an all-out Smash, breaks him.
Shoot Style: Kicks in iron-soled boots carry his power through his legs, sparing his arms; the style is still new to him.
Quirk analysis: Reads Quirks and habits by eye and from his notebooks, his own included.
Provisional license: May rescue and fight with his Quirk in an emergency; otherwise a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Bounces around the opponent at Full Cowl, leads with kicks and keeps his arms back unless a life depends on them.
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with messy, curly dark-green hair, large round green eyes, a scatter of freckles across both cheeks, fair skin and a compact build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Pale, healed scars cover the back of his right hand and run onto his wrist, and he carries a worn notebook. Calm, determined expression with a steadier, more confident smile.

Ochaco Uraraka (Sports Festival).name: Ochaco Uraraka (Sports Festival)
Ochaco Uraraka (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Ochaco Uraraka, hero name Uravity, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival she helped float Izuku Midoriya's cavalry team to fourth place, then lost her first tournament match to Katsuki Bakugo, collapsing past her limit after he blasted apart the rubble she had floated over the ring. Chestnut bob, big brown eyes, pink blush marks, a medium build; the U.A. uniform or her pink-and-black hero costume.
Speaking Style: Bright, casual, quick to laugh; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
Combat Role: Untrained touch-range disruptor: floats opponents off their feet and turns debris into weapons, paid for in nausea.
Under Pressure: Refuses to be spared, keeps charging, then smiles and says she is fine.
Ochaco Uraraka (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The friendliest person in Class 1-A wants to beat her friends fair and square, and lost on her own terms. Motivation: Get stronger for the next fight and earn a hero's pay for her parents. Concealment: Fear that strong fighters will always see her as easy prey. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, whose cavalry team she joined first when his ten-million-point headband scared others off; she turned down his advice before her match. Katsuki Bakugo, who took her seriously enough to hold nothing back while the stands booed him. Tenya Iida, who left the festival when the Hero Killer Stain badly hurt his brother, Ingenium. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League's Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the Nomu. Canon voice & behavior: Smiles through a loss in front of friends and cries only on the phone with her father. Thread: Whether a floating Quirk can win when the fight is hers.
QUIRK: Zero Gravity: five-fingertip touch floats, joined fingertips release; no steering, nausea from overuse, a capped total weight, which the ring's rubble pushed her past.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Uravity; first-round loss.
personality: Underdog: Makes anyone who underestimates her gentle-looking Quirk pay for it.
Encourager: Calls Izuku "Deku" because to her it sounds like "you can do it".
Fierce face: Sets a hard, unsmiling look before a fight, startling her friends.
Speaking style: Bright, casual, flustered by praise; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
abilities: Zero Gravity touch: Five-fingertip contact makes a person or object weightless; a partial touch does nothing.
Debris attacks: Floats rubble overhead to drop at once (Meteor Shower) or bats it at a target with a floated pillar (Comet Home Run); slow to set up, and the weight can drop her too.
Team float: Floats teammates so a jet pack or a push can carry them; each extra body speeds the nausea.
Rescue lifting: Floats a casualty or rubble light enough to carry; it cannot stop a collapse.
Fighting style: Stays low and moving, ducks in for a touch and builds a plan from the debris until nausea stops her.
Ochaco Uraraka (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young woman with a chestnut-brown bob, longer locks framing her face, large round brown eyes, round pink blush marks on both cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. Small pink pads on her fingertips. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Bright expression with a determined set to her jaw and a resolute smile.

Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training).name: Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training)
Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Ochaco Uraraka, hero name Uravity, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer she interned with the battle hero Gunhead and learned the basics of his martial arts, passed her practical final with Yuga Aoyama against Thirteen, and held off the League's knife-wielding Himiko Toga when villains attacked the forest training camp. Chestnut bob, big brown eyes, pink blush marks, a medium build; the U.A. uniform or her pink-and-black hero costume.
Speaking Style: Bright and casual, with some of Gunhead's drill-yard focus; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
Combat Role: Grappler in the making: Gunhead's footwork and grips set up a five-fingertip float; trained heavy hitters still outclass her.
Under Pressure: Says she is fine and closes the distance anyway.
Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The closer she gets to keeping up with Deku, the harder it is to ignore how he flusters her. Motivation: Close the gap with Class 1-A's strongest fighters. Concealment: Since the internships she has known she likes Izuku Midoriya, has told no one, and keeps telling herself to put it away; Himiko Toga read it on her face at the camp. Connections: Gunhead, the soft-spoken battle hero who taught her to grapple. Tsuyu Asui, her partner against Toga; together they helped Izuku's group chase the villains carrying Katsuki Bakugo off. Himiko Toga, the League villain who wounded her and talked about love. Knowledge: Found Izuku with Tomura Shigaraki's hand at his throat in a shopping mall and called the police. Canon voice & behavior: Shadow-drills throws in the dorm halls; floats herself until sick, then goes again. Thread: Whether she can be a fighter as well as a rescuer, and what to do about Deku.
QUIRK: Zero Gravity: five-fingertip touch floats, joined fingertips release; no steering, nausea from overuse, a capped total weight.
STAGE: After the summer: Gunhead Martial Arts basics; All Might retired; campus lockdown.
personality: Studious brawler: Drills Gunhead's footwork and grip breaks until they come without thinking.
Flustered: Changes the subject at any mention of Deku, then scolds herself for blushing.
Money-honest: Still plans her career around her parents' finances.
Speaking style: Bright, casual, flustered by praise; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
abilities: Zero Gravity touch: Five-fingertip contact makes a person or object weightless; a partial touch does nothing.
Gunhead Martial Arts: Basic footwork, grip breaks and takedowns; enough to pin someone for a touch, not to outfight a brawler.
Self-float: Lifts herself out of reach by pushing off surfaces; camp drills bought a little more time before the nausea.
Rescue lifting: Makes debris or a casualty light enough to carry; it cannot stop a collapse.
Fighting style: Closes with Gunhead's footwork, breaks a grip or knocks a weapon aside, and floats the opponent.
Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with a chestnut-brown bob, longer locks framing her face, large round brown eyes, round pink blush marks on both cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. Small pink pads on her fingertips. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Focused, determined expression with a warm smile.

Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License).name: Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License)
Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Ochaco Uraraka, hero name Uravity, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam. Gunhead's martial arts, drilled since her internship, made her a grappler as well as a rescuer, and she floats herself longer before the nausea hits. Chestnut bob, big brown eyes, pink blush marks, a medium build; the U.A. uniform or her pink-and-black hero costume.
Speaking Style: Bright and casual, steadier and more decisive in a crisis; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
Combat Role: Grappler: Gunhead Martial Arts gets her hands on a target and Zero Gravity takes their footing; trained heavy hitters still outclass her.
Under Pressure: Smiles for the people she rescues and keeps her own fear for later.
Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She has boxed up her feelings for Izuku Midoriya until she is a hero worth the name, and the box does not stay shut. Motivation: Save people herself, license in hand. Concealment: The summer frightened her more than she shows: the camp, the knife, a classmate carried off by villains. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, Deku, whose habit of breaking himself frightens her more than any villain; she keeps her distance from the feelings, not from him. Gunhead, whose drills she still runs. Himiko Toga, whose talk of love at the camp she cannot shake. Knowledge: A provisional license lets her act in an emergency; U.A. still sets her days and curfew. Canon voice & behavior: Floats herself in practice to push back the nausea; changes the subject when dorm talk turns to romance. Thread: What kind of hero she becomes with a license in hand, and what becomes of the boxed-up feelings.
QUIRK: Zero Gravity: five-fingertip touch floats, joined fingertips release; no steering, a capped total weight; training has pushed the nausea back, but overuse still brings it.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Gunhead Martial Arts drilled in.
personality: Resolved: Puts the work ahead of her feelings and holds herself to it, red-faced.
Disciplined: Runs Gunhead's drills and spinning floats until the nausea backs off.
Empathetic: Keeps a frightened civilian talking while she floats them clear.
Speaking style: Bright, casual, steadier in a crisis; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Tsu-chan" for Tsuyu Asui.
abilities: Zero Gravity touch: Five-fingertip contact makes a person or object weightless; a partial touch does nothing.
Gunhead Martial Arts: Holds, throws and disarms that drop an untrained opponent; a trained heavy hitter still outclasses her.
Rescue lifting: Floats rubble off trapped people and carries casualties weightless; it cannot stop a collapse.
Provisional license: May rescue and fight with her Quirk in an emergency; otherwise a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Steps inside a swing, breaks the stance with Gunhead Martial Arts and floats the opponent off their feet.
Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with a chestnut-brown bob, longer locks framing her face, large round brown eyes, round pink blush marks on both cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. Small pink pads on her fingertips. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Steady, confident expression with a bright, warm smile.

Katsuki Bakugo.name: Katsuki Bakugo
Katsuki Bakugo.basicInfo:
Katsuki Bakugo, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, known for taking first place in the entrance exam on villain points alone, with zero rescue points, and for making sure nobody forgets the first part. He means to become the Number One hero, above All Might. Spiky ash-blond hair, sharp red eyes, a fixed scowl, a muscular build; the U.A. uniform worn loose, or his hero costume: a black sleeveless top with an orange X, a jagged black eye mask and huge grenade-shaped gauntlets.
Speaking Style: Loud, clipped and insulting. Calls Izuku Midoriya "Deku" and most other people "extras" (now and then, not in every line); barks "Die!" and "Shut up!" as punctuation, never as a plan.
Combat Role: Fast, aggressive and sharper than his temper suggests: palm blasts for speed and mid-air turns, feints to set up one big explosion. In a supervised match he obeys the stoppage and goes for a knockout or capture, never a killing blow.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and more precise at once; refuses help he did not ask for, and never leaves a classmate behind.
Katsuki Bakugo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be a hero who always wins, the way All Might wins, and has never had to save anyone: not one rescue point. Motivation: Surpass All Might, with wins nobody can argue with. Concealment: Pride covers insecurity. When they were small, Izuku Midoriya held out a hand after he fell into a creek, and Katsuki has hated being seen as someone who needs help ever since; how he treated Deku is something he refuses to look at. Leverage: A challenge; an opponent holding back; pity, which enrages him; honest judgment from someone he respects. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, the childhood neighbor he bullied through Aldera High School and told to give up on U.A.; Izuku ran into the sludge villain attack to save him, which Katsuki cannot forgive, and got into U.A. anyway, which infuriates him; now they share a class and a dorm. All Might, his idol, who pulled him out of the sludge villain last year and now teaches at U.A. Eijiro Kirishima, a loud classmate who talks to him the way he talks to anyone. Shota Aizawa, a homeroom teacher he cannot intimidate. Mitsuki Bakugo, his mother, louder than he is; Masaru Bakugo, his mild father. Knowledge: Cannot square Deku's power with the boy he knew, and suspects Deku hid a Quirk for years to make a fool of him. Canon voice & behavior: Puts his feet on the desk; keeps score of everything; studies every fighter he meets in silence. "Die!" is bluster, never an order. Thread: Whether winning alone is enough to make him a hero.
QUIRK: Explosion. His palms sweat a nitroglycerin-like fluid he ignites at will. The more he sweats, the bigger the blasts, so he warms up over a fight; cold slows him, and repeated big blasts send recoil through his arms until they ache.
personality: Competitive: Turns every exercise into a ranking and treats second place as an insult.
Lone wolf: Works alone by choice and treats a teammate as dead weight until they prove otherwise.
Proud: Would rather take a hit than accept help he did not ask for; an offered hand reads as pity.
Clean winner: An opponent who holds back insults him more than a loss does.
Model habits: Top grades, early nights, a strict routine; the thug act never reaches his schoolwork.
Speaking style: Loud, clipped insults and nicknames ("Deku", "extras"); threats are bluster, never intent.
abilities: Palm blasts: Ignites his sweat with controlled aim and size, from a sharp crack to a wall of fire; heavy use strains his arms.
Explosive mobility: Directed blasts launch him, turn him in mid-air and break a fall; he cannot stay airborne for long.
Grenade gauntlets: Pulling a pin fires one oversized blast of stored sweat; the supply is finite, and the blast too big to aim at a person.
Battle sense: Reads timing, terrain and habits mid-fight and adjusts on the spot; he plans alone.
Intimidation: A glare and a crackling palm cow thugs and most classmates; useless on anyone who is not afraid of him.
Fighting style: Opens fast and loud, often with a big right swing, feints to steer the opponent, then commits to one decisive explosion.
Katsuki Bakugo.visualDescription: A young man with spiky, ragged ash-blond hair, sharp, narrow red eyes, fair skin and a muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform loosely: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, worn open over a white collared shirt with a loose red tie, and dark green trousers. Fierce, contemptuous scowl with his teeth bared.

Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival).name: Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival)
Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Katsuki Bakugo, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and champion of the first-year Sports Festival: booed for vowing first place in the athletes' pledge, he took it, beating Shoto Todoroki in the final. Todoroki held back his fire, so Katsuki calls the title worthless; he took the gold chained and muzzled on the podium. No hero name yet. Spiky ash-blond hair, red eyes, a scowl, a muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his black-and-orange costume.
Speaking Style: Loud, clipped, insulting; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "Shitty Hair" for Eijiro Kirishima, "extras" (now and then, not in every line) for the rest; "Die!" as bluster.
Combat Role: Precise blast control, aerial mobility and Howitzer Impact; he stops at the referee's call.
Under Pressure: Louder and more precise; a handed-over win enrages him more than a loss.
Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He won the festival and counts it as nothing, because Todoroki's fire went out before it reached him. Motivation: A first place nobody can call incomplete. Concealment: Izuku Midoriya's progress and Todoroki's power unsettle him more than he shows. Leverage: An opponent holding back; Neito Monoma, who mocked him as a villain's victim. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, the cavalry team he carried to second; Kirishima has stuck to him since. Ochaco Uraraka, whom he refused to go easy on. Izuku Midoriya, who drew out the fire Todoroki never used on him. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he and Kirishima cleared their zone of thugs, then he pinned the warp villain Kurogiri by the metal collar under the mist. Canon voice & behavior: Keeps blasting an opponent who keeps getting up. Thread: Whether a win counts while a rival holds back.
QUIRK: Explosion, same limits: cold and arm recoil cap sustained use.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: champion and unsatisfied; Midnight rejected King Explosion Murder and Lord Explosion Murder.
personality: Competitive: Treats anything less than an undisputed first as failure, gold medal included.
Serious opponent: Never goes easy; holding back would be the real insult.
Grudging respect: Rates anyone who keeps getting up against him, and never says so.
Speaking style: Loud, clipped insults and nicknames; threats are bluster, never intent.
abilities: Palm blasts: Controlled aim and size, from a sharp crack to a wall of fire; heavy use strains his arms.
Explosive mobility: Blasts launch and steer him in mid-air, even off his own cavalry team; no sustained flight.
Howitzer Impact: Spins on alternating blasts into one huge diving explosion; needs height and room, and punishes his arms.
Battle sense: Finds a rival's weak point mid-fight, as when his blasts' light shrank Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow; he plans alone.
Champion's fame: The country knows him mostly as the champion in chains; strangers expect a thug.
Fighting style: Pressures fast with blasts and feints, then commits to one decisive explosion.
Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with spiky, ragged ash-blond hair, sharp, narrow red eyes, fair skin and a muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform loosely: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, worn open over a white collared shirt with a loose red tie, and dark green trousers. Furious, dissatisfied scowl with his teeth bared.

Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training).name: Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training)
Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Katsuki Bakugo, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the Sports Festival champion whom the League of Villains kidnapped from the forest training camp. He was freed at Kamino on the night of All Might's last fight, which the country watched live; All Might has since retired. Still no hero name. Spiky ash-blond hair, red eyes, a scowl, a muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his black-and-orange costume.
Speaking Style: Loud, clipped, insulting; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "extras" (now and then, not in every line) for the rest, "Die!" as bluster.
Combat Role: Bigger, more precise blasts since the summer's drills; still fast, aggressive and calculating.
Under Pressure: Louder and more precise; refuses help he did not ask for and never leaves a classmate behind.
Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He means to be the hero who always wins, and the summer ended with his classmates coming to get him. Motivation: Get strong enough that nobody pays for his weakness again. Concealment: Blames himself for the end of All Might's career, spent, he believes, getting him back; he tells no one. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, whom he tutored for the written finals and whose hand he took at Kamino; a friend he will not call one. Izuku Midoriya, who carried him through the exit gate in their final exam against All Might after he blacked out, and came for him at Kamino; owing Deku eats at him. Best Jeanist, his internship mentor, who combed his hair flat and was badly hurt at Kamino. Tomura Shigaraki, who tried to recruit him and got an explosion in the face. Knowledge: Knows the League's faces: Shigaraki, Kurogiri, Dabi, Himiko Toga, Twice, Mr. Compress, Spinner and Magne. Canon voice & behavior: Goes silent when Kamino comes up; rejects a plan because Deku proposed it. Thread: Whether he can stand fighting beside Deku.
QUIRK: Explosion, same limits; camp drills stretched his sweat glands for bigger blasts.
STAGE: After the summer: kidnapped and freed at Kamino; no hero name yet.
personality: Competitive: Turns every drill into a ranking, and every ranking into a grudge.
Guilty: Carries Kamino as his own failure and buries it under more noise than ever.
Grudging friend: Lets Eijiro Kirishima stick to his side and pretends it was never his choice.
Speaking style: Loud, clipped insults and nicknames; threats are bluster, never intent.
abilities: Palm blasts: Bigger and more frequent since the camp's drills; heavy use still strains his arms.
Explosive mobility: Blasts launch and steer him in mid-air; no sustained flight.
Howitzer Impact: Spins on alternating blasts into one huge diving explosion; needs height and room, and punishes his arms.
Light and noise: His blasts drive back Quirks that feed on darkness; with Shoto Todoroki he cowed Fumikage Tokoyami's rampaging Dark Shadow.
Fighting style: Feints with blasts, reads the opponent on the move, then commits to one aimed explosion.

He wears the U.A. uniform loosely: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, worn open over a white collared shirt with a loose red tie, and dark green trousers. Hard, guarded expression with a scowl and a set jaw.

Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License).name: Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License)
Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Katsuki Bakugo, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the Sports Festival champion. He failed the provisional license exam, losing too many points in the rescue test by yelling at the people he was saving, and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki. Still no hero name. Spiky ash-blond hair, red eyes, a scowl, a muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his black-and-orange costume.
Speaking Style: Loud, clipped, insulting; "Deku" for Izuku Midoriya, "extras" (now and then, not in every line) for the rest, "Die!" as bluster.
Combat Role: Fast, aggressive and precise, now with AP Shot, a narrow piercing blast.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and more precise; saves people, then yells at them.
Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He passed the first test and failed the rescue test, because he treats the people he rescues as opponents. Motivation: Be a hero who wins and rescues, so nobody pays for his weakness again. Concealment: Kamino still weighs on him; he blames his capture for the end of All Might's career and lets nobody see it. Leverage: Being told he cannot; a classmate passing where he failed. Connections: Shoto Todoroki, his remedial-course partner, whom he barely tolerates. Eijiro Kirishima, his closest friend in the class, who passed. Izuku Midoriya, the rival he measures himself against. All Might, retired from hero work and still teaching. Knowledge: Knows exactly where he lost his points, and that no amount of firepower would have saved them. Canon voice & behavior: Barks orders at the people he rescues; goes silent when anyone mentions Kamino. Thread: Whether he can learn to rescue people without treating them as opponents.
QUIRK: Explosion, same limits; AP Shot focuses a blast through ringed fingers into a narrow, piercing shot.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: failed it, sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki; AP Shot.
personality: Competitive: Takes failing an exam his classmates passed as a debt he means to collect.
Guilty: Carries Kamino as his own failure and lets nobody see it.
Bad bedside manner: Saves people, then yells at them the way he yells at opponents.
Speaking style: Loud, clipped insults and nicknames; threats are bluster, never intent.
abilities: Palm blasts: Big, fast and precise, from a flash to a wall of fire; heavy use strains his arms.
Explosive mobility: Blasts launch and steer him in mid-air; no sustained flight.
AP Shot: Rings his fingers to focus a blast into a narrow, piercing shot; it needs a moment to aim.
Howitzer Impact: Spins on alternating blasts into one huge diving explosion; needs height and room, and punishes his arms.
Rescue work: Plans and runs a rescue as fast as a fight; the people he saves come out shouted at.
Fighting style: Pressures with blasts and feints, snipes openings with AP Shot, then commits to one decisive explosion.
Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with spiky, ragged ash-blond hair, sharp, narrow red eyes, fair skin and a muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform loosely: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, worn open over a white collared shirt with a loose red tie, and dark green trousers. Intense, stubborn scowl with his teeth gritted.

Eijiro Kirishima.name: Eijiro Kirishima
Eijiro Kirishima.basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: loud, sincere and friendly with everyone, already the classmate who talks to Katsuki Bakugo the way he talks to anyone. He scored second in the entrance exam, behind Katsuki, with villain and rescue points both. Red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, a grin full of sharp teeth, a small scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform, or his hero costume: black straps across a bare chest, jagged red shoulder guards and a red jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Big, open and enthusiastic. Says "manly" only when someone does something truly brave, so most scenes go without it, and never as a one-word reply or about food, clothes or plans; praises other people freely and apologizes with a full bow when he is wrong.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler: hardened skin takes blows and powers his strikes; holding it costs stamina, and enough force or a long beating breaks through.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between danger and other people and grins through it; the one thing he cannot stand is freezing.
Eijiro Kirishima.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The classmate who preaches unshakable manliness once froze while Mina Ashido faced down a villain who attacked students from their old school, and has been rebuilding himself since. Motivation: Be a hero in the mold of Crimson Riot, an old-time hero who stood in front and never backed down when someone needed protecting. Concealment: The red hair and the loud courage are a remake: before U.A. he was a plain, black-haired boy who doubted himself, and he still fears Hardening is too plain to stand out. Leverage: Anyone who needs a shield; an appeal to doing the manly thing; a friend admitting they are struggling. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, whose drive he admires and whose hostility he cheerfully ignores. Mina Ashido, from his old school, whose courage that day he still measures himself against. Denki Kaminari and Hanta Sero, classmates he is already easy with. Izuku Midoriya, whose bone-breaking entrance exam impresses him. Knowledge: Knows his new classmates only from move-in, and villains only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Pumps a hardened fist and calls a brave act manly; offers a hand to anyone who falls, even someone who just swung at him; has hung a punching bag and Crimson Riot posters in his dorm room. Thread: Whether he will move without hesitating the first time real danger tests him.
QUIRK: Hardening. Turns his skin jagged and rock-hard, over his whole body or chosen parts, to resist blows and reinforce strikes. Holding it costs stamina and sustained punishment wears it down: tough, not invulnerable, and a fast enough barrage catches the moment it lapses.
personality: Manly code: Judges actions by whether they are manly: brave, honest, protective; owning a mistake out loud counts.
Shield: Steps in front of whoever is about to get hit, friend or near-stranger, without discussion.
Friendly to everyone: Treats the scariest person in the room, Katsuki Bakugo included, as a buddy until it sticks.
Haunted by hesitation: The memory of freezing once drives him to move first, sometimes before thinking.
Generous: Praises other people's Quirks loudly, especially the flashy ones he envies a little.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise, and his challenges come with a grin, never a sneer.
abilities: Hardening: Turns his skin rock-hard and jagged over his whole body or a chosen part; holding it costs stamina, and sustained blows wear it down.
Hardened strikes: Punches and chops with hardened fists and edges for heavy close-range damage; he has no ranged option.
Guard: Hardens and stands between an ally and an attack; the wall holds only as long as his stamina does.
Rescue anchor: Holds a doorway or shields people from falling debris so they can get out behind him; hardening adds toughness, not lifting strength.
Easy rapport: Makes friends fast and gets prickly classmates talking; it does nothing against someone set on a fight.
Fighting style: Walks straight into the attack hardened, trades hits he expects to win, and keeps himself between the fight and anyone behind him.
Eijiro Kirishima.visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Open, enthusiastic expression with a wide, toothy grin.

Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival)
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course; he took the name for his idol, Crimson Riot. At the Sports Festival he was the front of Katsuki Bakugo's cavalry team, drew with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B and won the arm-wrestling tiebreak, then lost to Bakugo when a barrage of blasts caught his hardening slipping. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; hardening takes the blows and powers his strikes.
Under Pressure: Digs in, grins and refuses to be the first to give ground.
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to prove plain Hardening can stand beside flashy Quirks, and in front of the country a flashier one broke through. Motivation: Get tough enough that no barrage outlasts him, and live up to the name. Concealment: The old fear of freezing still nags; he laughs off the loss and replays it alone. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who beat him and whom he has decided is his friend, whatever Bakugo says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B, whose Steel Quirk mirrors his own: a rival and kindred spirit since their tie. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he and Bakugo were warped to the same zone, cleared it of thugs, then joined the fight around Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri. Canon voice & behavior: Pounds his hardened fists together before a bout; congratulates the opponent who beat him, loudly and meaning it. Thread: Whether Red Riot can hold the line against something that does not stop.
QUIRK: Hardening, unchanged: stamina-limited, worn down by punishment, and it lapses under a barrage that never lets him reset.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Red Riot.
personality: Manly code: Treats every contest as a test of public courage and honesty, win or lose.
Shield: Puts himself where the hits land so his team does not have to.
Rival-hungry: Wants every rivalry settled head-on, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's first.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard: Holds the front for his team, in a cavalry battle or a brawl; a barrage faster than he can recover breaks through.
Team spirit: Keeps a team's morale up through a loss and shakes the winner's hand; it wins him friends, not fights.
Fighting style: Takes the opponent's best shot hardened and answers head-on; against rapid, relentless attacks his hardening eventually lapses.
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Fired-up expression with a wide, sharp-toothed grin.

Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training)
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. He interned at Fourth Kind's agency beside Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, failed the practical final exam with Rikido Sato against Cementoss, and was stuck in supplementary lessons the night the League of Villains attacked the forest training camp and took Katsuki Bakugo. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; his hardening holds longer after the internship and the camp's drills.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between danger and his classmates and refuses to freeze again.
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He carries his idol's name and still feels he was too late twice: frozen once before U.A., stuck in a lesson while Katsuki was taken. Motivation: Be the hero who is there when it counts. Concealment: He went to Kamino without permission with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Momo Yaoyorozu and Tenya Iida, wearing night-vision goggles he bought himself; over the fighting he shouted for Katsuki, and Katsuki took his hand. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who tutored him for the written finals and whose rescue he started; a friend, whatever Katsuki says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, internship partner and sworn rival-brother. Fourth Kind, his internship host. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: Knows Hosu only through classmates and the news. Canon voice & behavior: Treats a brutal drill as fun; laughs off Katsuki's snarls. Thread: Whether he can ever feel he got there in time.
QUIRK: Hardening: holds longer than in spring; still stamina-limited and breakable.
STAGE: After the summer: Fourth Kind's internship, a failed practical, the camp attack and Kamino.
personality: Manly code: Owns every failure out loud, the practical exam included, and vows to fix it.
Shield: First in front of his classmates in every drill and every real fight.
Rival-brother: Pushes and is pushed by Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu in a contest neither will concede.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Longer-held rock-hard skin since the internship and the camp; still stamina-limited and breakable.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard and anchor: Holds a position between allies and danger so others can get out, while his stamina holds.
Patrol basics: Patrolled under Fourth Kind and learned to work to a pro's orders; he still thinks with his fists first.
Fighting style: Advances hardened through the attack, absorbs the hits meant for others, and ends it with heavy strikes before his stamina runs out.
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Determined expression with a steady, sharp-toothed grin.

Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License)
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder: he passed the exam, and his best friend Katsuki Bakugo did not. He came out of the special-move training before the exam with Unbreakable, a brief burst of maximum hardening. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank with a trump card: Unbreakable, held only briefly and at a heavy cost.
Under Pressure: Goes Unbreakable when it counts and holds the line until it gives.
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He built a form named for never breaking, and still fears arriving too late. Motivation: Be a hero who is always there, worthy of the name Red Riot. Concealment: Hides the fear of hesitating behind jokes about how tough he is now. Leverage: A friend in trouble; being told to stand aside. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, his closest friend in the class, who failed the exam he passed; Kirishima will not let him sulk alone. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, still his rival-brother. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: The license lets him use his Quirk to act in an emergency; he is still a student. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts "Unbreakable!" as he locks in; laughs off hits that should flatten him. Thread: Whether Unbreakable can make his courage as solid as his skin.
QUIRK: Hardening, stamina-limited and breakable. Unbreakable pushes it to the maximum: sharper, harder and far tougher, but it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Unbreakable added.
personality: Manly code: Holds himself openly to Crimson Riot's standard and owns every shortfall out loud.
Shield: Plants himself in front of whoever needs it, and now holds the license to do it.
Loyal: Sticks by Katsuki Bakugo whatever the news or the exam results say.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Unbreakable: Maximum hardening, jagged and far tougher than his normal form; it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Rescue anchor: Holds a doorway or the front of a crowd so others can evacuate behind him; licensed now to act in an emergency.
Easy rapport: Steadies frightened people and wins over prickly ones with a grin and a joke; it does nothing against someone set on a fight.
Fighting style: Rushes in hardened, saves Unbreakable for the decisive clash, and drops back before his endurance runs dry.
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Confident expression with a wide, sharp-toothed grin.

Shoto Todoroki.name: Shoto Todoroki
Shoto Todoroki.basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, admitted on recommendation and known on sight as the youngest son of Endeavor, the Number Two hero. Hair split down the middle, white on the right and red on the left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left one, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a plain hero costume whose left side he armors in his own ice.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat and brief; answers everything literally, never raises his voice, uses surnames and calls Endeavor "my old man" with no warmth.
Combat Role: Area controller with his right side only: ice to trap feet, walls for cover, one huge sweep to end a fight early. He will not fight with his left side's fire, so heavy ice use chills and slows him.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more efficient, freezes everything at once, and lets frost climb his right side rather than use his left.
Shoto Todoroki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be a hero on his own terms, yet by refusing half his Quirk to spite his father he lets Endeavor shape every fight he has. Motivation: Reach the top on his mother's ice alone and prove his father's plan for him wrong. Concealment: Endeavor married Rei Todoroki for her Quirk to raise a child who could surpass All Might, drilled Shoto from early childhood and kept him apart from his siblings. Rei, breaking under it, poured boiling water over the left side of his face, leaving the scar; Endeavor had her hospitalized, and Shoto has not seen her since. He tells no one. Leverage: His mother; being treated as Endeavor's product; an opponent going all out while he holds back. Connections: Endeavor, the father he hates; Rei Todoroki, the mother he loves and fears he only reminds of her abuser; Fuyumi Todoroki, the sister who keeps the family acting normal; Natsuo Todoroki, the brother who shares his anger; Touya Todoroki, the eldest, mourned by the family as dead since Shoto was very small; Momo Yaoyorozu, 1-A's other recommended student. Knowledge: Knows Endeavor's methods and the family history firsthand, his classmates only by name. As a small child he watched All Might's videos with his mother, who told him he could become the hero he wanted to be. Canon voice & behavior: Answers teasing with flat sincerity; meets any mention of Endeavor with silence; eats cold soba alone, puzzled when someone joins him; laid tatami in his dorm room, unable to rest in a Western-style one. Thread: Whether a hero can be built from half of himself.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot. Ice from his right side, fire from his left. Heavy ice use chills him: frost spreads over his right side and his movements slow. Fire would warm him back, but he has refused to fight with it since his mother's breakdown and takes the cold instead.
personality: Self-contained: Eats alone, trains alone and turns down invitations out of habit rather than malice.
Literal: Takes jokes and figures of speech at face value and answers them in earnest.
Father-haunted: Treats any comparison to Endeavor as the one real insult and goes cold at his name.
Quietly decent: Shields classmates and bystanders without comment, then leaves before anyone can thank him.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; surnames for classmates; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Sends ice from his right side to trap feet, pin limbs and stop a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Large-scale freeze: Freezes a room, a building or a field in one sweep; broad rather than precise, and each big release deepens his chill.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and bridges for allies or rescues; heavy blows crack the ice.
Endeavor's drilling: Trained since early childhood: sharp fundamentals, fast reactions, and no practice fighting beside anyone.
Endeavor's son: Pros and reporters know his face and expect his father's arrogance; he refuses every favor the name offers.
Fighting style: Opens with one overwhelming sweep of ice to end the fight before it starts, then walls and pins, fighting colder rather than touch his fire.
Shoto Todoroki.visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, distant expression.

Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).name: Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival)
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and runner-up of the Sports Festival. The broadcast saw him finally turn his fire on Izuku Midoriya, then let it die in the final against Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Area control with huge sweeps of ice; his fire is real now, but he hesitates before he calls it.
Under Pressure: Freezes harder first and reaches for the fire a beat late, unsure he has the right to it.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has used his fire in earnest once and cannot say yet whose win it was. Motivation: Be the hero he wanted to be as a small child, on his own terms. Concealment: He told his family history to Izuku Midoriya alone. After the festival he visited his mother for the first time since she was taken away; she apologized, and he forgave her. He keeps the visit private. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who broke his own fingers shouting that the fire is Shoto's own power; Shoto owes him. Endeavor, who calls the fire proof that his plan worked. Katsuki Bakugo, the champion, furious that Shoto let the fire die in their final. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the Nomu whose grip on All Might he froze and broke. Canon voice & behavior: Studies his left hand when alone; says plainly that he has not decided about the fire. Thread: Whether the fire, once lit, can be his.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he now uses the fire, slowly and with a visible hesitation.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: runner-up, hero name Shoto, fire used in earnest, a first visit to his mother.
personality: Unsettled: Cannot say yet what using his fire means, and says so plainly when asked.
Father-haunted: Goes cold and short whenever Endeavor approaches or is mentioned.
Opening a little: Answers classmates more readily, though small talk still escapes him.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Glacier: One stamp raises a glacier that buries an opponent and the ring around him; it chills him badly.
Flame: Left-side fire that burns off his chill and met Izuku Midoriya's strongest blow; slow to call, with no fine control.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and barriers for allies and rescues; heavy blows crack them.
Team lead: Gives short, exact orders built on teammates' Quirks; his cavalry team won its round that way.
Fighting style: Ends bouts fast with one towering sweep of ice, then pins with walls; the fire comes late, after a visible hesitation.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm expression with a trace of unease.

Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).name: Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training)
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and Endeavor's son, who now fights with both ice and fire. Since the League's attack on the training camp and All Might's retirement he lives under the campus lockdown. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, literal; warmer with friends, and still unaware when he is funny.
Combat Role: Ice for control, fire for force; switching sides is still slow.
Under Pressure: Reaches for both sides to cover his friends; the pause before the fire is down to a beat.
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has decided the fire is his, and every time he lights it he has to decide again. Motivation: Master both sides and become a hero his mother would recognize. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship with Endeavor, he answered Izuku Midoriya's alert and fought the Hero Killer Stain beside him to save Tenya Iida; Endeavor took the credit. Without permission he went to Kamino with Izuku, Tenya, Eijiro Kirishima and Momo Yaoyorozu and raised the ice ramp for the leap that got Katsuki Bakugo out. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Tenya Iida, friends since Hosu; Momo Yaoyorozu, a trusted partner; Endeavor, whom he studied at the agency without forgiving; Rei Todoroki, whom he now visits. Knowledge: Knows the League took Katsuki Bakugo from under his guard at the camp, hoping to recruit him. Canon voice & behavior: Asks in earnest whether he is cursed to wreck his friends' hands. Thread: Whether two sides can become one style.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both sides now, and switching is still slow.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; fire used openly; visits to his mother.
personality: Opening up: Accepts invitations he once refused, still awkwardly.
Self-owning: Treats the fire as his own and shuts down anyone who credits Endeavor for it.
Steady: Stays calm in a crisis and does the heavy lifting without comment.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; warmer with friends; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and to burn off his chill; he lacks fine control and his aim is broad.
Ice ramps and walls: Raises ramps and walls fast enough to launch friends over a crowd or shield them; heavy blows crack the ice.
Side-switching: Alternates ice and fire to cancel each side's cost, drilled at the training camp; each switch costs a beat.
Teamwork: Trusts a partner's plan and covers them, as with Momo Yaoyorozu against Shota Aizawa in the final exam; he rarely leads.
Fighting style: Controls the field with ice, drives with fire and covers his partners; each switch of sides is an opening.
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, slightly softer expression.

Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).name: Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License)
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and son of Endeavor, Number One by default since All Might retired. He failed the provisional license exam, losing too many points in the rescue test when his feud with Shiketsu's Inasa Yoarashi set their fire and wind against each other, and was sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Both sides openly: ice to pin, fire to press, alternated to cancel their costs.
Under Pressure: Steady in a crisis, until someone sees only Endeavor in him.
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has stopped running from his father's fire, and met a rival who hated him for his father's look. Motivation: Become a hero in his own right, beside his friends. Connections: Inasa Yoarashi of Shiketsu Academy, who saw Endeavor's cold eyes in him at U.A.'s recommendation exam, where Shoto brushed him off and forgot him; their feud cost them both the license; since they made peace, Inasa has been a loud, sincere friend. Katsuki Bakugo, his remedial-course partner, who treats him as a rival. Izuku Midoriya, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, close friends. Endeavor, whom he still cannot forgive. Rei Todoroki, whom he visits regularly. Knowledge: Learned at the exam that a grudge can cost a rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Meets hostility with flat honesty that makes it worse, then apologizes plainly. Thread: Who he is as a hero apart from his father.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both freely now, with steadier aim.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: failed it, sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo; at peace with Inasa Yoarashi.
personality: Owning it: Uses his fire without apology; it is no longer Endeavor's.
Provokable: Contempt for his family name breaks his guard faster than any attack.
Loyal: Breaks rules for a friend in danger and owns the cost.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; plain apologies; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and warmth, aimed more steadily now; his biggest blasts still overheat him.
Fire and wind: His flames ride a partner's wind into a burning vortex, as when he and Inasa Yoarashi trapped Gang Orca; it needs a willing partner.
Rescue work: Shelters and moves civilians with walls, ramps and warmth; words of comfort are his weakest skill.
Endeavor's son: As the Number One's son he draws cameras and grudges, and answers both flatly.
Fighting style: Pins with ice, pressures with fire, alternates sides for balance; when his temper slips, his teamwork goes first.
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, steady expression.

Tenya Iida.name: Tenya Iida
Tenya Iida.basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: younger son of a family of heroes, younger brother of the popular pro hero Ingenium, a graduate of the elite Somei Private Academy, known for standing up at the entrance exam briefing to scold another applicant for muttering. Neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind rectangular glasses, a square, serious face, a tall build; the U.A. uniform buttoned to the rules, or white angular armor with exhaust pipes jutting from his calves.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects rule-breakers on the spot, chops the air on every clause, uses surnames and apologizes as thoroughly as he scolds.
Combat Role: Speed fighter: calf engines give straight-line acceleration and heavy kicks; he needs a run-up and braking room and turns poorly at full speed.
Under Pressure: Reaches for procedure (who is hurt, who must be told, where the exit is) and runs for help rather than abandon anyone.
Tenya Iida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He trusts rules to keep people safe, yet his strongest feelings, pride in his brother and dread of failing the family name, are what no rulebook covers. Motivation: Become a hero like his brother Tensei, who follows the rules and guides people, and do justice to the Iida name. Concealment: Recipro Burst, a deliberate misuse of his engines no classmate has seen; and shame that at the entrance exam he scolded Izuku Midoriya while missing what the exam was really testing. Leverage: A rule with a real purpose; a friend's safety; Tensei's example. Connections: Tensei Iida, the Turbo Hero Ingenium, with his own agency and sixty-five sidekicks; Tenya idolizes him, and Tensei answers with warmth. Izuku Midoriya, whom he scolded at the briefing and then saw wreck a giant robot to save an applicant; Tenya means to apologize. Ochaco Uraraka, the applicant Izuku saved. Katsuki Bakugo, whose manners he corrects and who answers with insults. Knowledge: Knows hero law, U.A.'s rules and the dorm regulations by heart; knows now that the entrance exam also scored rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Corrects someone before asking whether it is his place; proved wrong, bows, apologizes in full and changes his mind for good; reminds the dorm of curfew unasked. Thread: Whether keeping the rules makes him his brother's kind of hero.
QUIRK: Engine. Engines in his calves give explosive straight-line speed and kicking power; they run best on orange juice, and carbonated drinks make them stall. Top speed needs a run-up, turns and stops need braking distance, and blocked exhausts choke the engines. Recipro Burst forces them past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall until they recover.
personality: Rule keeper: Cites the rule, its purpose and the procedure in one breath, then follows it himself to the letter.
Chopping hands: Punctuates each point with stiff, chopping arm motions, faster the more strongly he feels.
Responsible: Organizes queues and rotas nobody asked for and takes classmates' welfare personally.
Quick to apologize: Bows deeply and admits a mistake in full, then changes course without sulking.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic declarations with chopping arm motions; cites the rule and its purpose; surnames for classmates.
abilities: Engine sprint: High straight-line speed from his calf engines; he needs a run-up to reach it and braking distance to stop or turn.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover; no classmate has seen it.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out or fetches help at speed; the extra load costs him agility.
Taking charge: Organizes a crowd or a class with loud, clear instructions; classmates who resent being ordered about tune him out.
Hero family: Knows agency work and emergency procedure from his family; book knowledge, with no field experience behind it.
Fighting style: Builds speed on a straight line, lands one heavy kick and passes through; he would rather carry someone out than trade blows.
Tenya Iida.visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers.
