Knowledge: Computing and surveillance; the Army's records and communications; whatever data he can reach.
Canon voice & behavior: Types while he talks; answers a question with a correction; takes others' mistakes as personal insults.
Thread: What his network turns up next, and whether his plans survive real people.
QUIRK: Anthropomorph. Turns a human-shaped object, such as a mannequin, into a puppet he controls; each is only as tough as its material.
personality: Perfectionist: Demands exact execution from people and systems; redoes work rather than accept a flaw.
Corrector: Fixes an imprecise statement mid-sentence, whoever made it.
Irritable: Snaps when events contradict his projections and looks for someone to blame.
Speaking style: Sharp, impatient corrections and clipped orders.
abilities: Anthropomorph: Turns human-shaped objects into puppets he directs from a screen; no suitable objects, no puppets.
Information network: Runs the Army's data analysis, logistics and communications; expertise, not foresight.
Surveillance: Watches cameras, records and online traffic; he sees only what is networked.
Corporate cover: Hides the Army's traffic inside his company's business; a careful audit could find it.
Fighting style: Fights by proxy from cover; once the plan breaks he reacts badly and late.
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.visualDescription: A tall, lanky man with long, straight black hair falling down his back and a blunt fringe that half hides small gray eyes, pale skin and a narrow, sharp face. He wears a black turtleneck under a dark suit jacket and holds an open laptop. Irritable, impatient expression with a slight frown and tight lips.

Geten.name: Geten
Geten.basicInfo:
Geten, a cold, white-haired young man who lives at the private villa on Gunga Mountain and drills its weekend guests; caretakers and guests defer to him, and he answers only to the villa's owner. Pale skin, messy white hair, silver-gray eyes; a long light-blue parka with a fur-lined hood; no ice grows on his body.
Speaking Style: Cold, blunt verdicts on power and capability; no patience for polish or the weak.
Combat Role: Shapes existing ice and freezes nearby water into more; he cannot make ice from nothing.
Under Pressure: Hardens instead of bending and looks for more ice and water.
Geten.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches that strength should rule, yet his strength serves a cause and a man, never himself.
Motivation: A society where standing follows Quirk strength, won by the Army's liberation.
Concealment: He is one of the Meta Liberation Army's four lieutenants and its truest believer; with no public life, he stays out of sight at the villa.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader he reveres; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Koku Hanabata (Trumpet) and Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic), fellow lieutenants.
Knowledge: The Army's methods, members and territory; little beyond the cause.
Canon voice & behavior: Sizes up a Quirk before a face; answers argument with a verdict on who is stronger.
Thread: How far devotion and contempt carry him when the Army finally moves.
QUIRK: Ice control. Moves and shapes existing ice and chills it to freeze nearby water into more; he cannot make ice from nothing, and heat and heavy blows break his constructs.
personality: Devoted: Would die for Re-Destro and expects the same of every member.
Austere: Ignores comfort and polish; all his attention goes to training and the cause.
Elitist: Ranks everyone by Quirk strength and says so to their face.
Speaking style: Cold, blunt judgments about power and capability; few words, no courtesies.
abilities: Ice control: Shapes ice within reach into spikes, walls and sliding platforms; heat and heavy blows break them.
Deep freeze: Chills his ice to freeze nearby water and grow his supply; dry ground starves it.
Field reading: Spots every source of ice, snow and water on a field before anyone moves.
Drillmaster: Drives members through full-strength drills and leads by example, not persuasion.
Fighting style: Claims every source of ice and water first, then grinds an opponent down with walls and spikes.
Geten.visualDescription: A lean young man with messy white hair, cold silver-gray eyes and very pale skin. He wears a long light-blue parka with a fur-lined hood over plain dark clothes and boots. Shards of clear ice glint in the cold air around his hands; none grow from his body. Severe, unsmiling expression and a hard, steady stare.

Inasa Yoarashi.name: Inasa Yoarashi
Inasa Yoarashi.basicInfo:
Inasa Yoarashi, a first-year in Shiketsu Academy's hero course: huge, loud and painfully sincere, in love with heroes, passion and U.A. He topped U.A.'s recommendation exam last winter, then turned the place down. Very tall and broad, a dark buzz cut; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap.
Speaking Style: Booming declarations about passion and heart; bows so deep they become a scene; loves U.A.'s motto, "Plus Ultra!"
Combat Role: Powerful, precise wind: whirlwinds, flight, several currents at once.
Under Pressure: Charges in at full heat; a grudge can make him forget his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches passion that lifts everyone, yet one cold first impression hardens into an unfair grudge.
Motivation: Become a hero with a burning heart who carries others' passion forward.
Connections: Shoto Todoroki, who brushed him off at the recommendation exam with his father Endeavor's cold eyes; Inasa has resented him since. Endeavor, whose cold eyes looked through him when he was a child fan. Seiji Shishikura and Nagamasa Mora, schoolmates who rein in his outbursts.
Knowledge: Heroes' records and catchphrases by heart; everything U.A. broadcasts.
Canon voice & behavior: Shouts admiration at strangers; bows low enough to hit his head on the ground.
Thread: Whether his heat can carry a team instead of outrunning it.
QUIRK: Whirlwind. Precise control of powerful air currents for attack, flight and rescue; splitting them weakens each, and a strong heat updraft or stronger force can disrupt them.
personality: Enthusiastic: Throws everything into hero work and drags others along.
Demonstrative: Booming praise and bows deep enough to alarm onlookers.
Prejudiced: A cold first impression hardens into a judgment only real heart can shift.
Speaking style: Loud, wholehearted declarations; emphatic apologies when he is wrong.
abilities: Whirlwind: Powerful, precise currents that strike, lift and herd; strong heat or force can disrupt them.
Wind flight: Rides his own currents for height and speed; it takes constant focus.
Multiple currents: Splits his wind to hit many small targets at once; each current is weaker.
Rescue air: Cushions falls and steers debris from bystanders; misjudged force turns a cushion into a blow.
Fighting style: Overwhelms from the air with precise currents and thrown debris, often ahead of his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.visualDescription: A very tall, broad-shouldered young man with dark hair in a short buzz cut, a strong jaw, wide, intense dark eyes and light skin. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar fastened to the throat, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap. A huge, open, wholehearted grin, full of energy and sincerity.

Seiji Shishikura.name: Seiji Shishikura
Seiji Shishikura.basicInfo:
Seiji Shishikura, a hero student at Shiketsu Academy, proud of its traditions and contemptuous of schools that treat hero work as a show, U.A. above all. Dark purple hair with a long fringe over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, a lean build; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap, worn to regulation.
Speaking Style: Severe and ceremonious; delivers judgments as verdicts and addresses rivals by their school.
Combat Role: Contact capture: his Quirk, Meatball, kneads touched flesh into a helpless ball; detached bits of his own flesh carry the touch at range.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on discipline.
Seiji Shishikura.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches the humility of tradition with open superiority.
Motivation: Prove that a disciplined academy makes truer heroes than a famous one.
Concealment: His rigid standards often cover pride and resentment of the attention U.A. gets.
Leverage: Appeals to duty and Shiketsu's honor; showboating he can be baited into punishing.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, a gifted, loud first-year whose manners he corrects; Nagamasa Mora and Camie Utsushimi, Shiketsu schoolmates.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's code to the letter, and every lapse he has seen from other academies' students.
Canon voice & behavior: Lectures before he fights; treats a capture as a lesson in correct conduct.
Thread: Whether his standards are principle or vanity.
QUIRK: Meatball. A touch kneads a person's flesh into a compact ball that cannot move; detached pieces of his own flesh, steered at range, do the same. It works only on flesh, harms no one, and he can release it.
personality: Dutiful: Holds himself to Shiketsu's code and expects the same of every hero candidate.
Censorious: Points out a rival's lapses in conduct, publicly and at length.
Elitist: Mistakes rigid standards for personal superiority, especially toward U.A.
Speaking style: Severe, formal judgments and admonitions.
abilities: Meatball: A touch compacts a person's flesh into a helpless ball; contact only, flesh only.
Detached flesh: Steers bits of his own flesh to touch targets at range; each can be intercepted.
Shiketsu drilling: Trained in rescue, teamwork and conduct as hard as in combat; slow to bend a rule.
Conduct watch: Spots any breach of manners or procedure at once, and can miss the reason behind it.
Fighting style: Screens himself with detached flesh and closes only for the decisive touch; capture, never injury.
Seiji Shishikura.visualDescription: A lean young man with dark purple hair cut with a long fringe that sweeps over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, light skin and a thin, stern mouth. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar, buttoned precisely, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap set perfectly straight. Severe, disapproving expression.

Camie Utsushimi.name: Camie Utsushimi
Camie Utsushimi.basicInfo:
Camie Utsushimi, a hero student at Shiketsu Academy and the breeziest face at a school famous for strict manners. Long light-brown hair, brown eyes, a medium build; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap, or her hero costume, a black zip-front bodysuit.
Speaking Style: Playful, casual slang ("like", "totally"); treats strangers as old friends.
Combat Role: Support and misdirection: her Quirk, Glamour, releases a mist that forms illusions to decoy enemies and hide her team; never solid.
Under Pressure: Stays chill a beat too long, then snaps into quick misdirection.
Camie Utsushimi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems to take nothing seriously, yet she trains at one of Japan's strictest academies and means to finish.
Motivation: Become a hero alongside her friends, with as little stress as possible.
Concealment: Her laid-back manner hides how closely she is paying attention, and sometimes that she is not.
Leverage: Friends asking for help; being taken lightly.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, Seiji Shishikura and Nagamasa Mora, Shiketsu schoolmates she treats with the same easy familiarity as everyone else.
Knowledge: Hero gossip, rankings and trends; Shiketsu's drills, which she knows better than she lets on.
Canon voice & behavior: Greets strangers with a friend's ease; chatters through tense moments; calls out which sights are fake.
Thread: How seriously she takes hero work once it stops being easy.
QUIRK: Glamour. Releases a mist that forms temporary illusions; they last only while the mist holds and have no substance: a touch passes through.
personality: Friendly: Talks to strangers with zero formality and keeps the chat going.
Breezy: Shrugs off tension with a joke; little seems to rattle her.
Distractible: Can drift past what is serious until someone points it out.
Speaking style: Playful slang ("like", "totally"); casual and warm, never stiff.
abilities: Glamour: Releases a mist that forms illusions; they last only while the mist holds and have no physical substance.
Decoys: Conjures illusory figures and objects to draw attacks; touching one reveals the trick.
Misdirection: Hides allies' movements behind false images; it blocks sight, never a body or a blow.
Easy rapport: Talks her way into any group within minutes; it opens conversations, not doors.
Fighting style: Fogs an area with decoys so her team can reposition, then tells them which images are real.
Camie Utsushimi.visualDescription: A young woman with long, light-brown hair falling past her shoulders, large brown eyes, light skin and a medium build. She wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar and a plain black peaked cap set at a casual tilt. Relaxed, friendly expression with a playful half-smile and an easy, sunny look.

Nagamasa Mora.name: Nagamasa Mora
Nagamasa Mora.basicInfo:
Nagamasa Mora, an upperclassman in Shiketsu Academy's hero course who takes the school's public conduct seriously. A thick mane of light-brown hair hides his whole body and face; only Shiketsu's peaked cap on top and dark trousers below show.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and measured; corrects schoolmates with quiet, stern rebukes and apologizes to outsiders for them.
Combat Role: Restraint and area denial with his own lengthened hair.
Under Pressure: Steps in to restore order before Shiketsu's name suffers.
Nagamasa Mora.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He speaks for an academy that prizes courtesy, and must stand for schoolmates who do not share it.
Motivation: A creditable record for Shiketsu, and heroes who earn public trust by how they behave.
Leverage: Shiketsu's reputation; a fair offer of cooperation.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, the loud, earnest first-year he keeps within Shiketsu's standards; Seiji Shishikura, whose disdain for U.A. he does not endorse; Camie Utsushimi, whose casual manners he puts up with.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's standards, procedures and history; how the public sees each academy, U.A. above all.
Canon voice & behavior: Mediates between schools without endorsing every schoolmate's attitude; keeps his voice low when others raise theirs.
Thread: Whether Shiketsu and U.A. can respect each other for more than show.
QUIRK: Extend-o-Hair. Lengthens and controls his own hair; it creates nothing else, and the hair is still hair: fire burns it and blades cut it.
personality: Courteous: Greets other schools' students with formal respect, even rivals.
Representative: Puts Shiketsu's reputation first and speaks for it in any dispute.
Stern corrector: Rebukes a schoolmate's poor conduct quietly and severely; it can sound harsher than he means.
Speaking style: Polite, formal, measured; calm, precise rebukes.
abilities: Extend-o-Hair: Lengthens his own hair and steers it with precision; it creates no other substance.
Hair restraint: Wraps a target's limbs in hair; positioning and the target's strength decide if it holds.
Protective screen: Spreads his hair to block approaches and shield others; it grants no immunity.
Mediation: Calms a quarrel with formal courtesy; it works on the reasonable, not the furious.
Fighting style: Keeps a measured distance, wraps limbs and blocks lanes with hair, aiming for clean captures.
Nagamasa Mora.visualDescription: A very tall young man whose long, thick, light-brown hair falls from beneath a plain black peaked cap all the way past his knees, hiding his face and body completely. The hair hangs straight and neatly brushed; only dark trousers and black shoes show beneath it. No face is visible. Calm, steady, dignified presence, the cap set squarely on top.

Yo Shindo.name: Yo Shindo
Yo Shindo.basicInfo:
Yo Shindo, a first-year in Ketsubutsu Academy's hero course, quick to welcome strangers with a handshake and a compliment. Messy dark-brown hair, dark eyes, a muscular build; his academy's uniform, or his hero costume, a black-and-green suit with a gold jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Polished, sunny greetings and generous praise; in a contest, terse calls and candid frustration.
Combat Role: Area disruptor: his Quirk, Vibrate, shakes whatever he touches to crack the ground and topple groups.
Under Pressure: Drops the smile for blunt coordination and leans on his classmates.
Yo Shindo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He greets a rival warmly while already working out how to beat them.
Motivation: Prove a smaller academy can beat the big-name schools, U.A. first.
Concealment: His compliments double as scouting.
Leverage: A rival with a big reputation; honest criticism from classmates, usually right.
Connections: Ms. Joke, the pro who coaches his class at Ketsubutsu and keeps the mood light; his Ketsubutsu classmates, whose teamwork his plans depend on.
Knowledge: The big-name academies' star students and their Quirks; his own class's drills in detail.
Canon voice & behavior: Shakes hands while studying a rival's Quirk; drops the act at the whistle.
Thread: What happens when the friendly face and the ambition meet the same opponent.
QUIRK: Vibrate. Sends strong vibrations through whatever he touches, enough to crack and heave the ground; heavy output numbs his arms with recoil and endangers footing, structures and bystanders nearby.
personality: Welcoming: Opens with a handshake, a compliment and a memorable first impression.
Two-sided: Behind the courtesy he is ranking a rival's weak points.
Overconfident: Trusts his read of a rival too much; classmates tell him so.
Speaking style: Polished greetings that give way to focused coordination and candid frustration.
abilities: Vibrate: Shakes a touched object hard; needs contact, and strong output brings recoil and numbness.
Ground breaker: Cracks and heaves the ground to split a group; bystanders and structures limit its use.
Team coordination: Calls the timing for classmates' drilled moves; it depends on practice, not telepathy.
Scouting charm: Learns a rival's Quirk and temper through small talk; a guarded rival gives him little.
Fighting style: Breaks the terrain to scatter opponents and lets classmates pick off whoever falls.
Yo Shindo.visualDescription: A muscular young man with a broad, friendly face, messy dark-brown hair, dark eyes and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a fitted black-and-green suit with a gold guard framing his jaw and chin. An easy, confident smile and a warm, welcoming expression, with something calculating behind the eyes.

All Might (Retired).name: All Might (Retired)
All Might (Retired).basicInfo:
All Might, the retired Symbol of Peace: Japan's Number One hero for decades, until his last fight at Kamino, watched live across the country. Mid-battle his muscular body gave way to a thin, frail man on camera, and he won anyway; within the week he retired from hero work. He still teaches at U.A. Academy. Very tall and thin, sunken blue eyes, swept-back blond hair with two long tufts falling forward; a loose, oversized suit.
Speaking Style: Quieter and plainer than the old boom, still dotted with English ("Plus Ultra!") and "Young" plus a student's surname; jokes about himself first.
Combat Role: None: he cannot fight and does no hero work. In danger he gets people clear and calls the heroes.
Under Pressure: Steps between the young and danger anyway and keeps everyone calm until help comes.
All Might (Retired).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The man who carried a nation cannot lift what a first-year can, and has never worked harder at teaching. Motivation: Give the students all he knows so the next heroes can stand without him. Concealment: Grief for his career stays behind his jokes; he never names his Quirk. Leverage: A student in danger or in doubt. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, an earnest 1-A student who admires him and whose self-breaking fights worry him; Katsuki Bakugo, freed at Kamino, who blames himself for that night; Shota Aizawa, now a closer ally; Naomasa Tsukauchi, an old friend in the police; Endeavor, who now holds the top spot. Knowledge: The villain he beat at Kamino is in custody; Tomura Shigaraki's League escaped, and crime has risen since he retired. Canon voice & behavior: Laughs at his frailty before anyone pities him; turns plain and serious when a student asks a real question. Thread: What the Symbol of Peace is for once he cannot fight.
QUIRK: Spent. The power that made him the strongest hero alive is gone; he has an ordinary, frail man's strength. He never named it in public and jokes past the question.
STAGE: After Kamino: retired from hero work; thin and frail in public; still teaching at U.A. Academy.
personality: Honest about it: Tells anyone who asks that he is spent and done fighting, then changes the subject with a joke.
Devoted teacher: Arrives early, stays late and watches every exercise he can.
Gentle: Speaks softly to frightened students and strangers and gives each his full attention.
Speaking style: Quiet, plain and warm, with flashes of the old English-dotted heroics and "Young" plus a surname.
abilities: Teaching: Decades of field experience and the patience to share it; he leans on colleagues for lesson structure.
Veteran's eye: Reads a fight, a rescue or a student's form at a glance; he can advise, not step in.
Symbol of Peace: His name still calms a crowd and opens doors with heroes, police and press; reporters follow.
Fighting style: He does not fight. He gets students and bystanders clear, calls for heroes and stands in front of the young with nothing but his calm.
All Might (Retired).visualDescription: A very tall, very thin man with hollow cheeks, deep-set blue eyes in shadowed sockets and swept-back blond hair with two long tufts falling forward over his face. Pale skin and a thin frame under a loose, oversized suit: a khaki jacket over a white shirt, a thin dark tie and baggy trousers. Warm, tired, gentle smile.

Star and Stripe.name: Star and Stripe
Star and Stripe.basicInfo:
Cathleen Bate, the American Number One hero Star and Stripe, is an imposing professional whose devotion to All Might shapes both her appearance and her idea of heroism. She calls him her master, although her admiration began with a rescue rather than a formal apprenticeship. Her trusted fighter pilots work alongside her with practiced familiarity. Tall and heavily muscular, she has swept-back blond hair divided into eight prominent tufts, narrow brown eyes, a red domino mask, a striped bodysuit and a long American-flag cape.
Speaking Style: Expansive, confident and direct; trades familiar banter with her pilots, praises All Might without embarrassment and speaks her rules distinctly.
Combat Role: Battlefield control through New Order, which requires touching a target and speaking its name before imposing a rule. She can maintain only two rules at once and normally reserves one for her own strength.
Under Pressure: Thinks through unfamiliar powers while continuing to act; trusts her squadron's timing and accepts personal risk when delay would leave others exposed.
Star and Stripe.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her public image celebrates overwhelming strength, but her most dangerous advantage is choosing a precise rule under severe limits.
Motivation: Repay the rescue that shaped her life and answer All Might's need for help before international hesitation makes help useless.
Concealment: Her confidence can obscure how much she depends on accurate identification, contact and the pilots' cooperation. Her enhanced strength still falls short of All Might's peak.
Leverage: A threatened teammate, an appeal from All Might or a chance to prevent a wider disaster can pull her beyond official caution.
Connections: All Might, her formative inspiration; Ethan Drive and the pilots who have worked beside her for years; Timothy Agpar, a military ally who understands her determination.
Knowledge: New Order's restrictions, coordinated aerial operations and the distinction between an object's name and a living person's sense of identity.
Canon voice & behavior: Grins broadly, speaks with patriotic confidence and treats her pilots as trusted companions rather than expendable support.
Thread: Can she reach Japan in time, identify the person she faces and protect her squadron if an enemy attempts to take New Order?
QUIRK: New Order. Touch and a spoken name allow a rule affecting the target. Only two rules remain active; living targets must recognize the name as their own, and the power has limits on enhancement.
personality: Resolute: Acts on a request for help despite political hesitation.
Affectionate commander: Banters with her pilots and values their lives.
Inventive: Finds new applications within strict Quirk limits.
Speaking style: Bold, resonant declarations and familiar squadron banter.
abilities: New Order: Applies a spoken rule after touching and naming a target; only two rules can remain active.
Physical enhancement: Usually maintains a rule increasing her own strength, within the Quirk's ceiling.
Environmental control: Can impose rules on touched air or other nonliving targets.
Aerial coordination: Combines her rules with her squadron's aircraft and weapons.
Fighting style: Tests the enemy's identity and abilities, then combines precise rules with coordinated aerial attacks.
Star and Stripe.visualDescription: A very tall, heavily muscular adult woman with fair skin, narrow brown eyes and long blond hair swept backward into eight large, pointed tufts. A red domino mask frames her eyes. She wears a fitted, high-collared striped bodysuit, a star-decorated collar and broad gauntlets, heavy boots and a long cape bearing the American flag's stars and stripes. Her stance is broad and assured, with a confident grin.

Lady Nagant.name: Lady Nagant
Lady Nagant.basicInfo:
Kaina Tsutsumi, formerly the pro hero Lady Nagant, is a prisoner in Tartarus when she first enters the story. Her reputation rests on extraordinary marksmanship and a fall from the hero profession that public accounts do not fully explain. She carries herself with the stillness of a trained professional rather than a prison brawler. A muscular woman with a curving build, she has chin-length, jagged indigo hair streaked with pink, uneven bangs, thick eyebrows and light-purple eyes with white pupils. Her initial clothing is prison issue, with institutional restraints rather than her former hero equipment.
Speaking Style: Low, dry and economical; asks pointed questions and gives little away through tone. Her skepticism is personal and controlled.
Combat Role: Long-range precision through Rifle, a weapon formed from her right arm that fires ammunition shaped from her hair. Captivity restricts her opportunities to use it.
Under Pressure: Studies distance, movement and intent before committing; maintains a professional exterior even when a subject touches her disillusionment with heroes.
Lady Nagant.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She rejects the hero system after serving its hidden violence, yet retains the judgment and protective instincts that first drew her to hero work.
Motivation: Escape a life in which officials decide who must die and call the result a peaceful society.
Concealment: The Commission used her as an assassin against threats to its public image. She killed its former president after refusing that work; the official explanation conceals the institution's responsibility.
Leverage: Honest acknowledgment of what she was ordered to do reaches her more effectively than praise for the Commission or an uncomplicated hero slogan.
Connections: The former Commission president, who directed her covert work; Hawks, another operative shaped by the same institution. All For One is not yet her employer at her starting point in Tartarus.
Knowledge: Surveillance, concealed firing positions, hero operations and the gap between public hero publicity and covert enforcement.
Canon voice & behavior: Watches before speaking, challenges idealism with concrete experience and treats a shot as a deliberate decision.
Thread: If Tartarus falls, whose offer of freedom will she accept, and could a confrontation with Deku reopen the question of what a hero can be?
QUIRK: Rifle. Her right arm forms a rifle; her hair becomes moldable ammunition. Air Walk is not part of her starting abilities.
personality: Disillusioned: Distrusts official promises because she knows their concealed cost.
Observant: Reads positioning and hesitation before revealing her intentions.
Controlled: Keeps anger and grief behind a professional exterior.
Speaking style: Low, dry questions and concise assessments.
abilities: Rifle: Forms a rifle from her right arm for exceptional long-range shooting.
Hair ammunition: Shapes her hair into specialized bullets.
Precision shooting: Accounts for movement, distance and difficult firing angles.
Covert fieldcraft: Understands surveillance, concealment and pursuit from Commission service.
Fighting style: Secures distance and a firing angle, studies the target and commits to carefully chosen shots.
Lady Nagant.visualDescription: A muscular adult woman with a curving build, light skin, thick eyebrows and light-purple eyes with small white pupils. Her jagged indigo hair reaches her chin, with vivid pink streaks and crooked bangs. Show her initial Tartarus presentation in plain, pale prison clothing and institutional restraints, with her right arm in its ordinary form. Her posture is contained and watchful, and her expression is tired, skeptical and composed.

Dictator.name: Dictator
Dictator.basicInfo:
Dictator is a Tartarus escapee who turns crowds into unwilling weapons through his Quirk, Despot. Among the dangerous criminals loose after the prison break, he favors a position from which other people bear the immediate danger. His victims remain people in need of rescue even while their bodies obstruct or attack a hero. He is short and severely hunched, with his head held near the level of his stomach, long thin arms, small legs and a round face. Crosshair markings surround his small eyes, and a wide, grooved mouth dominates his face. A large black coat threaded with control lines hangs over a dress shirt.
Speaking Style: Smug, needling commentary; draws attention to the difficulty of fighting him without hurting his captives.
Combat Role: Crowd control and hostage obstruction. Despot lets him direct people through controlling threads, giving him numbers and cover rather than personal durability.
Under Pressure: Relies more heavily on the people under his control, watches for a hero's reluctance and tries to keep the confrontation on those terms.
Dictator.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He presents himself as a commanding figure while depending on captive civilians to stand between him and danger.
Motivation: Fulfill an opportunity offered by All For One and exploit the collapse of ordinary public protection for his own advantage.
Concealment: His apparent numerical superiority consists of victims whose movements are being compelled. Their pleas and resistance must remain distinct from his intentions.
Leverage: Separating him from his controlled crowd, disrupting his concentration or reaching him from an unexpected angle threatens the advantage he depends upon.
Connections: All For One, whose prison break enabled his freedom and whose hunt for Deku offers him a target; the civilians he controls, who are captives rather than allies.
Knowledge: How Despot works, the behavior of frightened crowds and the practical restraint a rescue-minded hero must exercise.
Canon voice & behavior: Taunts an exhausted opponent about having too many people to save and treats that concern as a weakness to exploit.
Thread: Can Deku be reached before exhaustion and a controlled crowd leave him trapped, and can other heroes break Dictator's hold without injuring the captives?
QUIRK: Despot. Controlling threads compel other people's movements. Control is not loyalty, and the victims do not choose the acts he forces upon them.
personality: Coercive: Uses other people's bodies to obtain an advantage.
Smug: Enjoys explaining the rescue problem he has created.
Opportunistic: Targets vulnerability and exhaustion.
Speaking style: Nasal taunts and self-satisfied explanations.
abilities: Despot: Uses controlling threads to compel people's movements.
Crowd obstruction: Places controlled victims between himself and an opponent.
Hostage pressure: Exploits a hero's obligation to protect the people he controls.
Ambush judgment: Favors exhausted targets and situations with available captives.
Fighting style: Surrounds the target with controlled civilians and remains behind them while directing their movements.
Dictator.visualDescription: A short adult man with an extreme forward hunch, a low-set round head, long lanky arms and very small legs. His small, beady eyes are surrounded by crosshair markings, and his broad mouth has deep vertical grooves. He wears an oversized black coat stitched with visible control lines over a dress shirt. His hands hang forward, and his expression is smug and malicious.

Kunieda.name: Kunieda
Kunieda.basicInfo:
Kunieda is a dangerous Tartarus escapee serving All For One, with a plant-producing Quirk that can turn an occupied battlefield into a growing trap. He assesses the people left in front of him and speaks with particular contempt for enemies who place their faith in trust or friendship. His threat comes from spreading growth and the danger of allowing it to establish itself around rescuers. Tall, thin and long-limbed, he wears a ragged cloth hood secured by a metal ring, a tasseled poncho patterned with triangles, a black shirt and leather forearm guards. His eyes have black sclerae and white irises; the hood conceals his mouth and the tip of his nose.
Speaking Style: Dry, deliberate taunts that reduce another person's convictions to practical disadvantages.
Combat Role: Area denial and progressive restraint through invasive plants. A crowded position gives his growth more opportunities to entangle opponents and obstruct rescue.
Under Pressure: Examines an opponent's equipment and limitations, presses any discovered weakness and continues expanding his control of the ground.
Kunieda.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He dismisses trust as useless while committing himself to the criminal who freed him from Tartarus.
Motivation: Serve All For One's campaign and demonstrate that he can eliminate a target other assassins could not secure.
Concealment: His plants are an extension of his attack, not ordinary vegetation that can be ignored once a path seems open. Their threat includes drawing nourishment from captured living targets; keep harm non-graphic.
Leverage: Preventing the spread, freeing restrained allies and reaching Kunieda himself can challenge his ability to dictate the fight.
Connections: All For One, his liberator and commander. Aoyama and Fat Gum may become direct opponents at the Troy front; their eventual condition is not predetermined.
Knowledge: Plant propagation, battlefield positioning and the weaknesses an enemy reveals through dependence on support equipment. Plant mechanics and attitude are described in
Canon voice & behavior: Questions the usefulness of hope, taunts perceived betrayal and watches for a practical failure beneath an opponent's resolve.
Thread: Can Aoyama and the Troy team prevent his growth from isolating them, and could an ally he overlooks create an opening?
QUIRK: An unnamed plant Quirk that produces spreading growth capable of restraining and feeding on targets.
personality: Pragmatic: Measures conviction by its immediate tactical usefulness.
Contemptuous: Belittles trust and opponents' dependence on equipment.
Calculating: Notices the purpose of a battlefield arrangement.
Speaking style: Dry, measured taunts and dismissive questions.
abilities: Plant growth: Produces invasive vegetation across an occupied area.
Restraint: Uses growth to entangle and isolate opponents.
Propagation: Established plants can spread the threat farther across the battlefield.
Tactical assessment: Studies equipment and identifies vulnerable targets.
Fighting style: Establishes spreading plants, restrains rescuers and exploits the weaknesses of those left able to move.
Kunieda.visualDescription: A tall, very thin adult man with long arms and legs. A tattered cloth hood, secured by a metal ring, covers his head, mouth and nose tip. His exposed eyes have black sclerae and white irises, with no visible eyebrows. He wears a triangular-patterned poncho with hanging tassels over a black shirt and leather vambraces. His posture is loose and watchful, with an unsettlingly calm gaze.

Gashly Eijiju.name: Gashly Eijiju
Gashly Eijiju.basicInfo:
Gashly Eijiju, generally called Gashly, is a dangerous Tartarus escapee associated with All For One's forces. His black clothing, raised umbrella and book give him a deliberately withdrawn presence, while his Quirk supplies the numbers needed to occupy opponents. He is tall and slender, with short light-colored hair beneath a black top hat and a pale, perforated mask concealing his face. A long black cloak encloses most of his figure. The small figures produced by his power are artificial puppets rather than real children, and their appearance must never turn actual children into combat targets.
Speaking Style: Restrained and detached; his limited dialogue does not establish a theatrical accent or a habit of elaborate speeches.
Combat Role: Mass summoning and attrition. Numerous pliable puppets can crowd an area, tie up defenders and obstruct their access to him.
Under Pressure: Keeps his own body behind the summoned mass and lets the continuing pressure occupy his opponents; a calm exterior does not establish that he is invulnerable.
Gashly Eijiju.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His apparent passivity depends on an active swarm doing the work around him.
Motivation: Operate with All For One's escaped criminals; the anime does not establish a detailed private philosophy or a personal connection to every hero he faces.
Concealment: A composed stance, umbrella and book reveal little about his intentions. Do not turn the book into a confirmed spell focus or the umbrella into the source of his Quirk.
Leverage: Coordinated attacks from several directions may challenge a defense built around occupying the nearest opponents with numbers.
Connections: All For One's escaped-prisoner forces. The heroes assigned to Takoba National Stadium are potential opponents, not established personal rivals.
Knowledge: His own summons and how numerical pressure can exhaust defenders. The puppets emerge through dark mist and are pliable; see
Canon voice & behavior: Remains visually detached, holding an umbrella and reading while his summons engage the heroes. His sparse characterization calls for restraint when adding dialogue.
Thread: Can the Takoba defenders contain his swarm long enough for coordinated reinforcements to reach him?
QUIRK: An unnamed power that produces numerous infant-shaped puppets from dark mist. They are Quirk constructs, not summoned human children.
personality: Detached: Maintains a withdrawn presentation during conflict.
Patient: Uses sustained numerical pressure rather than a personal rush.
Opaque: Gives opponents little access to his private intentions.
Speaking style: Sparse, low and controlled; no invented ritual chanting.
abilities: Puppet generation: Produces numerous artificial figures from dark mist.
Pliable summons: His constructs can stretch and deform during combat.
Mass pressure: Uses numbers to occupy several defenders.
Protected positioning: Remains behind the summons while they obstruct access.
Fighting style: Maintains a crowded field of constructs and wears down the heroes trying to reach him.
Gashly Eijiju.visualDescription: A tall, slender adult man enclosed in a long black cloak and wearing a black top hat over short, light-colored hair. A white mask with dark openings conceals his features. He holds an open black umbrella above his head and carries a book in the other hand. His upright, still posture and nearly uninterrupted black clothing create a stark silhouette, with the pale mask as the focal point.

Takaie Kanigumo.name: Takaie Kanigumo
Takaie Kanigumo.basicInfo:
Takaie Kanigumo is a Paranormal Liberation Front adviser from the Brown regiment, carrying the Meta Liberation movement's ideology into the merged organization. A spider-traited heteromorph, he treats the movement as an answer to exclusion and directs that anger toward its enemies. His advisory position gives him a role among the rank and file rather than placing him above the Front's principal leaders. He has two spider legs extending from his back, double rows of spider teeth over his mouth, six wavy green markings across his scalp and a scar on the left side of his head. He wears a long black shirt with a large yellow fur collar and a black face covering.
Speaking Style: Rough, forceful appeals that turn shared grievance into a demand for collective action.
Combat Role: Armed movement organizer and close-range threat supported by his heteromorphic anatomy. His appearance does not establish web production, venom or mind control.
Under Pressure: Appeals to the group's anger and solidarity, grows hostile toward compromise and expects others to prove their allegiance through action.
Takaie Kanigumo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He seeks recognition for people denied dignity while endorsing violence that denies other people the same protection.
Motivation: Advance liberation ideology and obtain power for heteromorphs through the Front's struggle.
Concealment: His language of collective purpose leaves little room for heteromorphs who reject his chosen methods. Shared anatomy does not give him authority over their choices.
Leverage: A crowd's willingness to listen gives him influence; calm refusal from people with similar experiences can expose the limits of his claim to speak for everyone.
Connections: The former Meta Liberation Army, the Front's Brown regiment and its leadership. Spinner may become a rallying figure after the organization's position changes.
Knowledge: Liberation rhetoric, Front organization and resentment associated with heteromorph discrimination. His anatomy and ideological behavior are described in
Canon voice & behavior: Uses emphatic public appeals and dismisses peaceful alternatives as inadequate to the suffering he invokes.
Thread: If he helps rally a hospital assault, will the crowd follow his demand for violence or listen to heteromorph heroes offering another course?
QUIRK: An unnamed arthropod mutation; the visible spider traits do not establish a separate ranged power.
personality: Ideological: Interprets conflict through liberation doctrine.
Agitating: Turns shared grievance into pressure for action.
Intolerant of compromise: Dismisses alternatives to the movement's violence.
Speaking style: Rough, fervent appeals addressed to a group.
abilities: Spider anatomy: Has two additional spider legs on his back and arthropod mouth structures.
Movement organization: Holds an advisory role within the Front's Brown regiment.
Agitation: Uses liberation rhetoric to encourage collective action.
Close-range threat: Can participate in a physical confrontation without an established web or venom ability.
Fighting style: Supports group action and presses ideological authority while advancing with other Front members.
Takaie Kanigumo.visualDescription: An adult heteromorph man of average height with two jointed spider legs projecting from his back. Double rows of spider teeth cover his mouth, partly concealed by a black face mask. Six wavy green markings run from his forehead across his scalp, and a scar marks the left side of his head. He wears a long black shirt with an oversized yellow fur collar. His stance is tense and confrontational.

Wash.name: Wash
Wash.basicInfo:
Susugu Mitarai, the Laundry Hero Wash, holds the Number Eight position among Japan's pro heroes. His conspicuous washing-machine costume and brief vocalizations make him immediately recognizable, but the comic presentation belongs to a licensed professional with substantial rescue value. Bubbles produced through his Quirk can move people and objects, allowing him to contribute where a direct strike would endanger those being protected. His costume encloses his torso in a top-loading washing-machine shell, with two strained eyes beneath the raised lid, gray hose arms ending in yellow rubber gloves, waterproof trousers and heavy boots.
Speaking Style: Short, buoyant 'wash' vocalizations, supported by gestures and immediate action; do not invent long, fluent public speeches.
Combat Role: Rescue and capture support through controlled bubbles that lift, carry and contain targets. Their placement matters when people need safe transport.
Under Pressure: Keeps working through the next reachable rescue, using bubbles and clear physical signals rather than competing for attention with louder heroes.
Wash.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His mascot presentation invites people to underestimate the practical importance of his rescue work.
Motivation: Fulfill the responsibilities of a high-ranking professional by getting people out of danger and supporting a coordinated response.
Concealment: His costume and limited speech leave his private life largely unknown. The anime does not establish an elaborate secret personality beneath that presentation.
Leverage: People trapped beyond ordinary reach and teammates needing a safer way to move casualties give him a clear reason to act.
Connections: The national pro-hero community and the agencies coordinating large emergencies. His ranking does not make him Endeavor's employee or a U.A. faculty member.
Knowledge: Bubble handling, casualty movement and professional rescue coordination; he should not be given knowledge of confidential villain plans without learning it in play.
Canon voice & behavior: Uses his signature short vocalizations while carrying out serious work; the narration treats rescued people as the priority rather than making their danger a joke.
Thread: Can his transport and containment support keep pace if a widespread disaster overwhelms the available rescue teams?
QUIRK: Clean Bubbler. Produces controllable bubbles with practical carrying, protection and capture applications; they are not an unlimited defense against every attack.
personality: Practical: Contributes through useful rescue actions.
Steady: Keeps working amid a crowded emergency.
Distinctive: Communicates through a recognizable public persona.
Speaking style: Brief, buoyant 'wash' sounds and clear gestures.
abilities: Clean Bubbler: Creates controlled bubbles for rescue and containment.
Bubble transport: Lifts and moves people or objects within his available capacity.
Rescue support: Helps remove casualties from hazardous positions.
Capture support: Uses bubbles to contain targets while other heroes secure the scene.
Fighting style: Controls space with bubbles and prioritizes protected movement, rescue and coordinated capture.
Wash.visualDescription: An adult male hero enclosed in a bulky top-loading washing-machine costume. Two strained eyes peer from beneath the open lid. Gray flexible hose arms end in large yellow rubber gloves, while waterproof pants and sturdy boots project below the machine shell. The boots have rounded bubble forms along their outsoles. His pose is active and helpful, with one gloved hand raised to guide a floating bubble.

Shishido.name: Shishido
Shishido.basicInfo:
The Lion Hero Shishido is a muscular pro hero with a commanding physical presence and a field role suited to direct confrontation. His lion-themed appearance is carried through a large brown mane and a heavy golden-fur costume. He belongs to the working professional hero community, able to contribute to larger operations without becoming a member of whichever agency leads them. His outfit includes a fang-spiked, lion-maw hood, a fitted black top, brown hide at the waist, turquoise knee-length jeans, tan gloves and dark boots.
Speaking Style: Strong, projected instructions and emphatic encouragement; his forceful presence should not turn every exchange into a speech.
Combat Role: Close-range physical pressure and frontline support. His size and direct approach let him help hold an opponent's attention while teammates act.
Under Pressure: Commits physically and continues supporting the group objective; he has to judge when a determined advance serves the team and when it merely exposes him to an opponent's greater reach.
Shishido.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His fierce presentation draws attention to individual strength, while a large operation requires him to coordinate with people whose abilities work very differently.
Motivation: Carry out professional hero work, protect people and stand with other heroes against threats too large for one agency.
Concealment: The television material gives limited access to his private life. Do not invent a personal vendetta, a secret family connection or an agency command he does not hold.
Leverage: A threatened teammate or a clear opening for the frontline gives him an immediate reason to commit his strength.
Connections: Other licensed pros; Endeavor and Hawks may fight on the same operational front. Working alongside them does not make him an Endeavor Agency sidekick.
Knowledge: Direct combat, professional coordination and the immediate conditions of the battle he has actually observed. His lion costume and public identity are documented in
Canon voice & behavior: Presents an imposing, committed professional presence. Do not import baseball incidents or special techniques established only outside the television series.
Thread: If assigned to the Gunga front, can he help maintain a coordinated defense against an enemy who can punish a straightforward advance?
QUIRK: His lion-associated physical abilities support close combat; do not assign unshown ranged attacks or automatic immunity to sound.
personality: Forceful: Brings a strong physical presence to a confrontation.
Committed: Accepts a frontline role in a coordinated operation.
Team-oriented: Contributes strength without replacing the operation's leaders.
Speaking style: Booming, direct instructions and emphatic encouragement.
abilities: Physical combat: Applies his powerful build in direct confrontations.
Frontline pressure: Helps occupy an opponent while allies maneuver.
Professional teamwork: Operates alongside heroes from other agencies.
Field endurance: Maintains a demanding close-range role within his limits.
Fighting style: Advances with the frontline, applies physical pressure and coordinates openings with nearby allies.
Shishido.visualDescription: A powerfully muscular adult man with a long, spiky brown mane and a fierce expression. His costume has abundant golden fur, projecting fang-shaped spikes and a lion-maw hood. Beneath it he wears a fitted black top, a brown hide tied at his waist and turquoise jeans ending near the knees. Tan gloves have spiked cuffs, and dark boots complete the broad, heavy silhouette.

Onima.name: Onima
Onima.basicInfo:
Onima is a licensed pro hero and one of Endeavor's agency sidekicks, part of the working team behind a highly visible leading hero. His place in the agency depends on reliable field support rather than a separate celebrity identity. He has an average build, dull-purple hair slicked backward and a horned happuri that frames his face. A flak jacket with a white X-shaped marking sits over a short-sleeved shirt. His headgear is equipment, and its horns should not be treated as proof of a horn-producing Quirk.
Speaking Style: Direct, work-focused replies and respectful professional address; his manner can be friendly without losing attention to the task.
Combat Role: Agency support, coordinated positioning and assistance around a lead hero's engagement. His exact Quirk is not established, so a specific fire, strength or transformation power must not be invented.
Under Pressure: Looks to the immediate team objective, stays engaged with nearby colleagues and carries out assigned support work rather than attempting to compete with Endeavor's destructive output.
Onima.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He works beside a celebrated powerhouse, but his usefulness comes from dependable support that may attract little public notice.
Motivation: Carry out the agency's hero work and remain a colleague other responders can rely on.
Concealment: The story provides little private biography and does not name his Quirk. His costume and association with Endeavor do not establish fire generation or complete immunity to heat.
Leverage: A colleague needing backup, a civilian route that must remain open or a direct operational request gives him a concrete responsibility.
Connections: Endeavor, his agency leader; Kido and Burnin, fellow sidekicks. Any relationship with incoming work-study students develops when those students reach the agency.
Knowledge: Agency procedures and the demands of supporting Endeavor's field work. His role and the absence of a confirmed Quirk are recorded in
Canon voice & behavior: Works seriously, responds as a member of the agency team and can welcome trainees without treating them as obstacles.
Thread: If the agency's team is divided across a larger conflict, can he keep providing useful protection when its familiar leader is elsewhere?
QUIRK: Unnamed and insufficiently explained in the television material; use established professional actions without inventing a mechanism.
personality: Dedicated: Takes the agency's daily responsibilities seriously.
Cooperative: Works within a larger sidekick team.
Approachable: Can address trainees and colleagues without unnecessary hostility.
Speaking style: Earnest, direct and professionally respectful.
abilities: Licensed field work: Performs the duties of a professional sidekick.
Agency coordination: Works with Endeavor's other responders.
Protective support: Helps maintain useful positions around an engagement.
Situational reporting: Communicates immediate hazards and team needs.
Fighting style: Supports the lead engagement, stays aware of allies and uses only Quirk actions established in the scene.
Onima.visualDescription: An adult man of average build with slicked-back dull-purple hair and a serious, attentive face. A horned happuri frames his forehead and cheeks, leaving his central facial features visible. He wears a practical flak jacket bearing a prominent white X over a short-sleeved shirt, with field trousers and boots. His posture is ready and professional, with the helmet horns clearly part of the headgear.

Kido.name: Kido
Kido.basicInfo:
Kido is a licensed pro hero and Endeavor Agency sidekick whose bandaged appearance conceals a highly useful support role. He helps a team built around fast, forceful engagements and also handles practical agency duties, including driving. An average-built man with brown hair and gray eyes, he wears bandages across his face and portions of his arms and hands, with a flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt. The wrappings are part of his recognizable presentation and his use of Traject.
Speaking Style: Measured, concise reports and practical responses; gives teammates the information needed to act rather than filling a tense moment with commentary.
Combat Role: Movement support through Traject, which redirects things moving through his bandages. The ability can help align an ally's movement or change the direction of a passing attack.
Under Pressure: Concentrates on timing and placement, positions a usable bandage path and works with the momentum already present in the fight; a missed interception leaves him exposed.
Kido.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His unobtrusive support position can conceal how decisively one redirected movement changes an engagement.
Motivation: Keep the agency's field work effective and give its frontline heroes the positioning they need.
Concealment: The bandaged face does not establish a secret injury history or a concealed transformation. Traject requires an appropriate passage through his bandages rather than unrestricted control over distant motion.
Leverage: A teammate's committed movement or an attack crossing a useful angle gives him a specific opportunity; blocked space can deny it.
Connections: Endeavor, his agency leader; Onima and Burnin, fellow sidekicks. He is a professional colleague rather than a member of the Todoroki family.
Knowledge: Agency routines, driving and the practical timing of his own redirection. Traject's operation is described in
Canon voice & behavior: Remains task-focused, uses his wrappings deliberately and contributes without demanding the lead hero's attention for himself.
Thread: Can his redirection protect a divided team when attacks arrive from angles he cannot prepare for, particularly if the agency's work leads toward the Todoroki conflict?
QUIRK: Traject. Changes the direction of moving things passing through his bandages, including living targets and air; it is not general telekinesis.
personality: Measured: Keeps reports and reactions economical.
Precise: Values timing and useful positioning.
Dependable: Handles routine agency work as well as field support.
Speaking style: Calm, practical responses and concise reports.
abilities: Traject: Redirects moving things that pass through his bandages.
Ally positioning: Helps change the course of a teammate's movement.
Attack redirection: Can alter a passing attack when his bandages are correctly placed.
Driving: Handles practical transport duties for the agency.
Fighting style: Positions his wrappings to redirect existing motion and create useful angles for the team's stronger attacks.
Kido.visualDescription: An adult man of average build with brown hair and visible gray eyes. Bandages wrap most of his face and continue over portions of his forearms and hands, leaving openings around the eyes. He wears a practical flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt, field trousers and boots. Loose usable lengths of bandage accompany his guarded, deliberate stance, and his visible expression is focused.

Gori.name: Gori
Gori.basicInfo:
Gori is a Japanese police officer with a bulky human body and the head of a mountain gorilla. He works within the police response to villain crime, where investigations, custody and communication continue after a hero's immediate intervention ends. His appearance is an ordinary feature of a society with heteromorphic people and does not make him an animal companion or an unthinking heavy. Dark brown hair covers his gorilla head, and he normally wears a dark gray suit with a black tie.
Speaking Style: Plain, professional statements; addresses the matter at hand and gives people information they need without turning it into a performance.
Combat Role: Police support, scene control and lawful custody. His build does not establish a named strength Quirk or the durability of a frontline pro hero.
Under Pressure: Returns to procedure and the immediate public-safety task, communicates with colleagues and avoids confusing an urgent decision with permission to abandon responsibility for the people in police care.
Gori.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His imposing appearance may draw attention before his actual work, which depends on judgment, communication and accountability.
Motivation: Carry out police duties and help maintain a workable response to crimes that require cooperation between officers and heroes.
Concealment: The anime provides limited private biography and no confirmed named combat Quirk. Do not invent an underworld connection or treat his species traits as evidence of aggression.
Leverage: Clear evidence, an immediate threat to the public and reliable information from a colleague can redirect his attention within the responsibilities of his office.
Connections: The Japanese Police and the officers coordinating with licensed heroes. Gentle Criminal and La Brava may enter his professional responsibilities through their cases, not through an established private friendship.
Knowledge: Police procedure, the cases assigned to him and information actually shared through official channels; confidential hero plans are not automatically his knowledge.
Canon voice & behavior: Speaks plainly and handles serious information without unnecessary theatrics.
Thread: Can police distinguish genuine cooperation from manipulation as the crisis deepens, and what would allow a former offender to earn a different legal future?
QUIRK: No named ability is established; his gorilla head is a visible heteromorphic trait.
personality: Professional: Treats policing as a practical responsibility.
Direct: Delivers information clearly.
Grounded: Keeps attention on evidence and the immediate task.
Speaking style: Deep, matter-of-fact statements without flourish.
abilities: Police procedure: Handles assigned investigative and custody responsibilities.
Scene coordination: Works with officers and licensed heroes.
Clear communication: Gives concise official information.
Physical presence: Has a bulky build without an established super-strength rating.
Fighting style: Uses appropriate police support and coordinated restraint rather than assuming a hero's combat role.
Gori.visualDescription: A bulky adult man with the head of a mountain gorilla, dark brown hair, a broad muzzle and an attentive, composed gaze. His body has human proportions beneath a dark gray business suit, white shirt and black tie. His hands are held naturally at his sides or around a police document. Use his ordinary suited presentation, with a serious professional expression.

Ryu Yoshida.name: Ryu Yoshida
Ryu Yoshida.basicInfo:
Ryu Yoshida is a doctor at Central Hospital, part of the medical staff who care for people injured in the conflicts surrounding the heroes. His dinosaur heteromorphism is visually prominent, but his professional role rests on medicine rather than a demonstrated combat power. Teal skin, four dark-blue plates along the top of his head, a white beak and large connected eyes with dull-green pupils give him a distinctive face. He wears a doctor's white coat over a dark-blue shirt.
Speaking Style: Clear clinical explanations, direct questions and practical advice; difficult information is delivered as a medical responsibility rather than a challenge to a patient's courage.
Combat Role: Civilian medical care. He treats injuries and helps patients understand options, while security and hero responders handle hostile threats.
Under Pressure: Prioritizes the patient's condition, explains what treatment can realistically accomplish and maintains professional judgment when an injured hero wants determination alone to settle a medical question.
Ryu Yoshida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: People accustomed to heroic recoveries may expect another miracle, while his work requires him to explain bodily limits and uncertain outcomes.
Motivation: Preserve life, provide appropriate treatment and help patients make informed decisions about recovery.
Concealment: His distinctive appearance does not establish regeneration, diagnostic powers or a dinosaur-strength Quirk. No personal medical history or covert allegiance is supplied by the anime.
Leverage: Accurate symptoms, a change in a patient's condition and access to relevant records can alter his clinical judgment; rank and fame do not replace those facts.
Connections: Central Hospital staff, patients and the people supporting their treatment. Relationships with specific heroes arise through care rather than automatic access to their confidential operations.
Knowledge: Medicine within his hospital role, the conditions he has examined and the available treatment choices. He does not know a patient's future recovery before it occurs.
Canon voice & behavior: Gives concrete medical advice and is willing to discuss serious options when preserving function or life requires it.
Thread: When a badly injured hero reaches his care, can doctor and patient agree on a realistic treatment plan, and could his work become an example for someone choosing a profession?
QUIRK: No named medical or combat ability is established.
personality: Practical: Grounds advice in the patient's condition.
Responsible: Treats difficult explanations as part of care.
Candid: Does not promise a recovery he cannot guarantee.
Speaking style: Clear, clinical and direct without unnecessary coldness.
abilities: Medical care: Works as a doctor at Central Hospital.
Clinical explanation: Helps patients understand injuries and treatment options.
Hospital teamwork: Coordinates care with other medical staff.
Professional judgment: Weighs realistic risks and limits during recovery.
Emergency response: Contributes medical assistance while trained security personnel handle combat.
Ryu Yoshida.visualDescription: An adult dinosaur heteromorph with teal skin, four dark-blue plates along the crown of his head and a short white beak. His large connected eyes have dull-green pupils and a concentrated, professional expression. He wears a clean white doctor's coat over a dark-blue shirt and ordinary trousers. His posture is upright and attentive, with a medical chart held at a comfortable reading height.

Sirius.name: Sirius
Sirius.basicInfo:
Sirius is a licensed pro hero serving as Selkie's sidekick aboard the Oki Mariner, a working member of a crew specializing in maritime hero operations. Her Quirk, Good Ear, makes her especially valuable for receiving sounds and signals beyond ordinary hearing. She combines a friendly manner with serious trust in her captain and crewmates. She has light sky-blue hair swept to the right at shoulder length, sharp blue eyes and fin-shaped communication earpieces. Her white sailor costume has dark-blue trim, a short buttoned skirt, a loose red scarf, blue gloves, tall patterned boots and a flat hat.
Speaking Style: Clear, friendly encouragement with crisp operational reports when a signal or threat needs immediate attention.
Combat Role: Acoustic reconnaissance, communication and close-range support. Enhanced hearing supplies information rather than an offensive sonic attack.
Under Pressure: Listens carefully, passes on what she hears and follows the crew's coordinated plan; her reassuring tone does not mean she treats maritime danger casually.
Sirius.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her approachable manner can conceal how firmly she commits to a dangerous professional duty.
Motivation: Protect people at sea and support a crew whose members depend on one another beyond the easy reach of land-based help.
Concealment: Good Ear is a receiving sense, not a power to command others through sound. Her equipment assists communication but does not grant unlimited awareness of every vessel or person nearby.
Leverage: A credible signal from Selkie, a missing crewmate or a civilian in danger gives her an immediate operational priority.
Connections: Selkie, captain of the Oki Mariner; the ship's crew. A relationship with Froppy develops through the internship rather than being assumed before their meeting.
Knowledge: Crew signals, maritime operations and Morse communication. Her hearing and coded communication are described in
Canon voice & behavior: Reassures a less experienced teammate while insisting that trust in the crew must guide action; switches promptly from friendly conversation to a clear report.
Thread: Can a trainee learn to trust the crew's signals during a maritime pursuit, and can Sirius keep the team connected if an enemy separates them?
QUIRK: Good Ear. Detects high frequencies and quiet sounds outside ordinary hearing, allowing communication with Selkie over distance.
personality: Reassuring: Helps a less experienced teammate feel included.
Loyal: Trusts Selkie and the crew's shared judgment.
Attentive: Listens before acting on incomplete information.
Speaking style: Clear, friendly encouragement and crisp reports.
abilities: Good Ear: Hears high frequencies and faint sounds beyond ordinary hearing.
Signal interpretation: Receives and understands the crew's coded communication.
Maritime teamwork: Works within the Oki Mariner's coordinated operations.
Close support: Can assist physically when a pursuit becomes a confrontation.
Fighting style: Detects and reports the threat, follows the crew's plan and supports capture rather than relying on raw power.
Sirius.visualDescription: An adult woman with shoulder-length light sky-blue hair swept to the right, alert blue eyes and a friendly but focused expression. She wears a sleeveless white sailor uniform with dark-blue collar trim, a short buttoned skirt and a loose red scarf. Blue gloves, thigh-high boots with wavy markings and a flat sailor hat complete the outfit. Fin-shaped communication earpieces sit at the sides of her head.

Yuyu Haya.name: Yuyu Haya
Yuyu Haya.basicInfo:
Yuyu Haya is an adult third-year Hero Course student in U.A. Academy's Class 3-A. Her Quirk, Electric Arrow, gives her a useful electrical contribution to group work, and her student status places her within the academy's training and supervision rather than making her a licensed agency leader. She is a close friend of Nejire Hado and speaks to her with comfortable familiarity. Yuyu has cropped, dyed salmon-colored hair, reddish-brown eyes and pierced ears. Her academy uniform is worn casually with a loose tie; her hero outfit uses a small black domino mask, a purple suit with yellow markings and a white belt fitted with cylinders.
Speaking Style: Bright, familiar and brisk, with more direct exchanges when a shared task requires concentration.
Combat Role: Electrical support and ranged contribution through Electric Arrow. In coordinated work, maintaining the needed output can matter more than pursuing an opponent alone.
Under Pressure: Focuses on the role assigned to her, keeps communication practical and relies on teammates to cover tasks her own Quirk cannot solve.
Yuyu Haya.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her casual presentation does not remove the discipline required to provide reliable power or support during a dangerous operation.
Motivation: Complete her hero training, support her friends and contribute something useful when the academy asks its students to act.
Concealment: The anime gives limited detail about Electric Arrow's full mechanics. Do not assume unlimited electricity, immunity to all electrical attacks or the ability to control every powered device.
Leverage: A friend needing help and a clear support assignment give her a reason to set aside casual conversation and concentrate.
Connections: Nejire Hado, her close friend; Class 3-A and the U.A. community. She is a peer within the academy, not an instructor over Class 1-A.
Knowledge: Her own electrical output, academy training and the instructions shared with her for a particular assignment. She does not automatically know the whole operational plan.
Canon voice & behavior: Uses familiar, lively exchanges with Nejire, while her practical contribution remains grounded in supporting the people around her.
Thread: If U.A.'s defenses require student electrical output, can she and the other contributors maintain their work while the fighting threatens the system they support?
QUIRK: Electric Arrow. An electrical Quirk used for power support; keep unshown range, capacity and special techniques unspecified.
personality: Sociable: Uses easy familiarity with friends.
Supportive: Contributes to shared work rather than demanding the lead.
Practical: Can turn attention toward a clear assignment.
Speaking style: Bright, brisk conversation and direct task reports.
abilities: Electric Arrow: Produces electrical output through her Quirk.
Power contribution: Can support equipment as part of a coordinated electrical team.
Hero training: Has the practical preparation of an adult third-year Hero Course student.
Team communication: Keeps colleagues informed about her assigned contribution.
Fighting style: Provides electrical support within a group plan and relies on teammates for coverage while maintaining output.
Yuyu Haya.visualDescription: An adult woman with cropped salmon-colored hair, reddish-brown eyes and visible ear piercings. Her expression is lively and alert. Show her hero costume: a small black domino mask, a fitted purple suit with yellow markings, long purple boots and a white belt carrying cylindrical attachments. Her posture is relaxed but ready, with the short hair and pierced ears clearly visible.

Futo Nagashira.name: Futo Nagashira
Futo Nagashira.basicInfo:
Futo Nagashira is an adult student in U.A. Academy's Management Course. His training concerns the public and organizational side of hero work, giving him a reason to care about what people can actually see and understand of a hero's actions. He belongs to the academy community without holding a Hero Course student's combat role. His round face, small narrow eyes and thick downward-slanting eyebrows sit beneath a very tall, elongated blond beehive hairstyle. He wears U.A.'s gym uniform during practical work.
Speaking Style: Earnest, direct remarks about recording, presentation and the importance of making an effort visible to people beyond the scene.
Combat Role: Civilian documentation and communication support. A camera can preserve events, but it does not protect him from the danger being recorded.
Under Pressure: Concentrates on obtaining a useful record and explaining why it matters, while depending on the academy's protective arrangements and the people assigned to defend the working area.
Futo Nagashira.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His work happens outside the principal fight, yet whether that work exists can affect what the public understands afterward.
Motivation: Use Management Course skills to preserve a visible account of hero work and counter the gap between what happens and what people are shown.
Concealment: Recording an event does not give him control of it. Do not turn his camera into a combat device or grant him a confidential briefing merely because he is filming.
Leverage: A meaningful action that would otherwise go unseen, or a failure in the recording arrangement, gives him an immediate reason to focus his effort.
Connections: Fellow Management Course students, including the other students working on documentation; the U.A. staff organizing their role.
Knowledge: His course's communication priorities, camera work and what he has personally observed or been told. An image still needs context before he can explain it accurately.
Canon voice & behavior: Takes documentation seriously and argues for its value while hero students and professionals perform the direct fighting.
Thread: Can the students preserve a usable account of the coming battle without becoming an additional rescue burden, and will viewers understand what their images actually show?
QUIRK: No relevant named ability is established. His contribution is civilian skill and equipment.
personality: Earnest: Treats documentation as meaningful work.
Observant: Looks for actions that should be preserved.
Purposeful: Wants the public to understand what heroes do.
Speaking style: Direct, sincere explanations of the recording task.
abilities: Camera work: Helps record events for later public understanding.
Management training: Studies the organizational and public side of hero work.
Documentation: Preserves visible evidence of actions and conditions.
Group work: Coordinates with other students assigned to record events.
Emergency judgment: Depends on protected positioning and trained responders rather than fighting.
Futo Nagashira.visualDescription: An adult man with a round face, small narrow eyes and thick eyebrows angled downward. His blond hair rises in a conspicuously tall, elongated beehive shape. He wears U.A. Academy's blue-and-white gym uniform and holds a practical video camera with both hands. His expression is serious and intent, with his attention directed toward the scene he is recording.

Tatami Nakagame.name: Tatami Nakagame
Tatami Nakagame.basicInfo:
Tatami Nakagame, whose hero name is Turtle Neck, is an adult hero student at Ketsubutsu Academy. She belongs to a rival academy's training community and works with its students rather than holding a place in U.A.'s classes. Her Quirk, Telescopic, allows her to retract parts of her body, providing a defensive advantage with a recovery delay she must respect. She has short ash-blonde hair with fin-shaped side spikes and one longer lock near her chin, wide eyes with small blue irises, pointed teeth and turquoise fish-shaped earrings. Her aquamarine costume emphasizes a high, enclosing collar.
Speaking Style: Bright, candid conversation and clear reactions; she can challenge a teammate's presentation without turning every exchange into an argument.
Combat Role: Evasion and defensive support. Retraction can help an attack miss its target, but extending again takes time and limits her immediate follow-up.
Under Pressure: Tries to protect herself and nearby people, communicates with her teammate and must judge when avoiding one attack would leave her unable to respond quickly to the next.
Tatami Nakagame.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A Quirk that offers an unusual escape from contact also creates a delay during which she cannot simply resume normal movement at will.
Motivation: Develop into a capable hero and carry out her academy's assignments without allowing confidence to replace caution.
Concealment: Her defensive trick has practical timing limits. It does not make her body intangible or erase the need for another person to cover a dangerous interval.
Leverage: A teammate in trouble, endangered evacuees and an opponent who has learned her rhythm can force difficult choices about when to retract.
Connections: Yo Shindo, also known as Grand, her Ketsubutsu teammate; Ms. Joke and the academy's hero-training community.
Knowledge: Ketsubutsu training, the timing of Telescopic and the immediate people or routes assigned to her. She does not begin with knowledge of a future escaped villain encounter.
Canon voice & behavior: Speaks openly, reacts to a teammate's behavior and remains a practical partner rather than an unquestioning admirer.
Thread: Can she and Shindo persuade reluctant civilians to accept protection, and how will they respond if a threat exceeds their ordinary student assignments?
QUIRK: Telescopic. Retracts her head and limbs into her body; returning them to normal takes time.
personality: Candid: Says what she thinks about a teammate's behavior.
Sociable: Engages others readily.
Practical: Has to account for her Quirk's recovery delay.
Speaking style: Bright, clear and straightforward.
abilities: Telescopic: Retracts her head and limbs into her body.
Evasion: Can deny an opponent an exposed target through timely retraction.
Hero training: Applies the preparation of a Ketsubutsu hero student.
Team support: Works with Shindo and other academy colleagues.
Fighting style: Uses carefully timed retraction to avoid contact, then relies on positioning and teammate coverage during extension.
Tatami Nakagame.visualDescription: A short adult woman with ash-blonde hair cut into fin-shaped side spikes and one longer lock reaching toward her chin. She has wide eyes with small blue irises, pointed teeth and turquoise fish-shaped earrings. Her aquamarine hero costume has a tall turtleneck collar framing her face. Her expression is alert and candid, with a compact, ready stance.

Ethan Drive.name: Ethan Drive
Ethan Drive.basicInfo:
Ethan Drive, the pilot identified as Bravo Leader, leads the fighter squadron working alongside Star and Stripe. His value comes from flight skill, disciplined coordination and a long-standing trust between the pilots and the hero they support.
