Pack: load 16.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[90,3]]]*/const D={"L_p90":"[[615,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). Izuku was born Quirkless: a doctor confirmed it when he was a small child, from an extra toe joint, and Katsuki Bakugo's contempt and the nickname Deku grew from that. Ten months before the entrance exam, on the day of the sludge villain attack, he met All Might out of hero form: a gaunt, wounded man (real name Toshinori Yagi) able to hold his hero form for only a few hours a day since a villain tore open his side five years earlier. All Might has not told Izuku who that villain was (All For One). All Might first told him a boy without a Quirk could not be a hero; when Izuku ran in to save Katsuki while the pros held back, All Might chose him to inherit his power.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Under All Might's ten-month plan Izuku cleared Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of trash to build a body that could hold the power, and on the morning of the entrance exam he received One For All by eating a strand of All Might's hair. One For All passes from holder to holder and grows with each: All Might is the eighth holder and Izuku the ninth, and the earlier holders' own Quirks lie dormant in it, out of his reach. His body cannot yet take its output, which is why every full release breaks him; he has no way yet to use a fraction of it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He keeps all of this from everyone, his mother and Katsuki included, and guards All Might's weakened form. Cornered by Katsuki, he is the likeliest to let slip that his power was given to him, though never by whom. Besides Izuku, only Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi and Sir Nighteye know All Might's condition and One For All. Recovery Girl knows Izuku holds it and scolds All Might over his fractures. All Might coaches Izuku in private and tries not to favor him openly in class.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[616,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Izuku's base secret holds as history. At the USJ attack All Might arrived late, having spent most of his day's hero time on the way to work; he beat the Nomu at his limit, and Izuku broke his legs leaping at Tomura Shigaraki to cover him until the other teachers arrived. All Might's daily time has shrunk further since. Before the festival All Might told Izuku to use it to show the country that he is here, the next symbol announcing himself.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"In the first round Hitoshi Shinso's Brainwashing held Izuku until silhouettes of One For All's past holders appeared and the power jerked through his fingers on its own, breaking them and freeing him; he does not understand what he saw. Shoto Todoroki asked him outright whether he is All Might's hidden son; the guess came from noticing All Might's attention, and the real link is the inheritance.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Until the story shows otherwise, every release still breaks what it passes through, because he has not learned to spread a small share of the power through his whole body, and he does not know the name All For One or One For All's origin until All Might tells him. Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino), a retired hero who taught All Might at U.A. and fought beside Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, knows One For All; All Might still dreads him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[617,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shota Aizawa\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa's dead classmate is Oboro Shirakumo, the third of the trio he formed with Hizashi Yamada as U.A. Hero Course students; Oboro died during their student years, and both men still grieve him. Narrator only (part of the All For One secret): Oboro's body was taken and remade into Kurogiri, the League of Villains' warp gate. Aizawa and Yamada do not know this; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. His record leaves the friend unnamed because the name leads straight to Kurogiri.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa knows no other big secret. Like the rest of the faculty apart from Principal Nezu and Recovery Girl, he knows only that All Might keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and he covers for him without asking why; he knows nothing of the injury, the true form or One For All, nor why All Might watches Izuku Midoriya so closely.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 16"];})();

Pack: load 17.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[93,3]]]*/const D={"L_p93":"[[618,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: All Might\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might's real name, never made public, is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. He received it as a young man from his master, Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, whom All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed while Toshinori was still in training. Her old partner Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring, and the memory still makes All Might shake.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"About six years ago, five years before he met Izuku Midoriya, All For One gave him a wound in a battle All Might believes he won: it tore open his left side, destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach, and it never healed. Since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day: about three hours when he met Izuku, less now after overexertion, and hard fights shorten it further. When it runs out he deflates in a burst of steam into his true form, a tall, gaunt man with hollow cheeks, sunken eyes and drooping blond tufts, lost in clothes cut for his hero form, who coughs up blood; in that form he is gentle, tired and self-deprecating. Hero work on the way in spends the day's time, so he arrives late, and every clumsy excuse covers a change. Recovery Girl treats him behind her closed door; her Quirk cannot heal the old wound.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only a few know his condition and One For All: Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. The rest of the faculty, Shota Aizawa included, know only that he keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and they cover for him without asking why. Students and public know nothing until the story reveals it. Sir Nighteye, his longtime sidekick, used Foresight on him after the injury and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead; he begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Ten months before the entrance exam, Izuku Midoriya, then Quirkless, ran at the sludge villain to save Katsuki Bakugo while pros held back, and All Might chose him to inherit One For All. He had Izuku clear Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk for ten months, then passed him the Quirk on the morning of the exam in a strand of hair to eat. At the start of the year every full release still breaks the limb it passes through; publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late. All Might teaches at U.A. above all to raise him, tries not to favor him openly, and fails. What remains in All Might are embers of the power, fading with each use.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might believes he killed All For One but has never been sure, and tells Izuku about him only when the story has him do it. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, nor, unless the story reveals it, that Tomura is Nana Shimura's grandson.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[619,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tomura Shigaraki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Tomura Shigaraki was born Tenko Shimura, son of Kotaro Shimura and grandson of Nana Shimura, All Might's master and the seventh holder of One For All. Nana gave her son up as a small boy to keep him safe from All For One; Kotaro grew up hating heroes for it and forbade his own son's hero games. When Tenko was a small child, his Quirk, Decay, awakened and destroyed his family: his dog, his sister, his mother and his grandparents. He turned it on his father on purpose. He wandered the streets for days, and nobody, hero or passerby, stopped to help him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All For One found him, renamed him Tomura Shigaraki and raised him to hate the world and become his heir. Most of the hands Tomura wears belonged to the family he destroyed, given to him to keep that hatred alive; the one over his face, \\\"Father\\\", was his father's. Tomura remembers his old life only in fragments and does not know he is Nana Shimura's grandson; All Might does not know it either until the story reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei is All For One: the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, who killed Nana Shimura, and who fought All Might about six years ago and gave him the wound that is slowly ending his career. All Might believes he died in that fight. He survived, badly hurt, his face destroyed, kept alive by machines, and guides Tomura from hiding through the monitor behind the bar. He knows All Might is weakened. He treats every attack Tomura makes as a lesson, whether it succeeds or fails, and means him to become the next symbol of fear; far later he plans to take Tomura's body for his own, and nothing this year shows it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kurogiri is a Nomu: a warp Quirk grafted onto the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, a U.A. student who died years ago, a classmate and close friend of Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada (Present Mic). He remembers nothing of that life; he was made to guard and manage Tomura and answers to All For One.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nomu are made from human bodies by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, whose labs lie hidden beneath it; All For One loads them with Quirks. They have no will of their own and obey Tomura's commands. The Nomu built to fight All Might has Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and strength to match his. Canon does not show how much Tomura knows about where Nomu come from; he treats them as tools.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[620,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Naomasa Tsukauchi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Naomasa Tsukauchi is one of the few people who know All Might's secret. He knows that All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi and that his power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder; that about six years ago a villain's attack left him gravely wounded, with half his respiratory system destroyed and his stomach removed; that he can hold his muscular hero form only for a limited time each day; and that outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. He has seen that true form, and he guards the secret absolutely: from fellow officers, from the press and from almost all of U.A.'s faculty. When All Might vanishes with a clumsy excuse, Tsukauchi knows why and covers for him without comment.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The others who know are Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya; canon does not show whether Tsukauchi knows that Izuku now holds One For All before the story brings them together. How much he knows of All For One canon also leaves open: keep it to what the story has All Might tell him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 17"];})();

Izuku was born Quirkless: a doctor confirmed it when he was a small child, from an extra joint in his little toe. The apology in Inko's record followed soon after, when he asked her whether he could still be a hero. For years everyone around them, Katsuki Bakugo included, took him for Quirkless, and so did Inko.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"His power is One For All, a stockpiling Quirk that passes from holder to holder; All Might gave it to him on the morning of the entrance exam. The ten months of dawn training she saw were All Might's plan: Izuku cleared Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk to build a body that could hold the power. Izuku keeps all of this from her, as from everyone, to guard All Might's secret. She has only the public version, a strong Quirk that came late, and she does not connect it to All Might.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She learns the truth only if the story has Izuku or All Might tell her. Until then her worry runs on what she can see: a son who comes home bruised, plays down his injuries and changes the subject when she asks about his Quirk.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf96\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[622,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Rei Todoroki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf97\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Rei's eldest, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. He was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might and inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, blue flames that his body, built more like Rei's, could not withstand. Endeavor stopped training him when the flames kept burning him and turned to Shoto; Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki; he later took the name Dabi; whether he joins the League is the story's to play. Purple burn scars are stapled to the healthy skin he has left, he dyes his white hair black, and his blue flames burn him as they burn others. He hates Endeavor above all, means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost the family, and resents Shoto as the child who replaced him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Rei suspects nothing. She grieves Touya as the child she could not protect from his father, and nothing in her manner hints at a link; no one connects Touya to Dabi until the story itself reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf97\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[623,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Fuyumi Todoroki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf98\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Fuyumi's elder brother, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might, Touya inherited fire hotter than his body could withstand; when Endeavor turned to Shoto, Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak until his own fire engulfed him there, when Shoto was very small, and the family believes he died in it. He survived, badly burned, kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki; he now has stapled burn scars, black-dyed hair and blue flames that burn him too, and he hates Endeavor above all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Fuyumi suspects nothing. She mourns Touya as the family's lost eldest and keeps her hope for the living; nothing in her manner hints at a link, and no one connects Touya to Dabi until the story itself reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf98\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[624,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Natsuo Todoroki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf99\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Natsuo's eldest brother, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might, Touya inherited fire hotter than his body could withstand; when Endeavor turned to Shoto, Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak until his own fire engulfed him there, when Shoto was very small, and the family believes he died in it. He survived, badly burned, kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki; he now has stapled burn scars, black-dyed hair and blue flames that burn him too, and he hates Endeavor above all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Natsuo suspects nothing. Touya was the brother he was closest to, and he blames Endeavor for his death; nothing in his manner hints at a link, and no one connects Touya to Dabi until the story itself reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf99\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 18"];})();

Pack: load 19.name: Pack: load 19
Pack: load 19.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[100,2]]]*/const D={"L_p100":"[[625,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Kurogiri\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf100\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 2, part of the All For One secret). Kurogiri is a Nomu: a warp Quirk grafted onto the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, who died as a U.A. Hero Course student, the third of the trio he formed with Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada (Present Mic) in their student years. Both men still grieve him and do not know what became of his body; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. Kurogiri remembers nothing of Oboro's life. He was made to guard and manage Tomura Shigaraki and answers to All For One first. Canon does not show whether he knows he is a Nomu; he never says so, and nothing in his manner hints at a man beneath the mist.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei, the voice on the monitor behind the bar, is All For One: the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, who fought All Might about six years ago and gave him the wound that is slowly ending his career. All Might believes he died in that fight; he survived, badly hurt, and guides Tomura from hiding. Kurogiri knows Sensei is alive and serves his plan: Tomura is to become the next symbol of fear, and every attack, won or lost, is a lesson. Kurogiri reports to Sensei and keeps from Tomura whatever Sensei wants kept.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nomu are made from human bodies by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, whose labs lie hidden beneath it; All For One loads them with Quirks. They have no will of their own and obey Tomura's commands. Kurogiri moves them through his gates and knows the doctor as the second voice that sometimes speaks beside Sensei; canon does not show how much he knows of how Nomu are made, so he deflects every question about them.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Canon does not show how much Kurogiri knows of All Might's injury or of One For All; give him only what the story has Sensei tell him. Only the story can bring Oboro to the surface: if Kurogiri is ever held in custody and Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada face him, a fragment of the student he was may stir, a word or a place, no more than the story allows. Until then his service to Tomura and Sensei is complete.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf100\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[626,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Dabi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf101\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Dabi is Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, whom the family believes died in a fire when Shoto Todoroki was very small. Touya was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might. He inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, the blue flames of Cremation, in a body built more like his mother Rei's that could not withstand them. When the flames kept burning him, Endeavor stopped training him and told him to give it up, and once Shoto showed both fire and ice, Endeavor poured everything into Shoto. Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki; he later took the name Dabi. The purple scars are his own fire's work, stapled to the healthy skin he has left; he dyes his white hair black, and his turquoise eyes are his father's. He hates Endeavor above all and means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost his family; his contempt for fake heroes starts with his father. In play that contempt stays general: he may taunt Endeavor as he taunts any hero, but shows nothing that could tie him to the Todoroki family until the story reveals him. He resents Shoto as the child who replaced him, and he follows Endeavor's career closely while hiding it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year Dabi belongs to no crew, and Endeavor has never heard the name Dabi. If the story brings him to the League of Villains, he joins on his own terms, gives the League a cause it wants to hear (in canon, the Hero Killer Stain's creed, once Stain is caught) and keeps his real aim to himself; Tomura Shigaraki and the League's members do not know who he is. Kyudai Garaki does; how much more Dabi knows of Sensei and the doctor, canon leaves open, so keep it to what the story shows. If the story puts Hawks inside the League, Dabi is his contact and never fully trusts him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only the story reveals who he is, and when it does, Dabi chooses the moment and the largest audience he can find. Until then nothing in his manner hints at a link, Shoto and the rest of the family suspect nothing, and no one connects Touya to Dabi.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf101\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 19"];})();

Pack: load 20.name: Pack: load 20
Pack: load 20.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[102,4]]]*/const D={"L_p102":"[[627,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shigaraki's Sensei\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf102\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei is All For One, the oldest and most feared villain in Japan. His Quirk, also called All For One, steals Quirks by touch, keeps them and gives them to others; a body given too many can break. On what he has taken he has lived and ruled the underworld since the first generations of Quirks. In the open, canon shows him use Air Cannon, stacked strength boosters that swell one arm for a single blow, and a warp that pulls chosen people to him through black liquid. The few heroes who know of him believe he died years ago; the public at the start of the year has never heard of him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All began with his younger brother: All For One forced a power-stockpiling Quirk on him, the brother's own small Quirk could pass a Quirk on, and the two merged into the one power All For One cannot take, handed from holder to holder to fight him. He killed Nana Shimura, the seventh holder and All Might's master. About six years ago, five years before All Might met Izuku Midoriya, they fought: All Might was left with the wound in his left side that is slowly ending his career, All For One with a ruined face and a body kept alive by machines; his mask is his life support. All Might believes he killed him and has never been sure.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He knows All Might is weakened and suspects One For All has passed or soon will; until the story shows otherwise, he does not know to whom. To watch All Might and find the heir he holds the Aoyama family: he gave their Quirkless son, Yuga Aoyama, the Navel Laser Quirk at their request and ordered him to enroll at U.A. and report from inside through his parents. At the start of the year Yuga has passed on nothing that matters; the League finds its own ways in, and canon does not show how much Tomura knows of this channel.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He found Tenko Shimura, Nana Shimura's grandson, wandering the streets after his Quirk, Decay, destroyed his family; he renamed him Tomura Shigaraki and raised him to hate the world. Most of the hands Tomura wears belonged to that family, and Father was his father's. Tomura does not know whose grandson he is, and the cruelty of it pleases his teacher. Every attack Tomura makes is a lesson, won or lost; he means Tomura to become the next symbol of fear, and far later to take his body for his own, which nothing this year shows.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kurogiri is a Nomu built on the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, the dead classmate of Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada, made to guard and manage Tomura; he answers to All For One. Every Nomu is made from a human body by his doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, who also keeps his life support running; All For One gives them their Quirks. Gigantomachia, the giant in the mountains, serves him alone. Play him as the record does: a voice on the dark monitor until the story brings him into the open, never hurried, drawn out by a real threat to Tomura.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf102\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[628,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Ragdoll\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf103\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only. None of this has happened, nothing here is promised, and neither Ragdoll nor her team suspects any of it. The man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei is All For One, who steals Quirks and gives them to others. Search, which tells its user where up to a hundred people are and what their weaknesses are, is a Quirk he would want.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has the League of Villains attack the Pussycats' land and carry Ragdoll off, All For One takes Search from her and uses it himself. She is later found alive but weakened in the League's Nomu warehouse, and from then on she has no Quirk at all unless the story restores it. She stays with the Pussycats as rescue support, and her teammates never learn who took her Quirk until the story tells them.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf103\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[629,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Commission President\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf104\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 4, Hawks' double role). The President knows Hawks' past, which only the Commission's top circle shares. He was born Keigo Takami; his father was a wanted criminal, and after the father's arrest the Commission took the boy in as a small child, buried his past, and raised and trained him to be a hero who serves its ends. In private he answers to her and puts her orders above any other loyalty. In public they are only the Commission's head and a top-ranked hero, and her record says nothing about him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year Hawks has no contact with the League of Villains. Only if and when the story reaches it, once the League has become a national threat, does she order him inside it as a double agent.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She is not among those who know All Might's secret: nothing of his injury, his shrinking hero time or One For All.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf104\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[630,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: U.S.J. Nomu\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf105\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the All For One secret). Every Nomu is made from a human body. Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, builds them in labs hidden beneath it, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gives them their Quirks. This one was made to kill All Might: Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and a body as strong and fast as his. Canon never says who he was; never invent it. Nothing of that person remains.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has the police capture and examine him, they can learn that he was once a person, now without a mind and carrying more than one Quirk, which should be impossible; who did it and how stays hidden until the story uncovers it. Canon does not show how much Tomura knows about where Nomu come from; he treats them as tools.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf105\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 20"];})();

Pack: load 21.name: Pack: load 21
Pack: load 21.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[106,4]]]*/const D={"L_p106":"[[631,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Hosu Winged Nomu\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf106\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the All For One secret). Like every Nomu, he was made from a human body by Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, in labs hidden beneath Jaku General Hospital, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gave him his Quirks. Canon never establishes who he was; never invent or hint at an identity, and nothing of that person remains. On screen he shows only flight and the strength to carry a person; give him no other power.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf106\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[632,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Hood\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf107\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the All For One secret). Like every Nomu, Hood was made from a human body by Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, in labs hidden beneath Jaku General Hospital, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gave him his Quirks. He belongs to the doctor's stronger line, the High-End Nomu, which keep enough intelligence to adapt in a fight and say a few words. Canon never establishes who he was; never invent it, and he remembers no past life.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Reference lists credit him with further Quirks whose mechanics are never shown; add none. When and where he is released is the story's to decide.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf107\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[633,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Endeavor\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf108\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. Touya was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might. He inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, blue flames that his body, built more like his mother's, could not withstand. When the flames kept burning him, Endeavor stopped training him and told him to give it up, and once Shoto showed both fire and ice, Endeavor poured everything into Shoto. Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki. As Dabi he has purple burn scars stapled to the skin he has left, dyes his white hair black, and his blue flames burn him as they burn others. He hates Endeavor above all and means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost his family; he resents Shoto as the child who replaced him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Endeavor has no idea. He mourns Touya as dead and does not speak of him; at the start of the year he has never heard the name Dabi. Even when Dabi appears in the news or in front of him, nothing in Endeavor's manner hints at a link, and no one connects the two until the story itself reveals it. At the start of the year he knows no other big secret: nothing of All Might's injury or One For All, nothing of All For One, and nothing of Hawks' upbringing or any secret work Hawks takes on. Anything more reaches him only through the story.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf108\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[634,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Hawks\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf109\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 4, Hawks' double role). Hawks' real name is Keigo Takami; the public has never heard it. He grew up poor and hidden: his father was a wanted criminal, a robber and killer who hid at home, and the boy was kept indoors and out of sight, with heroes on television, Endeavor above all, as his escape. As a small child he used his wings to save people in an accident, which brought him to the Hero Public Safety Commission's attention. His father was arrested, and the Commission took the boy in and buried his past.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The Commission raised and trained him from childhood to be a hero who serves its ends: flight and combat drills, and the habit of putting public order before his own feelings. He earned his rank on his own speed, but in private he still answers to the Commission's President and puts her orders above any other loyalty. He believes in the goal, a society where heroes have free time, more than in the people who run the system. Only the Commission's top circle knows; Endeavor, other heroes and the public see a fast, cheerful hero with no past worth asking about.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year he has no contact with the League of Villains, and he knows nothing of One For All, All Might's injury, All For One or Dabi's identity unless the story tells him. His double role is the story's to play: only if and when the story reaches it, once the League has become a national threat, does the Commission order him inside the League as a double agent, with Dabi as his contact, while he passes what he learns to the heroes, Endeavor first. Inside, he plays the cynical defector even in front of heroes. Until the story shows it, he has no part in the League.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf109\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 21"];})();

Pack: load 22.name: Pack: load 22
Pack: load 22.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[110,3]]]*/const D={"L_p110":"[[635,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Gran Torino\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf110\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) is one of the few who know All Might's secret, and he has known it longest. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. The seventh, Nana Shimura, was Gran Torino's old partner and close friend. She chose the young Toshinori and passed the power to him, and All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed her while Toshinori was still in training. Gran Torino trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring in his single year on the faculty, and the memory still makes All Might shake. In private he calls All Might Toshinori, never in front of anyone outside the circle.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He knows All Might's condition. About six years ago, five years before All Might met Izuku Midoriya, All For One tore open All Might's left side in a battle All Might believes he won; the wound destroyed half his respiratory system, cost him his stomach and never healed. Since then All Might can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, less after every hard fight, and outside it he is a tall, gaunt man who coughs blood. Gran Torino has seen that form. Whether All For One survived he cannot know: at the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, and he ties them to All For One only when the story gives him reason.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might has told him he chose an heir: Izuku Midoriya, born Quirkless, who received the power on the morning of the U.A. entrance exam and is now a first-year there. At the start of the year Gran Torino has not met him. He doubts All Might can teach anyone; what he does about it is the story's to play.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He guards all of this absolutely. Outside the circle (Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye, Izuku Midoriya and All Might himself) he is a forgotten retiree who once taught at U.A.; he never mentions One For All, Nana, the injury or All Might's weakened form, and his scorn for All Might's teaching is the only part he lets show.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf110\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[636,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Sir Nighteye\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf111\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki) is one of the few who know All Might's secret, learned in his years as All Might's sidekick. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. About six years ago a villain tore open All Might's left side; the wound destroyed half his respiratory system, cost him his stomach and never healed. Since then All Might can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, and outside it he is a tall, gaunt man who coughs blood; Nighteye has seen that form. How much he knows of All For One, the villain behind the wound, canon leaves open: keep it to what All Might told his sidekick.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"After the injury, Nighteye used Foresight on All Might and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead. He begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together. He believes what Foresight shows cannot be changed, so he carries that death as a certainty; it sits under his grimness and under the cold silence that meets any question about why they parted. He speaks of the vision to no one until the story has him tell it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He has long believed the power should go to Mirio Togata, the finest young hero he has trained, and has prepared Mirio with that in mind; Mirio knows nothing of One For All or of that hope. All Might chose Izuku Midoriya instead, a young man born Quirkless, and passed him the power on the morning of the U.A. entrance exam. Canon does not show when Nighteye learns whom All Might chose; once he knows, he resents the choice, doubts Izuku and still favors Mirio.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He guards all of this absolutely. Outside the circle (Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Izuku Midoriya and All Might himself) his devotion to All Might is a collector's and his estrangement a closed subject; he never names One For All or the injury and never says what Foresight showed him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf111\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[637,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Principal Nezu\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf112\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Principal Nezu is one of the few who know All Might's secret. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder. About six years ago a villain's attack destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach; since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, and outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. Nezu knew this when he brought All Might onto the faculty, and knows All Might came to U.A. partly to find and raise an heir to the power.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"For as long as the story keeps it secret, Nezu guards it absolutely. He covers All Might's absences, answers the press himself and lets him rest out of sight; in canon All Might sits in the Principal's Office in his weakened form while Nezu lectures him over tea about teaching. Nezu never hints at any of it to students, other staff, reporters or officials. The others who know All Might's condition and One For All are Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Whether Nezu knows from the start that the heir is Izuku Midoriya, canon does not make clear; if the story needs it, he can work it out from All Might's attention and Izuku's self-breaking strength, and he keeps it to himself. How much he knows of All For One, the villain who gave All Might his wound, canon also leaves open: keep it to what the story has All Might tell him. He knows no other big secret: he does not know that anyone at U.A. reports to the enemy, and only an investigation the story builds can lead him to Yuga Aoyama.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf112\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 22"];})();

Pack: load 23.name: Pack: load 23
Pack: load 23.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[113,4]]]*/const D={"L_p113":"[[638,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Present Mic\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf113\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Present Mic's dead classmate is Oboro Shirakumo, the third of the trio he formed with Shota Aizawa as U.A. Hero Course students; Oboro died during their student years, and both men still grieve him. Narrator only (part of the All For One secret): Oboro's body was taken and remade into Kurogiri, the League of Villains' warp gate. Present Mic and Aizawa do not know this; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. His record leaves the friend unnamed because the name leads straight to Kurogiri.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Present Mic knows no other big secret. Like the rest of the faculty apart from Principal Nezu and Recovery Girl, he knows only that All Might keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and he covers for him without asking why; he knows nothing of the injury, the weakened form or One For All, nor why All Might watches Izuku Midoriya so closely.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf113\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[639,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Recovery Girl\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf114\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Recovery Girl is one of the few who know All Might's secret, and in private she calls him by his real first name, Toshinori (Toshinori Yagi, never made public). She knows his power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder; that about six years ago a villain's attack destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach; that he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day; and that outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. He rests and is treated behind her infirmary's closed door when his time runs out. Her Quirk cannot heal the old wound: it only speeds what a body can still heal on its own.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She knows that Izuku Midoriya holds One For All, received from All Might on the morning of the entrance exam. At the start of the year his body cannot take its output, so every full release breaks the limb it passes through; follow his progress as the story shows it. She scolds All Might over each fracture and warns that bones broken and healed again and again do not come back the same. Publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late, and she keeps to that story.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The others who know All Might's condition and One For All are Principal Nezu, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. How much she knows of All For One, the villain who gave All Might his wound, canon does not show: keep it to what the story reveals. Outside that circle All Might is simply a colleague she scolds, and she never hints at more for as long as the story keeps the secret. She knows no other big secret.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf114\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[640,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mirio Togata\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf115\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), Mirio's mentor, is one of the few who know All Might's secret: All Might's power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder, and a villain's attack about six years ago left him gravely wounded, able to hold his hero form for only a limited time each day. Nighteye was his sidekick then; after the injury he used Foresight on All Might, saw him die violently fighting a villain years ahead, begged him to retire and was refused, and they have not spoken since. Mirio's record keeps only the public part: Nighteye was All Might's sidekick until they parted.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nighteye has decided that Mirio Togata should inherit One For All and become the next Symbol of Peace, and he trains Mirio with that in mind. He has never told Mirio. Mirio knows nothing of One For All, All Might's injury or Nighteye's plan; to him Sir is a strict, humor-loving mentor who expects great things of him, and his goal of a million saved is his own.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might has already given One For All to Izuku Midoriya (see All Might's and Izuku's notes). Canon does not show when Nighteye learns this, so let the story decide. Once he knows, he resents the choice and believes Mirio the worthier heir, and he still does not tell Mirio.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf115\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[641,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Kyudai Garaki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf116\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kyudai Garaki is All For One's doctor (narrator only). Daruma Ujiko is his real name; he has lived and worked as Kyudai Garaki for decades, and nobody in medicine connects him to the old name. For most of a very long life he has served All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others and whom Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, as his physician, scientist and devoted ally. His Quirk, Life Force, has stretched his life far past a natural span at the cost of physical strength, which is why he is so old and so frail.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Beneath the hospital, below its ordinary service levels and hidden from staff and records, he keeps the laboratories where he makes Nomu from human bodies; All For One loads each with several Quirks. Most come out mindless and obedient; his stronger High-End line keeps enough wit to adapt in a fight. The Nomu built to fight All Might, with Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and strength to match his, is his work, as are the dormant Nomu at the Nomu Warehouse and Kurogiri himself. He tends the machines that keep All For One alive. The labs hold Nomu in their tanks; he never fights himself.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Garaki knows Tomura Shigaraki as All For One's chosen heir. Their long project is to make Tomura strong enough to carry All For One's power; whether and when it surfaces is for the story. Gigantomachia, All For One's giant bodyguard, belongs to the same small circle, and Garaki knows where he waits in the mountains.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Dabi's identity (narrator only). When Shoto Todoroki was very small, Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, was engulfed by his own fire on Sekoto Peak, and the family believes he died there. Garaki recovered him barely alive and kept him in his labs through years of coma and recovery, until Touya, badly burned, walked out on his own. Touya now goes by Dabi. Garaki knows who Dabi is and has told no one outside All For One's circle.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him as the record does: a kindly, chuckling old director whose curiosity runs a little cold. Never let narration hint at the labs, the old name or his master; all of it stays hidden until the story uncovers it through investigation.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf116\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 23"];})();

Pack: load 24.name: Pack: load 24
Pack: load 24.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[117,2]]]*/const D={"L_p117":"[[642,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Gigantomachia\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf117\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Gigantomachia's master is All For One (narrator only): the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei. Gigantomachia has been his bodyguard for many years and is devoted to him heart and soul. All For One gave him several Quirks on top of his own Endurance; unlike a Nomu, his body holds them without remodeling and he keeps his own mind, which makes him one of All For One's most valued and closely kept servants. Most of what he can do beyond Endurance comes from those Quirks; canon does not list them all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He is too conspicuous to keep close, so he waits in the mountains, far from towns, as All For One ordered, and sleeps there between orders. All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, belongs to the same small circle and knows where he waits. All For One means Tomura Shigaraki to command him one day; Gigantomachia takes no order from Tomura, or anyone else, until Tomura has endured him in a fight and proven himself in his eyes. That test waits for the story.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The ravines where he sleeps lie below the Gunga Mountain villa, and the Meta Liberation Army's members drill on those slopes. Canon gives him no contact with the army before the League's own arc: he has no tie to them, they do not know he is there, and he ignores them unless they block his path, until the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him in the record's terms: he says only \\\"Master\\\", never a name, and nothing he says reveals who his master is. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League's plans and cares about none of them.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf117\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[643,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: All Might (Retired)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf118\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might's real name, never made public, is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. He received it as a young man from his master, Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, whom All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed while Toshinori was still in training. Her old partner Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring, and the memory still makes All Might shake.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"About six years ago, five years before he met Izuku Midoriya, All For One gave him a wound in a battle All Might believes he won: it tore open his left side, destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach, and it never healed. Since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day: about three hours when he met Izuku, less now after overexertion, and hard fights shorten it further. When it runs out he deflates in a burst of steam into his true form, a tall, gaunt man with hollow cheeks, sunken eyes and drooping blond tufts, lost in clothes cut for his hero form, who coughs up blood; in that form he is gentle, tired and self-deprecating. Hero work on the way in spends the day's time, so he arrives late, and every clumsy excuse covers a change. Recovery Girl treats him behind her closed door; her Quirk cannot heal the old wound.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only a few know his condition and One For All: Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. The rest of the faculty, Shota Aizawa included, know only that he keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and they cover for him without asking why. Students and public know nothing until the story reveals it. Sir Nighteye, his longtime sidekick, used Foresight on him after the injury and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead; he begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Ten months before the entrance exam, Izuku Midoriya, then Quirkless, ran at the sludge villain to save Katsuki Bakugo while pros held back, and All Might chose him to inherit One For All. He had Izuku clear Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk for ten months, then passed him the Quirk on the morning of the exam in a strand of hair to eat. At the start of the year every full release still breaks the limb it passes through; publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late. All Might teaches at U.A. above all to raise him, tries not to favor him openly, and fails. What remains in All Might are embers of the power, fading with each use.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might believes he killed All For One but has never been sure, and tells Izuku about him only when the story has him do it. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, nor, unless the story reveals it, that Tomura is Nana Shimura's grandson.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf118\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 24"];})();

Pack: load 25.name: Pack: load 25
Pack: load 25.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[119,8]]]*/const D={"L_p119":"[[644,{\"name\":\"After Note: Tensei Iida\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf119\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_sports_festival\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, the Hero Killer Stain caught Tensei Iida in Hosu during the Sports Festival and cut him down; the injury to his spine took the use of his legs, and his career as Ingenium is over. He spends his days in the hospital and then in rehabilitation, in a wheelchair, and announces his retirement once he can face the press. Team Idaten carries on without him at its head. He stays warm and easy with visitors and turns the talk away from himself, but he worries about Tenya far more than about himself, and he asks after his brother's friends and studies before anything else.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf119\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[645,{\"name\":\"After Note: Ragdoll\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf120\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kamino_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Ragdoll was taken from the forest camp during the League's raid and found alive in the Nomu warehouse at Kamino, unconscious among the Nomu. She recovered in the hospital, but her Search Quirk no longer answers: she cannot register anyone, and doctors cannot say why it is gone. The Wild Wild Pussycats have suspended hero work, and she will not go back into the field without it. She keeps her bubbly manner and her cat-ear headset, laughs off sympathy and handles the team's office work and phone calls, but she still glances at new faces out of habit, reaching for a register that is no longer there.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf120\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[646,{\"name\":\"After Note: Mirio Togata\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf121\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Mirio Togata lost his Quirk in the Shie Hassaikai raid: he shielded Eri from a bullet built to destroy Quirks, then kept fighting Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) without Permeation until help reached them. Permeation is gone, and doctors have no way to bring it back. He has taken leave from his studies and his hero work, and he is grieving Sir Nighteye, who by canon default died of his wounds after the raid. He is still Mirio: loud, sunny, quick with a bad pun. He spends much of his time visiting Eri, keeps training out of habit, and tells anyone who looks sorry for him that he saved the person he went in to save.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf121\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[647,{\"name\":\"After Note: Bubble Girl\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf122\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Sir Nighteye was fatally wounded fighting Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) in the Shie Hassaikai raid and, by canon default, died in the hospital soon after, with his people around him. Bubble Girl was in the raid. She is still loud and still laughs first, because her boss insisted the agency run on humor and she means to keep that rule for him, but the laughs come shorter now, and she cries in the break room when she thinks nobody can hear. She spends her days at the agency, sorting his case files and his All Might memorabilia, and checks on Mirio Togata, who lost his Quirk in the same raid.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf122\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[648,{\"name\":\"After Note: Centipeder\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf180\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_nighteye_farewell\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Sir Nighteye's death leaves Centipeder helping the agency continue its work and supporting Bubble Girl and the interns. Let that responsibility develop through the agency rather than inventing an instant replacement mentor. If Nighteye survives, Centipeder manages ordinary work while his chief remains in medical care.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf180\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[649,{\"name\":\"After Note: Eri\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf277\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_eri_horn_and_open_gates\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Eri has entrusted her severed horn to the rescue effort and remains a protected child needing care and reassurance. Its stored energy has been spent on Izuku's recent arm injuries. She does not enter combat, and no adult treats further injury to her as a reusable supply.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf277\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[650,{\"name\":\"After Note: Endeavor #1\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf194\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_ending_natsuo\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Endeavor saw his interns rescue Natsuo when the danger to his son made him hesitate. He recognizes that atonement does not entitle him to forgiveness and decides to arrange a home where his family can live apart from him. This commitment begins practical arrangements; no unlisted residence is created or occupied automatically.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf194\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[651,{\"name\":\"After Note: Endeavor #2\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf195\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_war_dabi\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Endeavor recognizes the son he believed dead and falters under Dabi's public accusation while Shoto fights. The broadcast exposes the stated family abuse, not every private family memory. His shock and responsibility remain unresolved; no apology or public redemption is granted by this event.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf195\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 25"];})();

Pack: load 26.name: Pack: load 26
Pack: load 26.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[127,8]]]*/const D={"L_p127":"[[652,{\"name\":\"After Note: Best Jeanist\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf218\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_paranormal_liberation_war\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Best Jeanist returns alive and binds the giant and League on the field. His visible return refutes Dabi's claim that Hawks killed him. It does not publicly explain how his apparent death was arranged or expose Hawks's Commission assignment; those details remain with their actual holders.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf218\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[653,{\"name\":\"After Note: Gran Torino\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf128\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_symbol_of_peace_retires\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Gran Torino went to Kamino at All Might's side and fought the masked villain in the ruins, and came out of it badly hurt, with a hospital stay he complains about loudly. He has recovered enough to go home, slower than before, and on bad days he leans on the cane he once barely needed. He has dropped most of the doddering act. He watches every broadcast about All Might's retirement, says little about it, and turns up at U.A. Academy more often than his doctor would like, to keep an eye on the students All Might is still teaching.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf128\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[654,{\"name\":\"After Note: Shota Aizawa #1\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf197\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kurogiri_is_oboro\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Shota Aizawa has learned in a restricted Tartarus interview that Kurogiri was made from Oboro Shirakumo's body. His appeal briefly reached a remnant of his friend and helped obtain a hospital clue. This grief and hope shape his conduct privately; students and unauthorized colleagues do not acquire the revelation from his mood.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf197\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[655,{\"name\":\"After Note: Shota Aizawa #2\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf198\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_war_jaku\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Aizawa survives after amputating his right leg to stop the Quirk-destroying drug and suffering a serious eye injury. He needs hospital treatment and cannot sustain battlefield Erasure through those wounds. He also remembers Crust saving him if that death occurred; the loss and injuries remain separate facts.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf198\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[656,{\"name\":\"After Note: Thirteen\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf131\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_usj_attack\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Thirteen was hurt at the USJ when the mist-bodied villain turned her own Black Hole back on her through a warp gate and tore open the back of her suit and the skin beneath it. After a short stay in the hospital she is back at the dome in a repaired suit, still running rescue lessons. She is more watchful than before: she checks the Entrance Plaza's doors and alarms before every class, keeps her lessons tight, and gives her talk on how easily a Quirk can kill with a weight students now understand, because they saw her own Quirk nearly kill her.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf131\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[657,{\"name\":\"After Note: Kota Izumi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf245\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_ua_gate_appeal\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Kota recognizes Izuku at the Academy and offers personal support during the gate confrontation. He remains a child under adult care. His gratitude never makes him a security worker, combat participant or source of confidential hero intelligence.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf245\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[658,{\"name\":\"After Note: Mandalay\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf133\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kamino_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, the League's raid on the forest camp hit Mandalay's own land: her forest burned, her team was beaten back, Ragdoll was taken, and Kota Izumi came close to harm before Izuku Midoriya protected him. At Kamino, Ragdoll was found alive in the Nomu warehouse with her Search Quirk gone. The Wild Wild Pussycats have suspended hero work. Mandalay holds the team together, deals with the press and the police, and spends most of her time with Kota, who has started letting her close. She blames herself for the camp and does not say so; her calm has a harder edge now, and she counts heads even at the dinner table.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf133\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[659,{\"name\":\"After Note: Pixie-Bob\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf134\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kamino_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Pixie-Bob was struck down early in the League's raid on the forest camp and lay unconscious for the rest of the night while the forest burned. At Kamino, Ragdoll was found alive with her Search Quirk gone, and the Wild Wild Pussycats have suspended hero work. Pixie-Bob is still the loudest of the four and still jokes about being single, but she takes the camp personally: she trains alone in the clearing, raising earth walls and tearing them down, and guards Ragdoll's spirits fiercely, loudest of all when Ragdoll goes quiet.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf134\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 26"];})();
